/-
Copyright (c) 2026 The TCSlib Authors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: TCSlib Contributors
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.SpaceAmplifyRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.PTMEquiv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Basic

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The constant `2/3` in `BPTIME(T(n))` is arbitrary

[AB09, §7.1, p. 125]: "the constant 2/3 is arbitrary in the sense that it can be replaced with
any other constant greater than half without changing the classes `BPTIME(T(n))` and `BPP`".
The `BPP` half is `Randomized.BPP_PTMWith_const_eq_BPP_PTM`; this file proves the
`BPTIME(T(n))` half. The machine is the repetition machine `Randomized.Amplify.amp` of
[AB09, §7.7] (`r + 1` runs of `N` on fresh blocks of work tapes, rewinding the input head
between runs, majority vote in the finite control). Its existing analysis bounds a rewind by
`|x| + 2` steps; here a rewind is bounded by the input-head position, which a run of `t` steps
keeps at most `t + 1` (`Randomized.Amplify.halts_comp_pos`), so `2n + 1` runs take `O(n · t)`
steps with no condition on `T`.

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.BPTIMEWith` — `BPTIME(T)` with success threshold `ρ` in place of `2/3`.

## Main results

* `Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos` — the repetition machine halts within
  `t + r (2t + 3) + 1`.
* `Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.amp` — majority of `2n + 1` runs: success `1/2 + ε`
  becomes `1 - 2 (1 - 4ε²)^n`, in time `t + 2n (2t + 3) + 1`.
* `Randomized.BPTIMEWith_eq_BPTIME` — for every constant `ρ ∈ (1/2, 1)`,
  `BPTIMEWith ρ T = BPTIME T`, for every `T`. [AB09, p. 125]

## Divergences

* The book makes the claim precise only for `BPP` (§7.4.1). For `BPTIME(T(n))` no hypothesis
  on `T` (time-constructibility, `T(n) ≥ n`) is needed: the repetition reruns `N` under its
  own halting, and a decider in time `c · T` forces `c · T(n) ≥ 1`.
* `ρ < 1` is required: `ρ > 1` gives the empty class, and `ρ = 1` demands zero error, which
  majority votes cannot reach. The threshold `ρ` ranges over `ℚ` rather than `ℝ`; this is
  class-preserving, since every real `ρ ∈ (1/2, 1)` lies between two rationals in `(1/2, 1)`
  and the class is antitone in `ρ`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized.Amplify

open Turing

/-! ### Halting of the repetition machine -/

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {r : ℕ} {dec : ℕ → Bool} {x : List Bool} {t : ℕ}

/-- From a rewinding configuration after run `j`, with `i = r - j` runs left and the input head
at most `t + 1`, every branch halts within `i (2t + 3) + 1` steps.

**Proof sketch.** As `Randomized.Amplify.rewind_halts`, but the rewind takes `p + 2 ≤ t + 3`
steps (`rewind_run_pos`, `Turing.FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val`), and `halts_comp_pos` passes the
bound `t + 1` on the input head of a halted run of length at most `t` started at cell `1`. -/
theorem rewind_halts_pos (ht : N.tm.HaltsWithin x t) :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (j : Fin (r + 1)), j.val + i = r → ∀ (c : Fin (r + 2)) (C : ACfg N r x),
      RewindAt C j c → C.inputPos.val ≤ t + 1 →
        ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = i * (2 * t + 3) + 1 →
          ((amp N r dec).tm.runWith w C).state = none := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro j hj c C hC _ w hw
    obtain ⟨b, w', rfl⟩ : ∃ b w', w = b :: w' := by
      cases w with
      | nil => simp at hw
      | cons b w' => exact ⟨b, w', rfl⟩
    have hlast : ¬ j.val < r := by omega
    cases b
    · rw [(rewind_last hC.1 hlast w').2]; rfl
    · rw [(rewind_last hC.1 hlast w').1]; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro j hj c C hC hpos w hw
    have hjr : j.val < r := by omega
    set p := (moveInputPos C.inputPos (-1)).val with hp
    have hp' : p ≤ t + 1 := by
      rw [hp, ← SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
      omega
    have hrun := (rewind_run_pos (dec := dec) hC.1 hjr).2
    have hE := restart_eq_emb C ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ c
      (fun t ht => hC.2.2 t (by rw [ht]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)) hC.2.1
    have hF : Fresh (restart C ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ c) (j.val + 1) :=
      fun t ht => hC.2.2 t (by omega)
    have hcomp := halts_comp_pos (B := t + 1)
      (fun u b hu => step_emb (dec := dec) (restart C ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ c)
        ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ c u b hu)
      (fun u hu hu' w hw => ih ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ (by show j.val + 1 + i = r; omega) _ _
        (rewindAt_emb c hu hF) hu' w hw) t (N.tm.initCfg x) (by simp; omega) ht
    have hmul : (i + 1) * (2 * t + 3) = i * (2 * t + 3) + (2 * t + 3) := by ring
    rw [← List.take_append_drop (p + 2) w, NDTM.runWith_append,
      hrun _ (List.length_take_of_le (by omega)), hE]
    exact halted_of_le hcomp (by simp only [List.length_drop]; omega)

/-- **The repetition machine halts in `O(r t)` steps**: if `N` halts on `x` within `t` on every
branch, then `amp N r dec` halts within `t + r (2t + 3) + 1`, whatever `|x|` is.
[AB09, §7.7, p. 139] -/
theorem amp_haltsWithin_pos (ht : N.tm.HaltsWithin x t) :
    (amp N r dec).tm.HaltsWithin x (t + (r * (2 * t + 3) + 1)) := by
  intro w hw
  rw [init_eq_emb]
  exact halts_comp_pos (B := t + 1) (fun u b hu => step_emb _ 0 0 u b hu)
    (fun u hu hu' w hw => rewind_halts_pos ht r 0 (by simp) _ _ (rewindAt_emb 0 hu fresh_init)
      hu' w hw) t (N.tm.initCfg x) (by simp; omega) ht w hw

/-- The output distribution of `amp N r dec` at the time bound of `amp_haltsWithin_pos`. -/
theorem amp_outputProb_pos (ht : N.tm.HaltsWithin x t) (v : Bool) :
    (amp N r dec).outputProb x (t + (r * (2 * t + 3) + 1)) [v] =
      randProb ((r + 1) * t) (fun l => dec (blockCount t (r + 1) (acc N x) l) = v) := by
  rw [← amp_outputProb ht v,
    ← FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin (amp_haltsWithin_pos ht)
      (le_max_left _ (t + (r * (t + x.length + 2) + 1))),
    FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin (amp_haltsWithin ht) (le_max_right _ _)]

end Randomized.Amplify

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

open Randomized

/-- Threshold-`p` deciding is monotone in the time bound and antitone in the threshold. -/
theorem BPDecidesInTimeWith.mono {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    {p q : ℕ → ℚ} (h : N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L T₁ p) (hT : ∀ n, T₁ n ≤ T₂ n)
    (hp : ∀ n, q n ≤ p n) : N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L T₂ q := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hprob⟩ := h x
  refine ⟨hhalt.mono (hT _), ?_⟩
  rw [outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin hhalt (hT _)]
  exact (hp _).trans hprob

/-- A decider in time `T` has `T(n) ≥ 1` for every `n`: no branch is halted at time `0`. -/
theorem BPDecidesInTimeWith.one_le {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ}
    {p : ℕ → ℚ} (h : N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L T p) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ T n := by
  by_contra h0
  have hT : T (List.replicate n false).length = 0 := by simp only [List.length_replicate]; omega
  have hh := (h (List.replicate n false)).1
  rw [hT] at hh
  exact NDTM.not_haltsWithin_zero N.tm _ hh

/-- **Majority of `2n + 1` runs** [AB09, §7.4.1]: a decider with success `1/2 + ε` in time `t`
gives one with success `1 - 2 (1 - 4ε²)^n` in time `t + 2n (2t + 3) + 1`.

The runs of `Amplify.amp` are independent blocks (`Amplify.amp_outputProb_pos`), whose
majority is correct with that probability (`Amplify.majority_randProb_ge`). -/
theorem BPDecidesInTimeWith.amp {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {t : ℕ → ℕ} {ε : ℚ}
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (h : N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L t fun _ => 1/2 + ε) (n : ℕ) :
    (Amplify.amp N (2 * n) fun m => decide (2 * n + 1 < 2 * m)).BPDecidesInTimeWith L
      (fun l => t l + (2 * n * (2 * t l + 3) + 1)) fun _ => 1 - 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n := by
  intro x
  set T := t x.length
  set dec : ℕ → Bool := fun m => decide (2 * n + 1 < 2 * m)
  obtain ⟨hT, hp⟩ := h x
  refine ⟨Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos hT, ?_⟩
  show _ ≤ (Amplify.amp N (2 * n) dec).outputProb x (T + (2 * n * (2 * T + 3) + 1)) _
  rw [Amplify.amp_outputProb_pos hT]
  exact Amplify.majority_randProb_ge hε _ hp

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Turing

/-- `BPTIME(T)` with success threshold `ρ`: the languages decided by some PTM in time `c · T`
with `Pr[M(x) = L(x)] ≥ ρ`. [AB09, Def 7.2 and p. 125] -/
def BPTIMEWith (ρ : ℚ) (T : ℕ → ℕ) : Set (Language Bool) :=
  {L | ∃ (c : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L (fun n => c * T n) fun _ => ρ}

/-- `BPTIME` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem BPTIMEWith_two_thirds (T : ℕ → ℕ) : BPTIMEWith (2/3) T = BPTIME T := rfl

/-- Lowering the threshold enlarges the class. -/
theorem BPTIMEWith_anti {ρ ρ' : ℚ} (h : ρ' ≤ ρ) (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    BPTIMEWith ρ T ⊆ BPTIMEWith ρ' T := by
  rintro L ⟨c, N, hN⟩
  exact ⟨c, N, hN.mono (fun _ => le_rfl) fun _ => h⟩

/-- Success `1/2 + ε` can be raised to `1 - η` within `BPTIME(T)`, given `n` with
`2 (1 - 4ε²)^n ≤ η`: majority of `2n + 1` runs, in time `(10n + 2) c · T`. [AB09, §7.4.1] -/
theorem BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp {ε η : ℚ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n ≤ η) (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    BPTIMEWith (1/2 + ε) T ⊆ BPTIMEWith (1 - η) T := by
  rintro L ⟨c, N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨(10 * n + 2) * c, _, (hN.amp hε n).mono (fun l => ?_) fun _ => by linarith⟩
  have h1 := hN.one_le l
  nlinarith

/-- **The constant `2/3` in `BPTIME(T(n))` is arbitrary** [AB09, §7.1, p. 125]: for every
constant `ρ ∈ (1/2, 1)` and every `T`, `BPTIMEWith ρ T = BPTIME T`.

**Proof sketch.** Both inclusions are `BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp` followed by
`BPTIMEWith_anti`: from `ρ = 1/2 + (ρ - 1/2)` to `2/3`, and from `2/3 = 1/2 + 1/6` to `ρ`,
choosing `n` with `(1 - 4ε²)^n` small (`exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one`). -/
theorem BPTIMEWith_eq_BPTIME {ρ : ℚ} (h1 : 1/2 < ρ) (h2 : ρ < 1) (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    BPTIMEWith ρ T = BPTIME T := by
  rw [← BPTIMEWith_two_thirds]
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ ?_
  · set ε := ρ - 1/2 with hε
    have hq : 1 - 4 * ε ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show (0 : ℚ) < 1/6 by norm_num) hq
    have h := BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp (n := n) (ε := ε) (η := 1/3) (by linarith) (by linarith) T
    rw [show 1/2 + ε = ρ by ring] at h
    exact h.trans (BPTIMEWith_anti (by norm_num) T)
  · have hq : 1 - 4 * (1/6 : ℚ) ^ 2 < 1 := by norm_num
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show (0 : ℚ) < (1 - ρ) / 2 by linarith) hq
    have h := BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp (n := n) (ε := 1/6) (η := 1 - ρ) (by norm_num)
      (by linarith) T
    rw [show (1/2 : ℚ) + 1/6 = 2/3 by norm_num] at h
    exact h.trans (BPTIMEWith_anti (by linarith) T)

end Randomized

## ===== campaign/gates/125-word-leaves/review/replay/compiled-source/TCSlib/Complexity/Randomized/BiasedCoin.lean.txt =====

/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: TCSlib Contributors
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Coins
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ErrorReduction
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.PTMEquiv

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Probabilistic machines with a `ρ`-coin

The setting of [AB09, §7.4.3] and Exercise 7.5: a PTM whose coins come up `1` with probability
`ρ` instead of `1/2`. The probability of an event over `m` such coins is `Randomized.biasedProb`
(`TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Coins`). This file identifies it with the product Bernoulli
measure `Randomized.iidBernoulli`, so that Hoeffding's bound applies to `ρ`-coins, defines
bounded-error decision with a `ρ`-coin, and turns polynomial-time verifiers into such machines.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.FinNDTM.biasedOutputProb` — `Pr[M(x) = v]` over `t` `ρ`-coins.
* `Turing.FinNDTM.BiasedBPDecidesInTime`, `Randomized.biasedBPTIME`, `Randomized.biasedBPP` —
  [AB09, Def 7.2] with a `ρ`-coin.

## Main results

* `Randomized.biasedProb_eq_toReal_iidBernoulli` — `biasedProb` is the product measure.
* `Randomized.biasedProb_count_dev_le` — Hoeffding for `ρ`-coins.
* `Randomized.biasedBPP_half` — with `ρ = 1/2` the class is `BPP` ([AB09, Def 7.2]).
* `Randomized.mem_biasedBPP_of_eff` — a polynomial-time verifier correct with probability
  `≥ 2/3` over `ρ`-coins gives a language in `biasedBPP ρ`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Finset MeasureTheory Complexity Turing
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

variable {ρ : ℝ}

/-! ### Elementary properties of `biasedProb` -/

/-- Complement rule for `ρ`-coins. -/
theorem biasedProb_not (m : ℕ) (A : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb ρ m (fun w => ¬ A w) = 1 - biasedProb ρ m A := by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero => by_cases h : A [] <;> simp [biasedProb, h]
  | succ m ih => rw [biasedProb_succ, biasedProb_succ, ih, ih]; ring

/-- `ρ`-coin probabilities are monotone in the event, for `0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1`. -/
theorem biasedProb_mono (h0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (h1 : ρ ≤ 1) {m : ℕ} {A B : List Bool → Prop}
    (h : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = m → A w → B w) : biasedProb ρ m A ≤ biasedProb ρ m B := by
  induction m generalizing A B with
  | zero =>
    by_cases hA : A []
    · simp [biasedProb, hA, h [] rfl hA]
    · simp only [biasedProb, hA, if_false]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [biasedProb_succ, biasedProb_succ]
    have e1 := ih (A := fun w => A (true :: w)) (B := fun w => B (true :: w))
      fun w hw => h _ (by simp [hw])
    have e2 := ih (A := fun w => A (false :: w)) (B := fun w => B (false :: w))
      fun w hw => h _ (by simp [hw])
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 h0
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - ρ)
    linarith

/-- An event of the coins after the first `s` has its probability over the remaining coins. -/
theorem biasedProb_drop (s n : ℕ) (P : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb ρ (s + n) (fun w => P (w.drop s)) = biasedProb ρ n P := by
  induction s generalizing n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [show s + 1 + n = (s + n) + 1 by omega, biasedProb_succ]
    simp only [List.drop_succ_cons]
    rw [ih]; ring

/-- An event of the first `n` coins has its probability over `n` coins. -/
theorem biasedProb_take (n t : ℕ) (P : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb ρ (n + t) (fun w => P (w.take n)) = biasedProb ρ n P := by
  induction n generalizing P with
  | zero =>
    classical
    simp only [List.take_zero, Nat.zero_add]
    by_cases h : P []
    · simp [h, biasedProb]
    · simp [h, biasedProb]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show n + 1 + t = (n + t) + 1 by omega, biasedProb_succ, biasedProb_succ]
    simp only [List.take_succ_cons]
    rw [ih (fun w => P (true :: w)), ih (fun w => P (false :: w))]

/-- A condition on the slice `w[s, s+T)` of `m ≥ s + T` `ρ`-coins has its probability over
`T` coins. -/
theorem biasedProb_drop_take {s T m : ℕ} (h : s + T ≤ m) (B : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb ρ m (fun w => B ((w.drop s).take T)) = biasedProb ρ T B := by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [Nat.add_assoc, biasedProb_drop s (T + e) (fun v => B (v.take T)), biasedProb_take]

/-- **Projection onto marked coordinates preserves `ρ`-coins**: the coins of a `ρ`-coin word at
the marked positions of `mask` are independent `ρ`-coins. -/
theorem biasedProb_maskSelect (mask : List Bool) (A : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb ρ mask.length (fun w => A (maskSelect mask w)) =
      biasedProb ρ (mask.filter id).length A := by
  induction mask generalizing A with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.length_nil, List.filter_nil]
    rfl
  | cons emit mask ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons, biasedProb_succ]
    cases emit with
    | false =>
      simp only [maskSelect, if_false, List.nil_append, List.filter_cons, id,
        Bool.false_eq_true]
      rw [ih A]
      ring
    | true =>
      simp only [maskSelect, if_true, List.singleton_append, List.filter_cons, id,
        List.length_cons]
      rw [ih (fun u => A (true :: u)), ih (fun u => A (false :: u)), biasedProb_succ]

/-! ### `biasedProb` is the product Bernoulli measure -/

/-- `biasedProb` as a sum of word weights `∏ᵢ (ρ if wᵢ = 1 else 1 - ρ)` over the event. -/
theorem biasedProb_eq_sum (m : ℕ) (A : List Bool → Prop) [DecidablePred A] :
    biasedProb ρ m A = ∑ w : Fin m → Bool,
      if A (List.ofFn w) then ∏ i, (if w i then ρ else 1 - ρ) else 0 := by
  induction m generalizing A with
  | zero =>
    by_cases hA : A [] <;> simp [biasedProb, hA]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [biasedProb_succ, ih, ih, ← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ => Bool).sum_comp,
      Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool, mul_sum, mul_sum]
    congr 1 <;> refine sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_ <;>
      simp only [Fin.consEquiv_apply, List.ofFn_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
        Fin.prod_univ_succ, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] <;>
      split_ifs <;> simp

/-- **`biasedProb` is the product measure**: for `0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1`, the probability of `A` over `m`
`ρ`-coins is the `iidBernoulli m ρ` measure of the words in `A`. [AB09, §7.4.3]

**Proof sketch.** Both are sums of word weights: `biasedProb_eq_sum` on one side, the
singleton masses `∏ᵢ Bernoulli(ωᵢ)` of the product measure (`Measure.pi_pi`) on the other. -/
theorem biasedProb_eq_toReal_iidBernoulli {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : p ≤ 1) (m : ℕ)
    (A : List Bool → Prop) :
    biasedProb (p : ℝ) m A = (iidBernoulli m p hp {ω | A (List.ofFn ω)}).toReal := by
  classical
  have hS : {ω : Fin m → Bool | A (List.ofFn ω)} =
      ↑(univ.filter fun ω : Fin m → Bool => A (List.ofFn ω)) := by ext; simp
  have hsing : ∀ ω : Fin m → Bool, iidBernoulli m p hp {ω} =
      ∏ i, (PMF.bernoulli p hp) (ω i) := fun ω => by
    rw [← Set.univ_pi_singleton, iidBernoulli, Measure.pi_pi]
    refine prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    exact PMF.toMeasure_apply_singleton _ _ (measurableSet_singleton _)
  rw [hS, ← sum_measure_singleton, biasedProb_eq_sum, sum_filter,
    ENNReal.toReal_sum fun ω _ => ?_]
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun ω _ => ?_
    split_ifs
    · rw [hsing, ENNReal.toReal_prod]
      refine prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      cases ω i
      · simp only [PMF.bernoulli_apply, cond_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        rw [ENNReal.coe_toReal, NNReal.coe_sub hp, NNReal.coe_one]
      · simp
    · rfl
  · split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The number of `1`s in `ω` is `successCount ω`. -/
theorem successCount_eq_count {k : ℕ} (ω : Fin k → Bool) :
    successCount ω = ((List.ofFn ω).count true : ℝ) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [successCount]
  | succ k ih =>
    have := ih (fun i => ω i.succ)
    simp only [successCount] at this ⊢
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, this, List.ofFn_succ, List.count_cons]
    cases ω 0 <;> simp; ring

/-- **Hoeffding for `ρ`-coins**: over `k > 0` `ρ`-coins, the fraction of `1`s is more than `δ`
away from `ρ` with probability at most `2e^{-2δ²k}`. -/
theorem biasedProb_count_dev_le {p : ℝ≥0} (hp : p ≤ 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    biasedProb (p : ℝ) k (fun w => δ < |(w.count true : ℝ) / k - p|) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * k) := by
  rw [biasedProb_eq_toReal_iidBernoulli hp]
  have h := iid_bernoulli_avg_concentration hp hk hδ
  simp only [successCount_eq_count] at h
  calc _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.exp (-2 * δ ^ 2 * k))).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h
    _ = _ := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)

end Randomized

/-! ### Machines with a `ρ`-coin -/

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

/-- `Pr[M(x) = v]` over `t` `ρ`-coins: the `ρ`-weight of the coin words of length `t` whose run
on `x` ends with output `v`. [AB09, §7.4.3] -/
noncomputable def biasedOutputProb (ρ : ℝ) (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (v : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  Randomized.biasedProb ρ t fun w => N.outputWith x w = v

/-- The PTM `N` with a `ρ`-coin decides `L` in time `T` with bounded error: every branch halts
within `T(|x|)` steps and `Pr[M(x) = L(x)] ≥ 2/3`. [AB09, Def 7.2 with a `ρ`-coin, §7.4.3] -/
def BiasedBPDecidesInTime (ρ : ℝ) (N : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x : List Bool, N.tm.HaltsWithin x (T x.length) ∧
    2/3 ≤ N.biasedOutputProb ρ x (T x.length) [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-- `BPTIME(T)` with a `ρ`-coin. [AB09, Def 7.2, §7.4.3] -/
def biasedBPTIME (ρ : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℕ) : Set (Language Bool) :=
  {L | ∃ (c : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), N.BiasedBPDecidesInTime ρ L fun n => c * T n}

/-- `BPP` with a `ρ`-coin: `⋃_c biasedBPTIME ρ (n^c + 1)`. [AB09, §7.4.3, Exercise 7.5] -/
def biasedBPP (ρ : ℝ) : Set (Language Bool) := ⋃ c : ℕ, biasedBPTIME ρ fun n => n ^ c + 1

/-- With a fair coin the class is `BPP`: `biasedBPP (1/2) = BPP_PTM`. [AB09, Def 7.2] -/
theorem biasedBPP_half : biasedBPP (1 / 2) = BPP_PTM := by
  classical
  have h : ∀ (N : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ),
      N.BiasedBPDecidesInTime (1 / 2) L T ↔ N.BPDecidesInTime L T := fun N L T => by
    refine forall_congr' fun x => and_congr Iff.rfl ?_
    rw [FinNDTM.biasedOutputProb, biasedProb_half, FinNDTM.outputProb]
    rw [show (2 / 3 : ℝ) = ((2 / 3 : ℚ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Rat.cast_le]
  ext L
  simp only [biasedBPP, BPP_PTM, Set.mem_iUnion, biasedBPTIME, BPTIME, Set.mem_setOf_eq, h]

/-- **Verifiers to `ρ`-coin machines**: a polynomial-time verifier `M` drawing `polyLen a k`
coins is simulated by a PTM running in time `K·(n^e + 1)` whose output distribution under
`ρ`-coins is that of `M(x, ·)` under `ρ`-coins, for every `ρ`.

**Proof sketch.** The machine of `exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff` reads a coordinate
projection of a slice of its coins; such projections of `ρ`-coin words are `ρ`-coin words
(`biasedProb_drop_take`, `biasedProb_maskSelect`). -/
theorem exists_FinNDTM_biased_of_eff {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {a k : ℕ}
    (hM : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M)) :
    ∃ (K e : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), ∀ x : List Bool,
      N.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) ∧
      ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (b : Bool), N.biasedOutputProb ρ x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) [b] =
        biasedProb ρ (polyLen a k x.length) fun u => M x u = b := by
  obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff (a := a) (k := k) hM
  refine ⟨K, e, N, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, mask, hcount, hle, hrun⟩ := hN x
  refine ⟨fun w hw => (hrun w hw).1, fun ρ b => ?_⟩
  unfold FinNDTM.biasedOutputProb
  rw [biasedProb_congr (B := fun w => M x (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length)) = b)
    fun w hw => by rw [(hrun w hw).2.1, List.singleton_inj],
    biasedProb_drop_take hle (fun v => M x (maskSelect mask v) = b),
    biasedProb_maskSelect mask (fun u => M x u = b), hcount]

/-- **A verifier over `ρ`-coins decides in `biasedBPP ρ`**: if a polynomial-time verifier `M`
with `polyLen a k` coins answers `L(x)` with `ρ`-coin probability at least `2/3` on every `x`,
then `L ∈ biasedBPP ρ`. [AB09, Def 7.2 ⇐ Def 7.3, with a `ρ`-coin] -/
theorem mem_biasedBPP_of_eff {ρ : ℝ} {L : Language Bool} {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool}
    {a k : ℕ} (hM : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M))
    (hL : ∀ x : List Bool, 2/3 ≤ biasedProb ρ (polyLen a k x.length)
      fun u => M x u = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x) :
    L ∈ biasedBPP ρ := by
  obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_FinNDTM_biased_of_eff (a := a) (k := k) hM
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, K, N, fun x => ⟨(hN x).1, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [(hN x).2]
  exact hL x

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.BiasedCoin
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.BinaryArith.Loops
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.UHalt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# An uncomputable coin decides an undecidable language

[AB09, Exercise 7.5]: [AB09, Lemma 7.12] needs `ρ` to be efficiently computable. Here `ρ` has base-4
digits `h₀ h₁ h₂ … ∈ {0, 1}`, `hⱼ = 1` iff `j ∈ Nat.Partrec.Code.haltingSet`. Then
`4^J ρ = A_J + τ` with `A_J = ∑_{j<J} hⱼ 4^{J-1-j} ∈ ℕ` and `τ ∈ [0, 1/3]`, so an estimate of
`ρ` within `1/(4·4^J)` reads `A_J` and `h_{J-1}` off. The language is
`L = {1^N 0 y : J = ⌊log₄|y|⌋ ≥ 1, N = A_{J-1}, h_{J-1} = 1}`: the input carries the unary
padding `y` that pays for the `32(n+1)² ≥ 32·16^J` coins of the estimate. A polynomial-time
verifier counting the `1`s among `32(n+1)²` `ρ`-coins decides `L` with error `< 1/3`, so
`L ∈ biasedBPP ρ`, while `L` is not computable: `A_j` and then `h_j` would be computable by
recursion on `j`.

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.haltDigit`, `Randomized.haltCoin` — the digits and the real `ρ`.
* `Randomized.haltLang` — the language; `Randomized.haltCoinVerifier` — the verifier.

## Main results

* `Randomized.not_computablePred_haltLang` — `L` is undecidable.
* `Randomized.haltLang_mem_biasedBPP` — `L ∈ biasedBPP ρ`.
* `Randomized.exists_biasedBPP_not_computablePred` — [AB09, Exercise 7.5].

## Divergences

* Undecidability is Mathlib's `ComputablePred` (no partial recursive decision procedure).
* The book leaves the language open; ours is a padded, prefix-checked form of the halting set
  (the padding is what makes `poly(n)` coins enough to read the needed digit).
* The machine is obtained from a polynomial-time verifier (`mem_biasedBPP_of_eff`); the time
  bound is that of [AB09, Def 7.2], with all `ρ`-coins drawn from the same coin.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Finset Complexity Turing
open scoped NNReal

/-! ### The halting coin -/

/-- The halting digits: `haltDigit j` iff `j ∈ Nat.Partrec.Code.haltingSet`, i.e. the code
numbered `j.unpair.1` halts on input `j.unpair.2`. -/
def haltDigit (j : ℕ) : Prop := j ∈ Nat.Partrec.Code.haltingSet

/-- The halting digits are not computable (the halting problem). -/
theorem not_computablePred_haltDigit : ¬ ComputablePred haltDigit :=
  Nat.Partrec.Code.not_computablePred_mem_haltingSet

open Classical in
/-- The `j`-th digit as a number in `{0, 1}`. -/
noncomputable def haltBit (j : ℕ) : ℕ := if haltDigit j then 1 else 0

/-- A digit is `0` or `1`. -/
theorem haltBit_le_one (j : ℕ) : haltBit j ≤ 1 := by
  unfold haltBit; split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- The halting coin `ρ = ∑ⱼ hⱼ 4^{-(j+1)}`. [AB09, Exercise 7.5] -/
noncomputable def haltCoin : ℝ := ∑' j : ℕ, (haltBit j : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1)

/-- The integer part `A_J = ∑_{j<J} hⱼ 4^{J-1-j}` of `4^J ρ`, by `A_{J+1} = 4A_J + h_J`. -/
noncomputable def haltPrefix : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | J + 1 => 4 * haltPrefix J + haltBit J

/-- The terms of `haltCoin` are summable, from any offset. -/
theorem summable_haltCoin (J : ℕ) :
    Summable fun j : ℕ => (haltBit (j + J) : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1) := by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by positivity) (fun j => ?_)
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 1)).mul_left
      (1 / 4))
  have : (haltBit (j + J) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast haltBit_le_one _
  rw [pow_succ]
  nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4) j]

/-- **The digits of `ρ`**: `4^J ρ = A_J + τ` with `0 ≤ τ ≤ 1/3`.

**Proof sketch.** Split the series after `J` terms. The head, times `4^J`, is `A_J` (induction
on `J`); the tail, times `4^J`, is `∑ⱼ h_{j+J} 4^{-(j+1)} ∈ [0, ∑ⱼ 4^{-(j+1)}] = [0, 1/3]`. -/
theorem haltCoin_mul_pow (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, haltCoin * 4 ^ J = haltPrefix J + τ ∧ 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  have hhead : ∀ J, (haltPrefix J : ℝ) =
      4 ^ J * ∑ j ∈ range J, (haltBit j : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1) := by
    intro J
    induction J with
    | zero => simp [haltPrefix]
    | succ J ih =>
      have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ (J + 1) * (1 / 4) ^ (J + 1) = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
      rw [haltPrefix, sum_range_succ]
      push_cast
      rw [ih]
      linear_combination (-(haltBit J : ℝ)) * h4
  have hs0 : Summable fun j : ℕ => (haltBit j : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1) := by
    simpa using summable_haltCoin 0
  set τ := ∑' j : ℕ, (haltBit (j + J) : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1)
  refine ⟨τ, ?_, tsum_nonneg fun j => by positivity, ?_⟩
  · have hsplit := (Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add J hs0).symm
    have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ J * (1 / 4) ^ J = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    rw [haltCoin, hsplit, hhead, add_mul, mul_comm]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_comm, ← tsum_mul_left]
    refine tsum_congr fun j => ?_
    rw [show j + J + 1 = (j + 1) + J by ring, pow_add]
    linear_combination ((haltBit (j + J) : ℝ) * (1 / 4) ^ (j + 1)) * h4
  · have hg : Summable fun j : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) :=
      ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 1)).mul_left
        (1 / 4)).congr fun j => by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    calc τ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) :=
          (summable_haltCoin J).tsum_le_tsum (fun j => by
            have : (haltBit (j + J) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast haltBit_le_one _
            nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4) (j + 1)]) hg
      _ = 1 / 3 := by
          rw [show (fun j : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1)) = fun j => 1 / 4 * (1 / 4) ^ j from
            funext fun j => by ring, tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num)
            (by norm_num)]
          norm_num

/-- `0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1/3`. -/
theorem haltCoin_mem : 0 ≤ haltCoin ∧ haltCoin ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  obtain ⟨τ, h, h0, h1⟩ := haltCoin_mul_pow 0
  simp [haltPrefix] at h
  exact ⟨h ▸ h0, h ▸ h1⟩

/-! ### The language -/

/-- The unary number `N` of an input `1^N 0 y`. -/
def hlN (x : List Bool) : ℕ := (BinArith.uHead x).length

/-- The precision exponent `J = ⌊log₄ |y|⌋` of an input `1^N 0 y`. -/
def hlJ (x : List Bool) : ℕ := Nat.log 4 (BinArith.uRest x).length

/-- [AB09, Exercise 7.5]: the inputs `1^N 0 y` with `J = ⌊log₄|y|⌋ ≥ 1`, `N = A_{J-1}` and
`h_{J-1} = 1`. -/
def haltLang : Language Bool :=
  {x | 1 ≤ hlJ x ∧ hlN x = haltPrefix (hlJ x - 1) ∧ haltDigit (hlJ x - 1)}

/-- **Where `4^J ρ` lies**: on members `4^J ρ ∈ [4N + 1, 4N + 4/3]`; on non-members
`4^J ρ ≤ 4N + 1/3` or `4^J ρ ≥ 4N + 4`.

**Proof sketch.** `4^J ρ = A_J + τ` with `τ ∈ [0, 1/3]` (`haltCoin_mul_pow`). For `J = 0`,
`4^0 ρ = τ ≤ 1/3`. For `J = j + 1`, `A_J = 4A_j + h_j`: members have `N = A_j`, `h_j = 1`, so
`A_J = 4N + 1`; for non-members, `N < A_j` gives `A_J ≥ 4N + 4`, while `N > A_j`, or `N = A_j`
with `h_j = 0`, gives `A_J ≤ 4N` (`A_J ≤ 4N - 3` in the first case). -/
theorem haltCoin_mul_pow_hlJ (x : List Bool) :
    (x ∈ haltLang → 4 * hlN x + 1 ≤ haltCoin * 4 ^ hlJ x ∧
      haltCoin * 4 ^ hlJ x ≤ 4 * hlN x + 4 / 3) ∧
    (x ∉ haltLang → haltCoin * 4 ^ hlJ x ≤ 4 * hlN x + 1 / 3 ∨
      4 * hlN x + 4 ≤ haltCoin * 4 ^ hlJ x) := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, h0, h1⟩ := haltCoin_mul_pow (hlJ x)
  rw [hτ]
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ hlN x := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (hlJ x) with hJ | hJ
  · have hx : x ∉ haltLang := fun h => by have := h.1; omega
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h hx, fun _ => Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [hJ, haltPrefix]; push_cast; linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, hlJ x = j + 1 := ⟨hlJ x - 1, by omega⟩
  have hb : (haltBit j : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast haltBit_le_one j
  have hmem : x ∈ haltLang ↔ hlN x = haltPrefix j ∧ haltDigit j := by
    show 1 ≤ hlJ x ∧ hlN x = haltPrefix (hlJ x - 1) ∧ haltDigit (hlJ x - 1) ↔ _
    rw [hj]
    simp
  rw [hmem, hj, haltPrefix]
  push_cast
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hA, hd⟩ => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
  · have : haltBit j = 1 := by simp [haltBit, hd]
    rw [hA, this]; push_cast; constructor <;> linarith
  · rcases lt_trichotomy (hlN x) (haltPrefix j) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · right
      have : (hlN x : ℝ) + 1 ≤ haltPrefix j := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      linarith
    · left
      have : haltBit j = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hx ⟨heq, by by_contra hd; simp [haltBit, hd] at h⟩
      rw [heq, this]; push_cast; linarith
    · left
      have : (haltPrefix j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ hlN x := by exact_mod_cast hgt
      linarith

/-! ### Undecidability -/

/-- The input `1^N 0 1^{4^{j+1}}` asking whether `N = A_j` and `h_j = 1`. -/
def hlQuery (N j : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  List.replicate N true ++ false :: List.replicate (4 ^ (j + 1)) true

/-- The query reads back as `N` and `J = j + 1`. -/
theorem hlN_hlQuery (N j : ℕ) : hlN (hlQuery N j) = N ∧ hlJ (hlQuery N j) = j + 1 := by
  have h := BinArith.uHead_encodeNat N (List.replicate (4 ^ (j + 1)) true)
  have h' := BinArith.uRest_encodeNat N (List.replicate (4 ^ (j + 1)) true)
  have he : BoolCircuit.encodeNat N ++ List.replicate (4 ^ (j + 1)) true = hlQuery N j := by
    simp [BoolCircuit.encodeNat, hlQuery]
  rw [he] at h h'
  refine ⟨by simp [hlN, h], ?_⟩
  simp only [hlJ, h', List.length_replicate]
  exact Nat.log_pow (by norm_num) _

/-- On the query with `N = A_j`, membership is the digit `h_j`. -/
theorem hlQuery_mem_iff (j : ℕ) : hlQuery (haltPrefix j) j ∈ haltLang ↔ haltDigit j := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hlN_hlQuery (haltPrefix j) j
  show 1 ≤ hlJ _ ∧ hlN _ = haltPrefix (hlJ _ - 1) ∧ haltDigit (hlJ _ - 1) ↔ _
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp

/-- **[AB09, Exercise 7.5], undecidability**: `L` is not computable.

**Proof sketch.** From a decision procedure for `L`, compute `A_j` by the recursion
`A_{j+1} = 4A_j + [hlQuery A_j j ∈ L]` (`Computable.nat_rec`), and then `h_j` as
`[hlQuery A_j j ∈ L]` (`hlQuery_mem_iff`): the halting digits would be computable. -/
theorem not_computablePred_haltLang : ¬ ComputablePred (· ∈ haltLang) := by
  rintro ⟨D, hD⟩
  have hrep : Computable fun n : ℕ => List.replicate n true := by
    refine (Computable.nat_rec (g := fun _ => ([] : List Bool))
      (h := fun _ p => true :: p.2) Computable.id (Computable.const [])
      (Computable.list_cons.comp (Computable.const true)
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂).of_eq fun n => ?_
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      calc _ = true :: List.replicate n true := by rw [← ih]; rfl
        _ = _ := rfl
  have hpow : Computable fun j : ℕ => 4 ^ (j + 1) := by
    refine (Computable.nat_rec (g := fun _ => 4) (h := fun _ p => 4 * p.2) Computable.id
      (Computable.const 4) (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 4)
        (Computable.snd.comp Computable.snd)).to₂).of_eq fun n => ?_
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      calc _ = 4 * 4 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [← ih]; rfl
        _ = _ := by ring
  have hq : Computable₂ hlQuery :=
    Primrec.list_append.to_comp.comp (hrep.comp Computable.fst)
      (Computable.list_cons.comp (Computable.const false)
        (hrep.comp (hpow.comp Computable.snd)))
  let s : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ := fun p => 4 * p.2 + cond (decide (hlQuery p.2 p.1 ∈ haltLang)) 1 0
  have hs : Computable s :=
    Primrec.nat_add.to_comp.comp
      (Primrec.nat_mul.to_comp.comp (Computable.const 4) Computable.snd)
      (Computable.cond (hD.comp (hq.comp Computable.snd Computable.fst))
        (Computable.const 1) (Computable.const 0))
  have hA : Computable haltPrefix := by
    refine (Computable.nat_rec (g := fun _ => 0) (h := fun _ p => s p) Computable.id
      (Computable.const 0) (hs.comp Computable.snd).to₂).of_eq fun n => ?_
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      calc _ = s (n, haltPrefix n) := by rw [← ih]; rfl
        _ = haltPrefix (n + 1) := by
          show 4 * haltPrefix n + _ = 4 * haltPrefix n + haltBit n
          congr 1
          by_cases h : haltDigit n
          · have := (hlQuery_mem_iff n).mpr h
            simp [haltBit, h, this]
          · have := mt (hlQuery_mem_iff n).mp h
            simp [haltBit, h, this]
  exact not_computablePred_haltDigit (ComputablePred.of_eq
    ⟨fun j => D _, hD.comp (hq.comp hA Computable.id)⟩ hlQuery_mem_iff)

/-! ### The verifier -/

/-- The precision `D = 4^J` of an input. -/
def hlD (x : List Bool) : ℕ := 4 ^ hlJ x

/-- [AB09, Exercise 7.5]: with `c` ones among the `k` coins `r`, accept iff
`(c/k)·D ∈ (4N + 2/3, 4N + 2)`, i.e. `k(12N + 2) < 3cD` and `cD < k(4N + 2)`. -/
def haltCoinVerifier (x r : List Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (r.length * (12 * hlN x + 2) < r.count true * (hlD x * 3)) &&
    decide (r.count true * hlD x < r.length * (4 * hlN x + 2))

/-- **The verifier is right on a good estimate**: if `k > 0` and the fraction of ones is within
`1/(4D)` of `ρ`, the verifier answers `x ∈ L`.

**Proof sketch.** The estimate `e = (c/k)·D` is within `1/4` of `Dρ`. On members `Dρ ∈
[4N + 1, 4N + 4/3]`, so `e ∈ (4N + 2/3, 4N + 2)`; on non-members `Dρ ≤ 4N + 1/3` or
`Dρ ≥ 4N + 4` (`haltCoin_mul_pow_hlJ`), so `e` is outside. -/
theorem haltCoinVerifier_eq {x r : List Bool} (hk : 0 < r.length)
    (he : |(r.count true : ℝ) / r.length - haltCoin| ≤ 1 / (4 * hlD x)) :
    haltCoinVerifier x r = MultiTapeTM.indicator (haltLang : Set (List Bool)) x := by
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < r.length := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < hlD x := by unfold hlD; positivity
  have hρ : haltCoin * (hlD x : ℝ) = haltCoin * 4 ^ hlJ x := by simp [hlD]
  have hest : |(r.count true : ℝ) * hlD x / r.length - haltCoin * hlD x| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have : (r.count true : ℝ) * hlD x / r.length - haltCoin * hlD x =
        ((r.count true : ℝ) / r.length - haltCoin) * hlD x := by ring
    rw [this, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hD0]
    calc |(r.count true : ℝ) / r.length - haltCoin| * hlD x ≤ 1 / (4 * hlD x) * hlD x :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he hD0.le
      _ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp
  generalize hE : (r.count true : ℝ) * hlD x / r.length = e at hest
  rw [abs_le] at hest
  have t1 : (r.length * (12 * hlN x + 2) < r.count true * (hlD x * 3)) ↔
      4 * (hlN x : ℝ) + 2 / 3 < e := by
    rw [← hE, lt_div_iff₀ hk0, ← @Nat.cast_lt ℝ]
    push_cast
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  have t2 : (r.count true * hlD x < r.length * (4 * hlN x + 2)) ↔ e < 4 * (hlN x : ℝ) + 2 := by
    rw [← hE, div_lt_iff₀ hk0, ← @Nat.cast_lt ℝ]
    push_cast
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨hmem, hnot⟩ := haltCoin_mul_pow_hlJ x
  rw [← hρ] at hmem hnot
  by_cases hx : x ∈ haltLang
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hmem hx
    rw [show MultiTapeTM.indicator (haltLang : Set (List Bool)) x = true from
      indicator_eq_true_iff.mpr hx, haltCoinVerifier, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff,
      decide_eq_true_iff, t1, t2]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [show MultiTapeTM.indicator (haltLang : Set (List Bool)) x = false from
      indicator_eq_false_iff.mpr hx, haltCoinVerifier, Bool.and_eq_false_iff,
      decide_eq_false_iff_not, decide_eq_false_iff_not, t1, t2]
    rcases hnot hx with h | h
    · left; linarith
    · right; linarith

/-- The precision is at most `|x| + 1`. -/
theorem hlD_le (x : List Bool) : hlD x ≤ x.length + 1 := by
  have hr := BinArith.length_uRest_le x
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (BinArith.uRest x).length with h | h
  · simp [hlD, hlJ, h]
  · have := Nat.pow_log_le_self 4 h.ne'
    simp only [hlD, hlJ]; omega

/-- **The verifier errs with probability `< 1/3`** over `32(n+1)²` `ρ`-coins.

**Proof sketch.** With `k = 32(n+1)² ≥ 32D²` coins, Hoeffding (`biasedProb_count_dev_le`) bounds
the probability that the fraction of ones is more than `1/(4D)` from `ρ` by
`2e^{-2k/(16D²)} ≤ 2e^{-4} < 1/3`; otherwise the verifier is right (`haltCoinVerifier_eq`). -/
theorem haltCoinVerifier_prob (x : List Bool) :
    2 / 3 ≤ biasedProb haltCoin (polyLen 32 2 x.length)
      fun u => haltCoinVerifier x u = MultiTapeTM.indicator (haltLang : Set (List Bool)) x := by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := haltCoin_mem
  have hk : 0 < polyLen 32 2 x.length := by unfold polyLen; positivity
  have hkR : ((polyLen 32 2 x.length : ℕ) : ℝ) = 32 * ((x.length : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    unfold polyLen; push_cast; ring
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < hlD x := by unfold hlD; positivity
  have hDx : (hlD x : ℝ) ≤ x.length + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlD_le x
  have hp : (⟨haltCoin, h0⟩ : ℝ≥0) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, NNReal.coe_mk, NNReal.coe_one]; linarith
  have hbad := biasedProb_count_dev_le hp hk (δ := 1 / (4 * hlD x)) (by positivity)
  simp only [NNReal.coe_mk] at hbad
  have hexp : 2 * Real.exp (-2 * (1 / (4 * (hlD x : ℝ))) ^ 2 *
      ((polyLen 32 2 x.length : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
    have h2 : -2 * (1 / (4 * (hlD x : ℝ))) ^ 2 * ((polyLen 32 2 x.length : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ -4 := by
      rw [hkR]
      have hsq : (hlD x : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ((x.length : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hD0.le hDx 2
      have hr : -2 * (1 / (4 * (hlD x : ℝ))) ^ 2 * (32 * ((x.length : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) =
          -4 * (((x.length : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / (hlD x : ℝ) ^ 2) := by field_simp; ring
      have h1 : 1 ≤ ((x.length : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / (hlD x : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
      rw [hr]; linarith
    have h6 : (6 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp 2
      rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 + 2 by norm_num, Real.exp_add]
      nlinarith
    have he : Real.exp (-4) ≤ 1 / 6 :=
      calc Real.exp (-4) = (Real.exp 4)⁻¹ := Real.exp_neg 4
        _ ≤ (6 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) h6
        _ = 1 / 6 := by norm_num
    linarith [Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2]
  have hgood : 2 / 3 ≤ biasedProb haltCoin (polyLen 32 2 x.length) (fun w =>
      ¬ (1 / (4 * (hlD x : ℝ)) <
        |(w.count true : ℝ) / (polyLen 32 2 x.length : ℕ) - haltCoin|)) := by
    rw [biasedProb_not]; linarith
  refine hgood.trans (biasedProb_mono h0 (by linarith) fun w hw hgw => ?_)
  rw [not_lt] at hgw
  exact haltCoinVerifier_eq (by omega) (by rw [hw]; exact hgw)

/-! ### The verifier in polynomial time -/

/-- The length test `|snd z| ≤ |fst z|`. -/
def lenLeB (z : List Bool) : Bool := decide ((pairSndD z).length ≤ (pairFstD z).length)

/-- One round of the power-of-`4` loop on `⟨m, d⟩`: replace `d` by `dddd` if that is no longer
than `m`. -/
def pow4Step (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (pairFstD z)
    (if lenLeB (pairEncode (pairFstD z) (pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z))
      then pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z else pairSndD z)

/-- The rounds of the power-of-`4` loop: after `t` rounds `|d| = 4^{min(t, ⌊log₄|m|⌋)}`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `t`, with `J = ⌊log₄|m|⌋`: the round quadruples `d` iff
`4 · 4^{min(t, J)} ≤ |m|`, iff `t < J` (`Nat.le_log_iff_pow_le`), and then
`min(t + 1, J) = min(t, J) + 1`; otherwise `min(t + 1, J) = min(t, J) = J`. -/
theorem iterate_pow4Step (m : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : ∃ w : List Bool,
    pow4Step^[t] (pairEncode m [true]) = pairEncode m w ∧
      w.length = 4 ^ min t (Nat.log 4 m.length) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨[true], rfl, by simp⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hl⟩ := ih
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hw]
    have hiff : 4 * 4 ^ min t (Nat.log 4 m.length) ≤ m.length ↔ t < Nat.log 4 m.length := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m.length with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · rw [← pow_succ', ← Nat.le_log_iff_pow_le (by norm_num) h.ne']
        omega
    by_cases ht : t < Nat.log 4 m.length
    · have h4 := hiff.mpr ht
      refine ⟨w ++ w ++ w ++ w, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hc : lenLeB (pairEncode m (w ++ w ++ w ++ w)) = true := by
          simp only [lenLeB, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, List.length_append, hl,
            decide_eq_true_iff]
          omega
        simp only [pow4Step, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, hc, if_true]
      · simp only [List.length_append, hl, show min (t + 1) (Nat.log 4 m.length) =
          min t (Nat.log 4 m.length) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
        ring
    · have h4 := mt hiff.mp ht
      refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hc : lenLeB (pairEncode m (w ++ w ++ w ++ w)) = false := by
          simp only [lenLeB, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, List.length_append, hl,
            decide_eq_false_iff_not]
          omega
        simp only [pow4Step, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, hc]
        rfl
      · rw [hl]; congr 1; omega

/-- The word of length `D = 4^J` computed from `x`. -/
def hlDWord (x : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairSndD (pairSndD (BinArith.forLoop pow4Step
    (pairEncode (BinArith.uRest x) (pairEncode (BinArith.uRest x) [true]))))

/-- `|hlDWord x| = D`. -/
theorem length_hlDWord (x : List Bool) : (hlDWord x).length = hlD x := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hl⟩ := iterate_pow4Step (BinArith.uRest x) (BinArith.uRest x).length
  simp only [hlDWord, BinArith.forLoop_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, hw, hl, hlD, hlJ]
  rw [min_eq_right (Nat.log_le_self _ _)]

/-- The ones of a word. -/
def onesW (w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  transduce (σ := Unit) (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ b => if b then some true else none) () w

/-- `|onesW w|` is the number of ones of `w`. -/
theorem length_onesW (w : List Bool) : (onesW w).length = w.count true := by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    simp only [onesW, transduce] at ih ⊢
    cases b <;> simp [ih]

/-- `|r| · (nN + 2)` in unary on `⟨x, r⟩`, with `N = |uHead x|`. -/
def hcLin (n : ℕ) (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (pairSndD z)
    (BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (BinArith.uHead (pairFstD z))) ++
      [true, true]))

/-- `c · D` in unary on `⟨x, r⟩`, with `c` the number of ones of `r`. -/
def hcCD (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (onesW (pairSndD z)) (hlDWord (pairFstD z)))

/-- `c · 3D` in unary on `⟨x, r⟩`. -/
def hcCD3 (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (onesW (pairSndD z))
    (BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (hlDWord (pairFstD z)) [true, true, true])))

/-- The verifier on `⟨x, r⟩`, from unary arithmetic: products by `mulU`, comparisons of lengths
by `lenLeB`. -/
def haltCoinTest (z : List Bool) : Bool :=
  !lenLeB (pairEncode (hcLin 12 z) (hcCD3 z)) && !lenLeB (pairEncode (hcCD z) (hcLin 4 z))

/-- The test computes the verifier. -/
theorem haltCoinTest_pairEncode (x r : List Bool) :
    haltCoinTest (pairEncode x r) = haltCoinVerifier x r := by
  simp only [haltCoinTest, hcLin, hcCD, hcCD3, haltCoinVerifier, lenLeB, pairFstD_pairEncode,
    pairSndD_pairEncode, BinArith.length_mulU, List.length_append, List.length_replicate,
    length_onesW, length_hlDWord, hlN, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, ← decide_not,
    Nat.not_le]

/-- A round of the power-of-`4` loop is polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_pow4Step : PolyTimeComputable pow4Step := by
  have hx : PolyTimeComputable pairFstD := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hr : PolyTimeComputable pairSndD := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
  have hquad : PolyTimeComputable fun z => pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z :=
    ((hr.append hr).append hr).append hr
  have ht : PolyTimeComputable fun z =>
      [lenLeB (pairEncode (pairFstD z) (pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z ++ pairSndD z))] :=
    polyTimeComputable_lenLe.comp (hx.pairEncode hquad)
  exact hx.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_ite ht hquad hr)

/-- The word of length `D` is computed in polynomial time.

**Proof sketch.** The counted loop `BinArith.forLoop` of `pow4Step` keeps its context `m`, and a
round replaces `d` by `dddd` only when that is no longer than `m`, so it adds at most `|m|`
letters (`forLoop_bound_of_ctx`). -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_hlDWord : PolyTimeComputable fun z => hlDWord (pairFstD z) := by
  have hloop := BinArith.polyTimeComputable_forLoop polyTimeComputable_pow4Step _ _
    (BinArith.forLoop_bound_of_ctx 2 (fun d => by simp only [pow4Step, pairFstD_pairEncode])
      fun d => by
        have h1 := length_pair_components_le d
        have h2 : (pow4Step d).length ≤ 2 * (pairFstD d).length + 2 + ((pairSndD d).length +
            (pairFstD d).length) := by
          unfold pow4Step
          rw [length_pairEncode]
          split_ifs with h
          · simp only [lenLeB, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
            omega
          · omega
        omega)
  have hu : PolyTimeComputable fun z => BinArith.uRest (pairFstD z) :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_uRest.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  exact BinArith.polyTimeComputable_slot3.comp
    (hloop.comp (hu.pairEncode (hu.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const [true]))))

/-- The unary products of the test are polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_hcLin (n : ℕ) : PolyTimeComputable (hcLin n) := by
  have hN : PolyTimeComputable fun z => BinArith.uHead (pairFstD z) :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_uHead polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hm : PolyTimeComputable fun z =>
      BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (BinArith.uHead (pairFstD z))) :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_mulU
      ((polyTimeComputable_const _).pairEncode hN)
  have hp : PolyTimeComputable fun z => pairEncode (pairSndD z)
      (BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (BinArith.uHead (pairFstD z))) ++
        [true, true]) :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.pairEncode (hm.append (polyTimeComputable_const _))
  unfold hcLin
  exact BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_mulU hp

/-- The ones of the coins, as a function of `⟨x, r⟩`, are polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_onesW_snd : PolyTimeComputable fun z => onesW (pairSndD z) :=
  BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app (polyTimeComputable_transduce _ _ _) polyTimeComputable_pairSndD

/-- `c · D` is polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_hcCD : PolyTimeComputable hcCD := by
  have hp : PolyTimeComputable fun z => pairEncode (onesW (pairSndD z)) (hlDWord (pairFstD z)) :=
    polyTimeComputable_onesW_snd.pairEncode polyTimeComputable_hlDWord
  unfold hcCD
  exact BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_mulU hp

/-- `c · 3D` is polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_hcCD3 : PolyTimeComputable hcCD3 := by
  have h3 : PolyTimeComputable fun z =>
      BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (hlDWord (pairFstD z)) [true, true, true]) :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_mulU
      (polyTimeComputable_hlDWord.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const _))
  have hp : PolyTimeComputable fun z => pairEncode (onesW (pairSndD z))
      (BinArith.mulU (pairEncode (hlDWord (pairFstD z)) [true, true, true])) :=
    polyTimeComputable_onesW_snd.pairEncode h3
  unfold hcCD3
  exact BinArith.polyTimeComputable_app BinArith.polyTimeComputable_mulU hp

/-- The test is polynomial-time: unary products, length tests and Boolean connectives. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_haltCoinTest : PolyTimeComputable fun z => [haltCoinTest z] := by
  have t1 : PolyTimeComputable fun z => [lenLeB (pairEncode (hcLin 12 z) (hcCD3 z))] :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_test_app (p := lenLeB) polyTimeComputable_lenLe
      ((polyTimeComputable_hcLin 12).pairEncode polyTimeComputable_hcCD3)
  have t2 : PolyTimeComputable fun z => [lenLeB (pairEncode (hcCD z) (hcLin 4 z))] :=
    BinArith.polyTimeComputable_test_app (p := lenLeB) polyTimeComputable_lenLe
      (polyTimeComputable_hcCD.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_hcLin 4))
  exact polyTimeComputable_and (polyTimeComputable_not t1) (polyTimeComputable_not t2)

/-- The verifier is polynomial-time. -/
theorem eff_haltCoinVerifier : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier haltCoinVerifier) :=
  eff_boolVerifier_of_test polyTimeComputable_haltCoinTest haltCoinTest_pairEncode

/-! ### Exercise 7.5 -/

/-- `L` is decided with bounded error in polynomial time with a `ρ`-coin. -/
theorem haltLang_mem_biasedBPP : haltLang ∈ biasedBPP haltCoin :=
  mem_biasedBPP_of_eff eff_haltCoinVerifier haltCoinVerifier_prob

/-- **[AB09, Exercise 7.5]**: there is a real `ρ ∈ [0, 1]` such that a polynomial-time PTM with
a `ρ`-coin decides an undecidable language with bounded error. -/
theorem exists_biasedBPP_not_computablePred : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 ∧ ∃ L : Language Bool,
    ¬ ComputablePred (· ∈ L) ∧ L ∈ biasedBPP ρ :=
  ⟨haltCoin, haltCoin_mem.1, haltCoin_mem.2.trans (by norm_num), haltLang,
    not_computablePred_haltLang, haltLang_mem_biasedBPP⟩

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.PTM
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.PolyTimeModel
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.Nondeterminism
import TCSlib.Complexity.CookLevin.Hardness
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.KarpLipton
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.MeyerSigmaEXP

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Easy inclusions between randomized and classical classes

The remarks of [AB09, Ch. 7] relating `BPP`, `RP`, `coRP` to `P`, `NP`, `EXP` and `PH`, in the
PTM form (`Randomized.BPP_PTM` etc.) and in the certificate form
(`Randomized.InBPP polyTimeModel` etc.), and the error reduction for `RP` of [AB09, Ex 7.4].

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.InRPWeak`, `Randomized.InRPStrong` — `RP` with acceptance probability
  `(|x|+1)^{-c}`, resp. `1 − 2^{-((|x|+1)^d + 1)}` [AB09, Ex 7.4].

## Main results

* `Randomized.P_subset_BPP_PTM`, `Randomized.inBPP_polyTimeModel_of_mem_P` — `P ⊆ BPP`
  [AB09, p. 126].
* `Randomized.RP_PTM_subset_NP`, `Randomized.mem_NP_of_inRP_polyTimeModel` — `RP ⊆ NP`
  [AB09, p. 131].
* `Randomized.RP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM`, `Randomized.coRP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM`, `Randomized.InRP.inBPP`,
  `Randomized.InCoRP.inBPP`, `Randomized.InCoRP.inBPP_polyTime` — `RP, coRP ⊆ BPP`
  [AB09, p. 132].
* `Randomized.mem_EXP_of_inBPP_polyTimeModel` — `BPP ⊆ EXP` [AB09, p. 126].
* `Randomized.inBPP_polyTimeModel_iff_mem_P_of_P_eq_NP` — `NP = P ⇒ BPP = P` [AB09, p. 135].
* `Randomized.InBPP.of_polyTimeReducible`, `Randomized.InRP.of_polyTimeReducible`,
  `Randomized.InCoRP.of_polyTimeReducible` — `BPP`, `RP`, `coRP` are closed under `≤ₚ`
  (through `Randomized.exists_eff_reducedVerifier`).
* `Randomized.PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_inBPP_SAT3` — `3SAT ∈ BPP ⇒ PH = Σ₂ᵖ` [AB09, p. 135].
* `Randomized.rp_error_reduction` — [AB09, Ex 7.4].

## Divergences

* `BPP ⊆ EXP`, `NP = P ⇒ BPP = P`, the `3SAT` corollary and [AB09, Ex 7.4] (printed for a
  "polynomial-time PTM") are stated for the certificate form; the PTM forms follow from the
  equivalence of [AB09, Defs 7.2 and 7.3] (unit U2).  Moreover `BPP ⊆ EXP` is proved
  through `BPP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ ⊆ EXP` (`sipser_gacs_polyTime`, `Complexity.SigmaP_two_subset_EXP`)
  rather than by enumerating coins.
* [AB09, Ex 7.4] assumes `Pr[accept] ≥ n^{-c}`, which is meaningless at `n = 0`; we assume
  `min (2/3) ((n+1)^{-c})`, implied by the book's bound for `n ≥ 1`, and conclude
  `1 − 2^{-((n+1)^d+1)} ≥ 1 − 2^{-n^d}` (the `InBPPStrong` convention).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

/-- A one-sided-error PTM decider is a nondeterministic decider: every accepting branch is a
certificate. [AB09, p. 131] -/
theorem RDecidesInTime.decidesInTime {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : N.RDecidesInTime L T) : N.DecidesInTime L T := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hin, hout⟩ := h x
  refine ⟨hhalt, ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun ⟨w, hw, _, hacc⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwout⟩ :=
      exists_outputWith_of_outputProb_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hin hx))
    exact ⟨w, hw, hhalt w hw, hwout⟩
  · by_contra hx
    have hf : N.outputWith x w = [false] := hout hx w hw
    exact absurd (hf.symm.trans hacc) (by decide)

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-! ### PTM form -/

/-- `DTIME(T) ⊆ BPTIME(T)`: a deterministic machine is a PTM whose two transition functions
coincide. [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem DTIME_subset_BPTIME (T : ℕ → ℕ) : DTIME T ⊆ BPTIME T := by
  classical
  rintro L ⟨c, M, hM⟩
  refine ⟨c, M.toFinNDTM, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := (M.computesInTime_iff _ _ _).mp (hM x)
  have hrun : ∀ w : List Bool, M.toFinNDTM.tm.runWith w (M.toFinNDTM.tm.initCfg x) =
      M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) w.length := fun w =>
    M.tm.toNDTM_runWith w (M.tm.initCfg x)
  refine ⟨fun w hw => by rw [hrun, hw]; exact hhalt, ?_⟩
  rw [FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_one fun w hw => by
    rw [FinNDTM.outputWith, hrun, hw]; exact hout]
  norm_num

/-- **`P ⊆ BPP`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem P_subset_BPP_PTM : P ⊆ BPP_PTM :=
  Set.iUnion_mono fun _ => DTIME_subset_BPTIME _

/-- `RTIME(T) ⊆ NTIME(T)`. [AB09, p. 131] -/
theorem RTIME_subset_NTIME (T : ℕ → ℕ) : RTIME T ⊆ NTIME T := by
  rintro L ⟨c, N, hN⟩
  exact ⟨c, N, hN.decidesInTime⟩

/-- **`RP ⊆ NP`** (PTM form): every accepting branch is a certificate. [AB09, p. 131] -/
theorem RP_PTM_subset_NP : RP_PTM ⊆ NP := by
  rw [NP_eq_iUnion_NTIME]
  exact Set.iUnion_mono fun _ => RTIME_subset_NTIME _

/-- **`RP ⊆ BPP`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 132] -/
theorem RP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM : RP_PTM ⊆ BPP_PTM :=
  Set.iUnion_mono fun _ => RTIME_subset_BPTIME _

/-- **`coRP ⊆ BPP`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 132] -/
theorem coRP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM : coRP_PTM ⊆ BPP_PTM := by
  intro L hL
  have h := compl_mem_BPP_PTM (RP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM hL)
  rwa [compl_compl] at h

/-! ### Certificate form -/

/-- **`RP ⊆ BPP`** (certificate form): an `RP` verifier never errs on non-members. [AB09, p. 132] -/
theorem InRP.inBPP {E : VerifierModel} {L : Language Bool} (h : InRP E L) : InBPP E L := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hL⟩ := h
  refine ⟨M, a, k, hM, fun x => ⟨(hL x).1, fun hx => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [randProb_congr (B := fun _ => True) fun r => by simp [(hL x).2 hx r], randProb_true]
  norm_num

/-- **`coRP ⊆ BPP`** (certificate form), for a model closed under negation. [AB09, p. 132] -/
theorem InCoRP.inBPP {E : VerifierModel} (hNot : ClosedUnderNot E) {L : Language Bool}
    (h : InCoRP E L) : InBPP E L := by
  have h' := InBPP.compl E hNot (InRP.inBPP h)
  rwa [compl_compl] at h'

/-- **`coRP ⊆ BPP`** for polynomial-time verifiers (certificate form). [AB09, p. 132] -/
theorem InCoRP.inBPP_polyTime {L : Language Bool} (h : InCoRP polyTimeModel L) :
    InBPP polyTimeModel L :=
  InCoRP.inBPP polyTimeModel_closedUnderNot h

/-- **`P ⊆ BPP`** (certificate form): the verifier `M(x, r) = L(x)` ignores its coins.
[AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem inBPP_polyTimeModel_of_mem_P {L : Language Bool} (hL : L ∈ P) :
    InBPP polyTimeModel L := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x _ => decide (x ∈ L), 0, 0,
    ⟨pairFstD ⁻¹' L, pairFstD ⁻¹' Lᶜ, preimage_mem_P hL polyTimeComputable_pairFstD,
      preimage_mem_P (compl_mem_P hL) polyTimeComputable_pairFstD, fun x r => ?_⟩,
    fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩⟩
  · show (_ ↔ pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ L) ∧
      (_ ↔ pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ Lᶜ)
    simp only [boolVerifier, pairFstD_pairEncode, Option.some.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq,
      decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    constructor
    all_goals trivial
  · rw [randProb_congr (B := fun _ => True) fun r => by simp [hx], randProb_true]
    norm_num
  · rw [randProb_congr (B := fun _ => True) fun r => by simp [hx], randProb_true]
    norm_num

/-- **`RP ⊆ NP`** (certificate form): an accepted random string is a certificate.
[AB09, p. 131]

**Proof sketch.** The `NP` verifier accepts `⟨x, u⟩` iff the `RP` verifier accepts `(x, u)` and
`|u| = polyLen a k |x|`; it is in `P` by `inter_mem_P` and `lenEq_preimage_mem_P`.  Members
have an accepted random string since acceptance has probability `≥ 2/3 > 0`
(`exists_ofFn_of_randProb_pos`); conversely an accepted `u` of the right length is a random
string (`exists_ofFn_eq`), so soundness of the `RP` verifier forces `x ∈ L`. -/
theorem mem_NP_of_inRP_polyTimeModel {L : Language Bool} (h : InRP polyTimeModel L) :
    L ∈ NP := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, ⟨V₁, V₀, hV₁, -, hM⟩, hL⟩ := h
  have hlen : {z : List Bool | (pairSndD z).length =
      (((fun y : List Bool => List.replicate (a * (y.length + 1) ^ k) true) ∘ pairFstD) z).length}
      ∈ P :=
    lenEq_preimage_mem_P polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
      ((polyTimeComputable_polyUnary a k).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD)
  refine mem_NP_iff_exists_length_le.mpr ⟨a, k, _, inter_mem_P hV₁ hlen, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hMt : ∀ u, M x u = true ↔ Turing.pairEncode x u ∈ V₁ := fun u => by
    simpa only [boolVerifier, Option.some.injEq] using (hM x u).1
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_ofFn_of_randProb_pos
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) ((hL x).1 hx))
    refine ⟨List.ofFn r, by simp [polyLen], (hMt _).mp hr, ?_⟩
    show (pairSndD (Turing.pairEncode x (List.ofFn r))).length =
      (List.replicate _ true).length
    simp [polyLen]
  · rintro ⟨u, -, hu, hlenu⟩
    have hlenu' : u.length = polyLen a k x.length := by
      change (pairSndD (Turing.pairEncode x u)).length =
        (List.replicate (a * ((pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x u)).length + 1) ^ k) true).length
        at hlenu
      simpa [polyLen] using hlenu
    by_contra hx
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := exists_ofFn_eq hlenu'
    have := (hL x).2 hx r
    rw [(hMt _).mpr hu] at this
    exact absurd this (by decide)

/-- **`BPP ⊆ EXP`** (certificate form). [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem mem_EXP_of_inBPP_polyTimeModel {L : Language Bool} (h : InBPP polyTimeModel L) :
    L ∈ EXP :=
  SigmaP_two_subset_EXP (sipser_gacs_polyTime h).1

/-- **`NP = P ⇒ BPP = P`** (certificate form), via `BPP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ` and the collapse `PH = P`.
[AB09, p. 135 and p. 140] -/
theorem inBPP_polyTimeModel_iff_mem_P_of_P_eq_NP (h : P = NP) (L : Language Bool) :
    InBPP polyTimeModel L ↔ L ∈ P := by
  refine ⟨fun hL => ?_, inBPP_polyTimeModel_of_mem_P⟩
  rw [← PH_eq_P_of_P_eq_NP h]
  exact SigmaP_subset_PH 2 (sipser_gacs_polyTime hL).1

/-- **The reduced verifier**: for a polynomial-time `f` and an efficient verifier `M` drawing
`polyLen a k` coins, running `M` on `f x` with the matching prefix of the coins is an efficient
verifier, and some polynomial schedule in `|x|` dominates the schedule in `|f x|`.

**Proof sketch.** The new verifier's answer sets are preimages of the old ones under the
polynomial-time map `⟨x, r⟩ ↦ ⟨f x, r'⟩` (`sliceTake`); `|f x|` is polynomial in `|x|`
(`PolyTimeComputable.output_length_le`), which bounds the schedule. -/
theorem exists_eff_reducedVerifier {f : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : PolyTimeComputable f)
    {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {a k : ℕ} (hM : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M)) :
    ∃ a' k', polyTimeModel.Eff
        (boolVerifier fun x r => M (f x) (r.take (polyLen a k (f x).length))) ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, polyLen a k (f x).length ≤ polyLen a' k' x.length := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, c, hC⟩ := hf.output_length_le
  obtain ⟨V₁, V₀, hV₁, hV₀, hM⟩ := hM
  let g : List Bool → List Bool := fun z =>
    sliceTake a k (Turing.pairEncode (f (pairFstD z)) (pairSndD z))
  have hg : PolyTimeComputable g := (polyTimeComputable_sliceTake a k).comp
    ((hf.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD).pairEncode polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
  have hgx : ∀ x r, g (Turing.pairEncode x r) =
      Turing.pairEncode (f x) (r.take (polyLen a k (f x).length)) := by
    intro x r
    simp [g, sliceTake]
  refine ⟨a * (C + 1) ^ k, c * k,
    ⟨g ⁻¹' V₁, g ⁻¹' V₀, preimage_mem_P hV₁ hg, preimage_mem_P hV₀ hg, fun x r => ?_⟩,
    fun x => ?_⟩
  · show (_ ↔ g (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ V₁) ∧ (_ ↔ g (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ V₀)
    rw [hgx]
    exact hM (f x) _
  · have hp : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
    have h1 : (f x).length + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c := by
      calc (f x).length + 1 ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c + (x.length + 1) ^ c :=
            Nat.add_le_add (hC x) hp
        _ = (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c := by ring
    calc polyLen a k (f x).length = a * ((f x).length + 1) ^ k := rfl
      _ ≤ a * ((C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c) ^ k :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left h1 k)
      _ = polyLen (a * (C + 1) ^ k) (c * k) x.length := by
          unfold polyLen
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          ring

/-- **`BPP` is closed under polynomial-time Karp reductions** (certificate form): if
`L' ≤ₚ L` and `L ∈ BPP` then `L' ∈ BPP`.

**Proof sketch.** Run the verifier of `L` on `f x` with the prefix of the random string it
draws on inputs of length `|f x|` (`exists_eff_reducedVerifier`); padding coins are ignored
(`randProb_take`). -/
theorem InBPP.of_polyTimeReducible {L L' : Language Bool} (hred : L' ≤ₚ L)
    (h : InBPP polyTimeModel L) : InBPP polyTimeModel L' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfL⟩ := hred
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', k', hE, hle⟩ := exists_eff_reducedVerifier (a := a) (k := k) hf hM
  refine ⟨_, a', k', hE, fun x => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ b : Bool, randProb (polyLen a' k' x.length)
      (fun r => M (f x) (r.take (polyLen a k (f x).length)) = b) =
      randProb (polyLen a k (f x).length) (fun s => M (f x) s = b) := fun b =>
    randProb_take (hle x) (fun s => M (f x) s = b)
  rw [key, key]
  exact ⟨fun hx => (hL (f x)).1 ((hfL x).mp hx),
    fun hx => (hL (f x)).2 fun hfx => hx ((hfL x).mpr hfx)⟩

/-- **`RP` is closed under polynomial-time Karp reductions** (certificate form).

**Proof sketch.** As `InBPP.of_polyTimeReducible`; every prefix of a random string is a random
string of its length (`exists_ofFn_eq`), so non-members are never accepted. -/
theorem InRP.of_polyTimeReducible {L L' : Language Bool} (hred : L' ≤ₚ L)
    (h : InRP polyTimeModel L) : InRP polyTimeModel L' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfL⟩ := hred
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', k', hE, hle⟩ := exists_eff_reducedVerifier (a := a) (k := k) hf hM
  refine ⟨_, a', k', hE, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx r => ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [randProb_take (hle x) (fun s => M (f x) s = true)]
    exact (hL (f x)).1 ((hfL x).mp hx)
  · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_ofFn_eq (m := polyLen a k (f x).length)
      (l := (List.ofFn r).take (polyLen a k (f x).length)) (by simp [hle x])
    show M (f x) _ = false
    rw [hr']
    exact (hL (f x)).2 (fun hfx => hx ((hfL x).mpr hfx)) r'

/-- **`coRP` is closed under polynomial-time Karp reductions** (certificate form). -/
theorem InCoRP.of_polyTimeReducible {L L' : Language Bool} (hred : L' ≤ₚ L)
    (h : InCoRP polyTimeModel L) : InCoRP polyTimeModel L' := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfL⟩ := hred
  exact InRP.of_polyTimeReducible (L := Lᶜ) (L' := L'ᶜ)
    ⟨f, hf, fun x => show x ∉ L' ↔ f x ∉ L from not_congr (hfL x)⟩ h

/-- **`3SAT ∈ BPP ⇒ PH = Σ₂ᵖ`**: `NP` would reduce to `BPP ⊆ P/poly` (Adleman), and Karp–Lipton
collapses the hierarchy. [AB09, p. 135, §7.5.1] -/
theorem PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_inBPP_SAT3 (h : InBPP polyTimeModel SAT3) : PH = SigmaP 2 :=
  PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_NP_subset_PPoly fun L hL =>
    (BoolCircuit.mem_PPoly_iff L).mpr
      (adleman_polyTime (InBPP.of_polyTimeReducible (SAT3_NPHard L hL) h))

/-! ### Error reduction for `RP` -/

variable (E : VerifierModel)

/-- `L ∈ RP` with acceptance probability only `min (2/3) ((|x|+1)^{-c})` on members (and never
accepting non-members). [AB09, Ex 7.4] -/
def InRPWeak (c : ℕ) (L : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (a k : ℕ),
    E.Eff (boolVerifier M) ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      (x ∈ L → min (2/3) (((x.length + 1 : ℚ) ^ c)⁻¹) ≤
        randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => M x r = true) ∧
      (x ∉ L → ∀ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool, M x (List.ofFn r) = false)

/-- `L ∈ RP` with acceptance probability at least `1 − 2^{-((|x|+1)^d + 1)}` on members.
[AB09, Ex 7.4] -/
def InRPStrong (d : ℕ) (L : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (a k : ℕ),
    E.Eff (boolVerifier M) ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      (x ∈ L → 1 - (1/2 : ℚ) ^ ((x.length + 1) ^ d + 1) ≤
        randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => M x r = true) ∧
      (x ∉ L → ∀ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool, M x (List.ofFn r) = false)

/-- The amplified form implies plain `RP` membership with the same verifier. -/
theorem InRPStrong.toInRP {d : ℕ} {L : Language Bool} (hL : InRPStrong E d L) : InRP E L := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hprop⟩ := hL
  refine ⟨M, a, k, hM, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, (hprop x).2⟩⟩
  have he : 2 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ d + 1 := by
    have := Nat.one_le_pow d (x.length + 1) (by omega)
    omega
  have h2 : (1/2 : ℚ) ^ ((x.length + 1) ^ d + 1) ≤ (1/2 : ℚ) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) he
  norm_num at h2
  linarith [(hprop x).1 hx]

/-- Plain `RP` membership implies the weak form, since the weak threshold is at most `2/3`. -/
theorem InRP.toInRPWeak (c : ℕ) {L : Language Bool} (hL : InRP E L) : InRPWeak E c L := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hprop⟩ := hL
  exact ⟨M, a, k, hM, fun x =>
    ⟨fun hx => (min_le_left _ _).trans ((hprop x).1 hx), (hprop x).2⟩⟩

/-- **Error reduction for `RP`** ([AB09, Ex 7.4]): acceptance probability
`min (2/3) ((|x|+1)^{-c})` amplifies to `1 − 2^{-((|x|+1)^d + 1)}` for every `d`, for a model
closed under polynomial `OR`-repetition.

**Proof sketch.** Run the weak verifier on `K = 4(n+1)^{c+d}` independent blocks and accept if
any block accepts (`anyVerifier`).  Non-members are never accepted, since every block is a
genuine random string of the old length.  For members, the run rejects exactly when the vote
count is `0`, which has probability `(1 − s)^K` (`randProb_blockCount`) where `s ≥
(2/3)(n+1)^{-c}` is the single-run acceptance probability; since `2(n+1)^c · s ≥ 1` and
`2(n+1)^c((n+1)^d + 1) ≤ K`, `one_sub_pow_le_half_pow` bounds it by `2^{-((n+1)^d+1)}`. -/
theorem rp_error_reduction (hAny : ClosedUnderAny E) {c : ℕ} {L : Language Bool}
    (hL : InRPWeak E c L) (d : ℕ) : InRPStrong E d L := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hprop⟩ := hL
  refine ⟨anyVerifier M (polyLen a k) (polyLen 4 (c + d)), 4 * a, c + d + k,
    hAny M a k 4 (c + d) hM, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hlen : polyLen (4 * a) (c + d + k) x.length =
      polyLen 4 (c + d) x.length * polyLen a k x.length := by
    unfold polyLen
    ring
  rw [hlen]
  set q := polyLen a k x.length with hq
  set K := polyLen 4 (c + d) x.length with hK
  constructor
  · intro hx
    set s := randProb q (fun l => M x l = true) with hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := randProb_nonneg
    have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := randProb_le_one
    -- rejection is a zero vote count, of probability `(1 - s)^K`
    have hacc : randProb (K * q)
        (fun l => anyVerifier M (polyLen a k) (polyLen 4 (c + d)) x l = true) =
        1 - (1 - s) ^ K := by
      have h0 := randProb_blockCount q (M x) K 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, one_mul,
        Nat.sub_zero] at h0
      rw [randProb_congr (B := fun l => ¬ (blockCount q K (M x) l = 0)) fun r => by
        simp only [anyVerifier, blockCount, List.any_eq_true, ← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero,
          List.countP_pos_iff, hq, hK], randProb_not, h0]
    -- the amplification arithmetic
    set y : ℚ := (x.length + 1 : ℚ) ^ c with hy
    have hy1 : 1 ≤ y := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg x.length : (0:ℚ) ≤ _)])
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by linarith
    have hyinv : y⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hy1
    have hmin : 2/3 * y⁻¹ ≤ s :=
      (le_min (by nlinarith [inv_nonneg.mpr hy0.le]) (by nlinarith [inv_nonneg.mpr hy0.le])).trans
        ((hprop x).1 hx)
    have hm : 1 ≤ ((2 * (x.length + 1) ^ c : ℕ) : ℚ) * s := by
      push_cast
      rw [← hy]
      have : 2 * y * (2/3 * y⁻¹) = 4/3 := by field_simp; ring
      nlinarith
    have he : 2 * (x.length + 1) ^ c * ((x.length + 1) ^ d + 1) ≤ K := by
      have hP : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
      have hQ : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ d := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
      rw [hK]
      unfold polyLen
      rw [pow_add]
      nlinarith
    have hpow := one_sub_pow_le_half_pow hs0 hs1 hm he
    rw [hacc]
    linarith
  · intro hx r
    have hl : (List.ofFn r).length = K * q := List.length_ofFn
    unfold anyVerifier
    rw [List.any_eq_false]
    intro i hi
    rw [List.mem_range, ← hK] at hi
    have hiq : i * q + q ≤ K * q := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
      rwa [Nat.succ_mul] at this
    have hb : (((List.ofFn r).drop (i * q)).take q).length = q := by
      rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop, hl]
      omega
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := exists_ofFn_eq hb
    rw [← hq, hr', (hprop x).2 hx r']
    decide

/-- `RP_{n^{-c}} = RP`: the acceptance threshold `2/3` of `RP` may be lowered to an inverse
polynomial. [AB09, p. 133 and Ex 7.4] -/
theorem inRPWeak_iff_inRP (hAny : ClosedUnderAny E) (c : ℕ) (L : Language Bool) :
    InRPWeak E c L ↔ InRP E L :=
  ⟨fun h => (rp_error_reduction E hAny h 0).toInRP E, InRP.toInRPWeak E c⟩

/-- **Error reduction for `RP` over polynomial-time verifiers** ([AB09, Ex 7.4]). -/
theorem rp_error_reduction_polyTime {c : ℕ} {L : Language Bool}
    (hL : InRPWeak polyTimeModel c L) (d : ℕ) : InRPStrong polyTimeModel d L :=
  rp_error_reduction polyTimeModel polyTimeModel_closedUnderAny hL d

end Randomized
