import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.MatchingMath
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Primality

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Bipartite perfect matching is in `RP`

The class half of [AB09, §7.2.4]: Lovász's test is a polynomial-time verifier, so the
language of bipartite graphs with a perfect matching is in `RP`, hence in `BPP`, both in the
certificate form over `Randomized.polyTimeModel` and in the PTM form of [AB09, Def 7.2/7.6].
The probability analysis is `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.MatchingMath`; the arithmetic
(the prime, the determinant over `ZMod p`) is `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.BinaryArith`.

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.Matching.encodeBPM`, `Randomized.Matching.BipartitePerfectMatching` — the
  encoding `⟨1ⁿ, row-major n² adjacency bits⟩` and the language.
* `Randomized.Matching.matchingVerifier` — Lovász's test over `ZMod p`.
* `Randomized.Matching.lovaszRows`, `Randomized.Matching.lovaszRowW`,
  `Randomized.Matching.matchingTest` — its word-level implementation (building the matrix
  from blocks cut by `Complexity.BinArith.chunkW`, then `detModAlg`).

## Main results

* `Randomized.Matching.eff_matchingVerifier` — the verifier is polynomial-time.
* `Randomized.Matching.inRP_BipartitePerfectMatching`,
  `Randomized.Matching.inBPP_BipartitePerfectMatching` — certificate form.
* `Randomized.Matching.BipartitePerfectMatching_mem_RP_PTM`,
  `Randomized.Matching.BipartitePerfectMatching_mem_BPP_PTM` — PTM form.

## Divergences

* The graph is the `n × n` Boolean adjacency matrix with `n` in unary, as for `PATH`
  (`Complexity.encodePATH`); words that encode no graph are non-members.
* The determinant is evaluated over `ZMod p` for the least prime `p > 2^k`, `k = ⌈log₂ 2n⌉`
  (`Complexity.BinArith.lovaszPrime`), not over `ℤ`; each entry reads `k` fair coins
  (see `MatchingMath`). The verifier also rejects coin words shorter than `n²k`.
* One round has success probability `≥ 1/2`; membership in `RP` (threshold `2/3`) uses the
  error reduction of [AB09, Ex 7.4] (`Randomized.inRPWeak_iff_inRP`).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized.Matching

open Complexity Turing
open Complexity.LogProg (bitsVal bitsVal_bits)
open Complexity.BinArith (eqW eqW_pairEncode polyTimeComputable_eqW mulU length_mulU
  polyTimeComputable_mulU chunkW chunkList chunkW_pairEncode polyTimeComputable_chunkW
  lovaszBits lovaszBits_le two_mul_le_two_pow_lovaszBits)

variable {n : ℕ}

/-! ### The language -/

/-- The row-major adjacency word of `A`: `n²` bits, bit `i·n + j` is `A i j`. -/
def adjWord (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) : List Bool :=
  (List.finRange n).flatMap fun i => (List.finRange n).map (A i)

/-- The encoding of the bipartite graph of `A`: `⟨1ⁿ, adjWord A⟩`. -/
def encodeBPM (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (adjWord A)

/-- **Bipartite perfect matching** [AB09, §7.2.4]: the encodings of bipartite graphs with a
perfect matching. -/
def BipartitePerfectMatching : Language Bool :=
  {x | ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool), x = encodeBPM n A ∧ HasPerfectMatching A}

/-- The matrix read off a word: entry `(i, j)` is bit `i·n + j`. -/
def adjOfWord (n : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool :=
  Matrix.of fun i j => w.getD (i * n + j) false

/-- Reading a concatenation of `n`-bit rows at row `i`, column `j`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the list of rows: row `0` is the prefix of length `n`, and
row `i + 1` sits `n` bits further into the word than row `i` of the tail. -/
private theorem getD_adjWord (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) (i j : ℕ) (hi : i < n)
    (hj : j < n) : (adjWord A).getD (i * n + j) false = A ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  unfold adjWord
  suffices h : ∀ (L : List (Fin n)) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < L.length),
      (L.flatMap fun i => (List.finRange n).map (A i)).getD (i * n + j) false = A L[i] ⟨j, hj⟩ by
    rw [h (List.finRange n) i (by simpa using hi)]
    simp
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
  | cons a L ih =>
    intro i hi
    rw [List.flatMap_cons]
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
        List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hj), List.getElem?_map,
        List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa using hj)]
      simp
    | succ i =>
      rw [show (i + 1) * n + j = n + (i * n + j) by rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega,
        List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp),
        List.length_map, List.length_finRange, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
        ← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      exact ih i (by simpa using hi)

/-- `adjWord A` has `n²` bits. -/
theorem length_adjWord (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) : (adjWord A).length = n * n := by
  simp [adjWord, List.length_flatMap, List.sum_replicate]

/-- Decoding inverts encoding. -/
theorem adjOfWord_adjWord (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) : adjOfWord n (adjWord A) = A := by
  ext i j
  exact getD_adjWord A i j i.isLt j.isLt

/-- An `n²`-bit word is the adjacency word of the matrix it encodes. -/
theorem adjWord_adjOfWord {w : List Bool} (hw : w.length = n * n) :
    adjWord (adjOfWord n w) = w := by
  refine List.ext_getElem (by rw [length_adjWord, hw]) fun m h1 h2 => ?_
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp [hw] at h2)
  have hq : m / n < n := by rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn]; omega
  have hm : m = m / n * n + m % n := (Nat.div_add_mod' m n).symm
  have e := getD_adjWord (adjOfWord n w) (m / n) (m % n) hq (Nat.mod_lt _ hn)
  rw [← hm, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h1] at e
  rw [e]
  simp [adjOfWord, ← hm, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h2]

/-- An encoded graph is in the language iff it has a perfect matching. -/
theorem encodeBPM_mem_iff (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) :
    encodeBPM n A ∈ BipartitePerfectMatching ↔ HasPerfectMatching A := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨m, B, h, hB⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨n, A, rfl, h⟩⟩
  have hl := congrArg (fun x => (pairFstD x).length) h
  simp only [encodeBPM, pairFstD_pairEncode, List.length_replicate] at hl
  subst hl
  have hA := congrArg (fun x => adjOfWord n (pairSndD x)) h
  simp only [encodeBPM, pairSndD_pairEncode, adjOfWord_adjWord] at hA
  exact hA ▸ hB

/-! ### The verifier -/

/-- **Lovász's test** [AB09, §7.2.4] on `x = ⟨1ⁿ, A⟩` and coins `r`: check that `x` encodes a
graph and `|r| ≥ n²k`, then accept iff `det X ≠ 0` over `ZMod p` with entry `(i, j)` read off
block `n·i + j` of `k` coins, `k = lovaszBits n`, `p = lovaszPrime n`. -/
noncomputable def matchingVerifier (x r : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let n := (pairFstD x).length
  let A := adjOfWord n (pairSndD x)
  decide (x = encodeBPM n A) && decide (n * n * lovaszBits n ≤ r.length) &&
    decide ((lovaszMatrix A
      (lovaszSample (ZMod (BinArith.lovaszPrime n)) n (lovaszBits n) r)).det ≠ 0)

/-! ### Building the matrix -/

/-- An entry on `⟨q, ⟨a, b⟩⟩`: the value of the coin block `b` if the edge bit `a` is set,
else `0` (in binary). -/
def lovaszEntryW (S : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  if (pairFstD (pairSndD S)).headD false then Nat.bits (bitsVal (pairSndD (pairSndD S))) else []

/-- A row on `⟨K, ⟨a, c⟩⟩`: cut the edge bits `a` into single bits and the coins `c` into
`|K|`-bit blocks, and combine them entrywise. -/
def lovaszRowW (S : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  BinArith.zipWithW lovaszEntryW (pairEncode [] (pairEncode
    (chunkW (pairEncode [true] (pairFstD (pairSndD S))))
    (chunkW (pairEncode (pairFstD S) (pairSndD (pairSndD S))))))

/-- The rows of Lovász's matrix on edge bits `w` and coins `r`, as numbers. -/
def lovaszRows (n k : ℕ) (w r : List Bool) : List (List ℕ) :=
  (List.range n).map fun i => (List.range n).map fun j =>
    if w.getD (i * n + j) false then bitsVal ((r.drop ((n * i + j) * k)).take k) else 0

/-- **The matrix word**: on `⟨K, ⟨rows of w, rows of r⟩⟩` the row loop writes Lovász's
matrix (rows of `n` edge bits, rows of `n·|K|` coins).

**Proof sketch.** `chunkW_pairEncode` lists the `n` rows of `w` and of `r`; `zipWithW` pairs
them row by row. Inside row `i`, cutting again lists the edge bits `w[i·n + j]` and the coin
blocks, which are the `k`-bit blocks `n·i + j` of `r`; `lovaszEntryW` writes their value or `0`. -/
theorem zipWithW_lovaszRowW (K u w NK r : List Bool) (hw : w.length = u.length * u.length)
    (hNK : NK.length = u.length * K.length) (hr : r.length = u.length * NK.length)
    (hK : 0 < K.length ∨ u.length = 0) :
    BinArith.zipWithW lovaszRowW (pairEncode K (pairEncode (chunkW (pairEncode u w))
      (chunkW (pairEncode NK r)))) =
      BinArith.encMat (lovaszRows u.length K.length w r) := by
  set n := u.length
  set k := K.length
  rw [chunkW_pairEncode u w n hw (by omega), chunkW_pairEncode NK r n hr (by
    rcases hK with hK | hK
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [hNK]; positivity)
    · exact Or.inr hK), BinArith.zipWithW_pairEncode, BinArith.decWords_encWords,
    BinArith.decWords_encWords, chunkList, chunkList, List.zipWith_map, List.zipWith_self]
  simp only [BinArith.encMat, lovaszRows, List.map_map]
  refine congrArg BinArith.encWords ?_
  refine List.map_congr_left fun i hi => ?_
  rw [List.mem_range] at hi
  have hrow : ((w.drop (i * n)).take n).length = n * [true].length := by
    simp [List.length_drop, hw]
    have : (i + 1) * n ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
    rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this; omega
  have hcoin : ((r.drop (i * NK.length)).take NK.length).length = n * k := by
    simp [List.length_drop, hr, hNK]
    have : (i + 1) * (n * k) ≤ n * (n * k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
    rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this; omega
  simp only [Function.comp, lovaszRowW, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
  rw [chunkW_pairEncode _ _ n hrow (Or.inl (by simp)), chunkW_pairEncode _ _ n (by rw [hcoin])
    (by omega), BinArith.zipWithW_pairEncode, BinArith.decWords_encWords,
    BinArith.decWords_encWords, chunkList, chunkList, List.zipWith_map, List.zipWith_self]
  simp only [BinArith.encRow, List.map_map]
  refine congrArg BinArith.encWords ?_
  refine List.map_congr_left fun j hj => ?_
  rw [List.mem_range] at hj
  simp only [Function.comp, lovaszEntryW, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
    List.length_cons, List.length_nil, zero_add, mul_one]
  have hbit : (((w.drop (i * n)).take n).drop j).take 1 = [w.getD (i * n + j) false] := by
    have hlt : i * n + j < w.length := by
      rw [hw]; have : (i + 1) * n ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
      rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this; omega
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hlt]
    simp only [List.drop_take, List.drop_drop]
    rw [List.take_take, show min 1 (n - j) = 1 by omega]
    exact List.take_one_drop_eq_of_lt_length hlt
  have hblk : (((r.drop (i * NK.length)).take NK.length).drop (j * k)).take k =
      (r.drop ((n * i + j) * k)).take k := by
    rw [List.drop_take, List.drop_drop, List.take_take, show min k (NK.length - j * k) = k by
      rw [hNK]; have : (j + 1) * k ≤ n * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hj
      rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this; omega, hNK]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [hbit, hblk]
  cases w.getD (i * n + j) false <;> simp [Nat.zero_bits]

/-- The rows have the matrix of Lovász's test, over `ZMod p`. -/
theorem matOfRows_lovaszRows (p k : ℕ) (w r : List Bool) :
    BinArith.matOfRows p n (lovaszRows n k w r) =
      lovaszMatrix (adjOfWord n w) (lovaszSample (ZMod p) n k r) := by
  ext i j
  simp only [BinArith.matOfRows, lovaszRows, lovaszMatrix, lovaszSample, adjOfWord,
    Matrix.of_apply, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range i.isLt,
    List.getElem?_range j.isLt, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
  rw [blockVal, show ((finProdFinEquiv (i, j) : Fin (n * n)) : ℕ) = j + n * i from rfl,
    Nat.add_comm (j : ℕ)]
  split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The row-length hypothesis of `detModAlg_pairEncode` for `lovaszRows`. -/
theorem length_lovaszRows (k : ℕ) (w r : List Bool) :
    (lovaszRows n k w r).length = n ∧ ∀ row ∈ lovaszRows n k w r, row.length = n := by
  simp [lovaszRows]

/-! ### The word-level test -/

/-- The unary `n` of `z = ⟨⟨1ⁿ, w⟩, r⟩`. -/
private def tU (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairFstD z)

/-- The edge bits `w` of `z = ⟨⟨1ⁿ, w⟩, r⟩`. -/
private def tW (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairFstD z)

/-- A word of length `k = lovaszBits n` (the binary `2^k` of `dblLoop`, low bit dropped). -/
private def tK (z : List Bool) : List Bool := (pairFstD (BinArith.dblLoop (tU z))).drop 1

/-- A word of length `n·k`. -/
private def tNK (z : List Bool) : List Bool := mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tK z))

/-- The first `n·n·k` coins. -/
private def tCoins (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  takePrefixByLen (pairEncode (mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tNK z))) (pairSndD z))

/-- `det X mod p` in binary, for Lovász's matrix built from `w` and the coins. -/
private noncomputable def tDet (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  BinArith.detModAlg (pairEncode (Nat.bits (BinArith.lovaszPrime (tU z).length))
    (BinArith.zipWithW lovaszRowW (pairEncode (tK z) (pairEncode (chunkW (pairEncode (tU z) (tW z)))
      (chunkW (pairEncode (tNK z) (tCoins z)))))))

/-- The verifier on `z = ⟨x, r⟩`, assembled from polynomial-time pieces: the well-formedness
of `x`, the coin count, and the nonzero test of the determinant. -/
noncomputable def matchingTest (z : List Bool) : Bool :=
  (eqW (pairEncode (pairFstD z) (pairEncode (List.replicate (tU z).length true) (tW z))) &&
    decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tU z))).length = (tW z).length)) &&
  decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tNK z))).length ≤ (pairSndD z).length) &&
  !decide (bitsVal (tDet z) = 0)

/-- `x` encodes a graph iff it is `⟨1ⁿ, w⟩` with `|w| = n²`. -/
theorem eq_encodeBPM_iff (x : List Bool) :
    x = encodeBPM (pairFstD x).length (adjOfWord (pairFstD x).length (pairSndD x)) ↔
      x = pairEncode (List.replicate (pairFstD x).length true) (pairSndD x) ∧
        (pairFstD x).length * (pairFstD x).length = (pairSndD x).length := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hw : pairSndD x = adjWord (adjOfWord (pairFstD x).length (pairSndD x)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [h]
      simp [encodeBPM]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · conv_lhs => rw [h]
      rw [encodeBPM, ← hw]
    · rw [hw, length_adjWord]
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [encodeBPM, adjWord_adjOfWord h2.symm]
    exact h1

/-- The implementation computes the verifier.

**Proof sketch.** The first two tests decide `x = ⟨1ⁿ, w⟩ ∧ |w| = n²`, i.e. that `x` encodes
`adjOfWord n w` (`eq_encodeBPM_iff`); the third is the coin count. Under both, the row loop
writes `lovaszRows` (`zipWithW_lovaszRowW`, with blocks of `n`, `n·k`, `1` and `k` bits),
`detModAlg_pairEncode` returns `(det M).val` for the prime `p`, `M` is Lovász's matrix on the
first `n²k` coins (`matOfRows_lovaszRows`), and those are all the coins it reads
(`lovaszSample_take`). -/
theorem matchingTest_pairEncode (x r : List Bool) :
    matchingTest (pairEncode x r) = matchingVerifier x r := by
  set n := (pairFstD x).length with hn
  set w := pairSndD x with hw
  set k := lovaszBits n with hk
  have hU : tU (pairEncode x r) = pairFstD x := by simp [tU]
  have hW : tW (pairEncode x r) = w := by simp [tW, hw]
  have hK : (tK (pairEncode x r)).length = k := by
    simp [tK, hU, BinArith.dblLoop_spec, hk, lovaszBits, hn]
  have hNK : (tNK (pairEncode x r)).length = n * k := by simp [tNK, length_mulU, hK, hU, hn]
  have hwf : (eqW (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairEncode x r)) (pairEncode
      (List.replicate (tU (pairEncode x r)).length true) (tW (pairEncode x r)))) &&
      decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU (pairEncode x r)) (tU (pairEncode x r)))).length =
        (tW (pairEncode x r)).length)) = decide (x = encodeBPM n (adjOfWord n w)) := by
    rw [eqW_pairEncode, length_mulU, hU, hW, pairFstD_pairEncode, Bool.eq_iff_iff]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact (eq_encodeBPM_iff x).symm
  have hlen : decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU (pairEncode x r)) (tNK (pairEncode x r)))).length ≤
      (pairSndD (pairEncode x r)).length) = decide (n * n * k ≤ r.length) := by
    rw [length_mulU, hNK, hU, ← hn, pairSndD_pairEncode, Nat.mul_assoc]
  unfold matchingTest
  rw [hwf, hlen]
  show _ = (decide (x = encodeBPM n (adjOfWord n w)) && decide (n * n * k ≤ r.length) &&
    decide ((lovaszMatrix (adjOfWord n w)
      (lovaszSample (ZMod (BinArith.lovaszPrime n)) n k r)).det ≠ 0))
  by_cases h1 : x = encodeBPM n (adjOfWord n w)
  · by_cases h2 : n * n * k ≤ r.length
    · have hwn : w.length = n * n := ((eq_encodeBPM_iff x).1 h1).2.symm
      haveI : Fact (BinArith.lovaszPrime n).Prime := ⟨BinArith.lovaszPrime_prime n⟩
      have hC : tCoins (pairEncode x r) = r.take (n * (n * k)) := by
        simp [tCoins, takePrefixByLen, length_mulU, hNK, hU, hn]
      have hrows := zipWithW_lovaszRowW (tK (pairEncode x r)) (pairFstD x) w (tNK (pairEncode x r))
        (r.take (n * (n * k))) hwn (by rw [hNK, hK]) (by
          rw [List.length_take, hNK, ← hn, min_eq_left (by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]; exact h2)])
        (by
          rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
          · exact Or.inr h
          · exact Or.inl (by rw [hK]; exact Nat.clog_pos one_lt_two (by omega)))
      rw [← hn, hK] at hrows
      obtain ⟨hl, hsq⟩ := length_lovaszRows (n := n) k w (r.take (n * (n * k)))
      have hdet : tDet (pairEncode x r) = Nat.bits (lovaszMatrix (adjOfWord n w)
          (lovaszSample (ZMod (BinArith.lovaszPrime n)) n k r)).det.val := by
        rw [tDet, hC, hU, hW, hrows, BinArith.detModAlg_pairEncode _ _ (by rw [hl]; exact hsq),
          hl, matOfRows_lovaszRows, lovaszSample_take _ n k (by rw [Nat.mul_assoc])]
      rw [hdet, bitsVal_bits, decide_eq_true h1, decide_eq_true h2]
      simp [ZMod.val_eq_zero]
    · rw [decide_eq_false h2]
      simp
  · rw [decide_eq_false h1]
    simp

/-- The implementation is polynomial-time.

**Proof sketch.** Every piece is a composition of the closure kit: projections, `dblLoop`,
unary multiplication and cutting (counted loops, `Complexity.BinArith.forLoop`), the prefix
operations, the loops `zipWithW`, the prime finder, `detModAlg`, the zero test and the length
tests. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_matchingTest : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [matchingTest z]) := by
  have hU : PolyTimeComputable tU := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hW : PolyTimeComputable tW := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hK : PolyTimeComputable tK := by
    unfold tK
    have h := polyTimeComputable_tail.comp
      (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp (BinArith.polyTimeComputable_dblLoop.comp hU))
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have hNK : PolyTimeComputable tNK := by
    unfold tNK
    have h := polyTimeComputable_mulU.comp (hU.pairEncode hK)
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have hC : PolyTimeComputable tCoins := by
    unfold tCoins
    have h := polyTimeComputable_takePrefixByLen.comp
      ((polyTimeComputable_mulU.comp (hU.pairEncode hNK)).pairEncode polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have hE : PolyTimeComputable lovaszEntryW := by
    unfold lovaszEntryW
    exact polyTimeComputable_ite (polyTimeComputable_headD.comp BinArith.polyTimeComputable_slot2)
      (BinArith.polyTimeComputable_normBits.comp BinArith.polyTimeComputable_slot3)
      (polyTimeComputable_const [])
  have hR : PolyTimeComputable lovaszRowW := by
    unfold lovaszRowW
    have h := (BinArith.polyTimeComputable_zipWithW hE).comp
      ((polyTimeComputable_const []).pairEncode ((polyTimeComputable_chunkW.comp
        ((polyTimeComputable_const [true]).pairEncode BinArith.polyTimeComputable_slot2)).pairEncode
        (polyTimeComputable_chunkW.comp (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
          BinArith.polyTimeComputable_slot3))))
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have hD : PolyTimeComputable tDet := by
    unfold tDet
    have h := BinArith.polyTimeComputable_detModAlg.comp
      ((BinArith.polyTimeComputable_lovaszPrime.comp hU).pairEncode
        ((BinArith.polyTimeComputable_zipWithW hR).comp (hK.pairEncode
          ((polyTimeComputable_chunkW.comp (hU.pairEncode hW)).pairEncode
            (polyTimeComputable_chunkW.comp (hNK.pairEncode hC))))))
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have p1 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [eqW (pairEncode (pairFstD z)
      (pairEncode (List.replicate (tU z).length true) (tW z)))]) := by
    have h := polyTimeComputable_eqW.comp (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
      ((polyTimeComputable_unary.comp hU).pairEncode hW))
    simp only [Function.comp_def] at h
    exact h
  have p2 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z =>
      [decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tU z))).length = (tW z).length)]) := by
    have h := polyTimeComputable_lenEq.comp
      ((polyTimeComputable_mulU.comp (hU.pairEncode hU)).pairEncode hW)
    simp only [Function.comp_def, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode] at h
    exact h
  have p3 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z =>
      [decide ((mulU (pairEncode (tU z) (tNK z))).length ≤ (pairSndD z).length)]) := by
    have h := polyTimeComputable_lenLe.comp (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.pairEncode
      (polyTimeComputable_mulU.comp (hU.pairEncode hNK)))
    simp only [Function.comp_def, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode] at h
    exact h
  have p4 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [!decide (bitsVal (tDet z) = 0)]) := by
    have h := polyTimeComputable_not (BinArith.polyTimeComputable_isZero.comp hD)
    exact h
  have h := polyTimeComputable_and (polyTimeComputable_and (polyTimeComputable_and p1 p2) p3) p4
  exact h

/-- **Lovász's verifier is polynomial-time.** [AB09, §7.2.4] -/
theorem eff_matchingVerifier : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier matchingVerifier) :=
  eff_boolVerifier_of_test polyTimeComputable_matchingTest matchingTest_pairEncode

/-! ### `BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ RP` -/

/-- On an encoded graph the verifier is Lovász's test, given enough coins. -/
theorem matchingVerifier_encodeBPM (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Bool) (r : List Bool) :
    matchingVerifier (encodeBPM n A) r = (decide (n * n * lovaszBits n ≤ r.length) &&
      decide ((lovaszMatrix A
        (lovaszSample (ZMod (BinArith.lovaszPrime n)) n (lovaszBits n) r)).det ≠ 0)) := by
  unfold matchingVerifier
  dsimp only
  generalize hm : (pairFstD (encodeBPM n A)).length = m
  have hmn : m = n := by rw [← hm]; simp [encodeBPM]
  subst hmn
  simp [encodeBPM, adjOfWord_adjWord]

/-- **`BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ RP`**, certificate form. [AB09, §7.2.4]

**Proof sketch.** Coin words of length `(|x|+1)³ ≥ n²k`. On an encoded graph with a perfect
matching the verifier is Lovász's test (`matchingVerifier_encodeBPM`), which accepts with
probability `≥ 1/2` (`lovasz_test_zmod`, `2n ≤ 2^k < p`); since `|x| ≥ 2`, this meets the
weak threshold `min (2/3) (|x|+1)⁻¹` of [AB09, Ex 7.4] (`inRPWeak_iff_inRP`). On a
non-member the verifier rejects malformed words, and on a graph without a perfect matching
every determinant vanishes (`det_lovaszMatrix_eq_zero`). -/
theorem inRP_BipartitePerfectMatching : InRP polyTimeModel BipartitePerfectMatching := by
  refine (inRPWeak_iff_inRP polyTimeModel polyTimeModel_closedUnderAny 1 _).1
    ⟨matchingVerifier, 1, 3, eff_matchingVerifier, fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx r => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, A, rfl, hA⟩ := hx
    have hx : (encodeBPM n A).length = 2 * n + 2 + n * n := by
      simp [encodeBPM, length_pairEncode, length_adjWord]
    have hm : n * n * lovaszBits n ≤ polyLen 1 3 (encodeBPM n A).length := by
      have hk := lovaszBits_le n
      set M := n * n + 2 * n + 3
      have h1 : n * n ≤ M := by omega
      have h2 : lovaszBits n ≤ M := by omega
      have h3 : 1 ≤ M := by omega
      calc n * n * lovaszBits n ≤ M * M * M :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul (h1.trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ h3)) h2
        _ = polyLen 1 3 (encodeBPM n A).length := by
            simp only [polyLen, hx, M]; ring
    haveI : Fact (BinArith.lovaszPrime n).Prime := ⟨BinArith.lovaszPrime_prime n⟩
    have hT := lovasz_test_zmod A hA (two_mul_le_two_pow_lovaszBits n)
      (BinArith.two_pow_lt_lovaszPrime n).le hm
    rw [randProb_congr (B := fun l => (lovaszMatrix A (lovaszSample
        (ZMod (BinArith.lovaszPrime n)) n (lovaszBits n) l)).det ≠ 0) fun r => by
      rw [matchingVerifier_encodeBPM, List.length_ofFn, decide_eq_true hm, Bool.true_and,
        decide_eq_true_iff]]
    refine le_trans ?_ hT
    refine min_le_of_right_le ?_
    have h3 : (3 : ℚ) ≤ (encodeBPM n A).length + 1 := by
      rw [hx]; push_cast; nlinarith
    rw [pow_one]
    calc (((encodeBPM n A).length : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹ ≤ 3⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) h3
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  · unfold matchingVerifier
    dsimp only
    by_cases hw : x = encodeBPM (pairFstD x).length
        (adjOfWord (pairFstD x).length (pairSndD x))
    · have hnot : ¬ HasPerfectMatching (adjOfWord (pairFstD x).length (pairSndD x)) :=
        fun h => hx ⟨_, _, hw, h⟩
      simp [det_lovaszMatrix_eq_zero _ hnot]
    · simp [hw]

/-- **`BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ BPP`**, certificate form. [AB09, §7.2.4] -/
theorem inBPP_BipartitePerfectMatching : InBPP polyTimeModel BipartitePerfectMatching :=
  inRP_BipartitePerfectMatching.inBPP

/-- **`BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ RP`**, PTM form. [AB09, §7.2.4] -/
theorem BipartitePerfectMatching_mem_RP_PTM : BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ RP_PTM :=
  (mem_RP_PTM_iff _).2 inRP_BipartitePerfectMatching

/-- **`BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ BPP`**, PTM form. [AB09, §7.2.4] -/
theorem BipartitePerfectMatching_mem_BPP_PTM : BipartitePerfectMatching ∈ BPP_PTM :=
  RP_PTM_subset_BPP_PTM BipartitePerfectMatching_mem_RP_PTM

end Randomized.Matching

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Reductions

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# `NP/poly` and `BP·NP ⊆ NP/poly`

Nondeterministic polynomial-size circuits and [AB09, Exercise 7.7]: every language randomly
reducible to `3SAT` has them, by fixing good reduction coins as advice (Adleman's argument).
The first step of [AB09, Exercise 7.8] follows.

## Main definitions

* `Language.InNPPoly` — `NP/poly`, polynomial-size nondeterministic circuits
  [AB09, Exercise 7.7].
* `Randomized.wireVal` — the value carried by a circuit wire (free bit or constant).

## Main results

* `Randomized.BPNP_subset_NPPoly` — `BP·NP ⊆ NP/poly` [AB09, Exercise 7.7].
* `Randomized.NP_subset_NPPoly` — `NP ⊆ NP/poly`.
* `Randomized.coNP_subset_NPPoly_of_compl_SAT3_mem_BPNP` — `3SATᶜ ∈ BP·NP ⇒ coNP ⊆ NP/poly`,
  the first step of [AB09, Exercise 7.8].
* `Randomized.exists_good_coins` — coins good for every input of a length (by the union bound
  `Randomized.exists_forall_not_of_randProb_le`); `Randomized.inNPPoly_of_wiring` — circuits
  from `P` by wiring.

## Divergences

* **`NP/poly`.** A nondeterministic circuit on `x ∈ {0,1}ⁿ`, `y ∈ {0,1}^{m(n)}` is a fan-in-two
  `DAGCircuit (n + m n)` read on `Fin.append x y`; "polynomial size" is `a(n+1)^k`, the repair
  of `Language.InPPoly`. The certificate length is bounded by the size, which counts inputs.
* **Exercise 7.8.** Its hypothesis is `3SATᶜ ∈ BP·NP` (the overbar is lost in the printed
  text: `3SAT ∈ BP·NP` holds outright). This file derives `coNP ⊆ NP/poly`; the collapse
  `PH = Σ₃ᵖ` follows by Yap's theorem in `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Yap`
  (`Randomized.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_compl_SAT3_mem_BPNP`).

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-! ### Fixing good coins for every input of a length -/

open Classical in
/-- **Good coins for the amplified reduction** (the Adleman step of [AB09, Exercise 7.7]):
at every length `n`, some string of `K = 36(n+1)` blocks of reduction coins makes the
majority of the `K` reduced instances correct for *every* input of length `n`.

**Proof sketch.** For a fixed input the `K` blocks are independent runs of the reduction,
each wrong with probability at most `1/3`, so the binomial tail bound (`randProb_tail_le`)
bounds the probability that at least half are wrong by `2(8/9)^{18(n+1)} ≤ 2^{-(n+1)}`; the
union bound over the `2^n` inputs (`exists_forall_not_of_randProb_le`) leaves a string good
for all of them. For a good string, the correct blocks are a strict majority, so `x ∈ L`
exactly when a strict majority of the reduced instances lie in `C`. -/
theorem exists_good_coins {L C : Language Bool} {f : List Bool → List Bool} {a k : ℕ}
    (hprob : ∀ x : List Bool,
      2/3 ≤ randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => (f (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ C ↔ x ∈ L))
    (n : ℕ) : ∃ ρ : Fin (polyLen 36 1 n * polyLen a k n) → Bool, ∀ v : Fin n → Bool,
      (List.ofFn v ∈ L ↔ polyLen 36 1 n < 2 * (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).countP fun i =>
        decide (f (Turing.pairEncode (List.ofFn v)
          (((List.ofFn ρ).drop (i * polyLen a k n)).take (polyLen a k n))) ∈ C)) := by
  set q := polyLen a k n
  set K := polyLen 36 1 n
  let Bx : (Fin n → Bool) → List Bool → Bool := fun v r =>
    decide (f (Turing.pairEncode (List.ofFn v) r) ∈ C ↔ List.ofFn v ∈ L)
  have hK : K / 2 = 18 * (n + 1) := by
    simp only [K, polyLen, pow_one]
    omega
  have hbad : ∀ v, randProb (K * q) (fun l => K ≤ 2 * blockCount q K (fun r => !Bx v r) l) ≤
      (1/2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro v
    have h1 : 2/3 ≤ randProb q (fun r => Bx v r = true) := by
      have := hprob (List.ofFn v)
      rw [List.length_ofFn] at this
      exact this.trans_eq (randProb_congr fun r => by simp [Bx])
    have h2 : randProb q (fun r => (!Bx v r) = true) = 1 - randProb q (fun r => Bx v r = true) := by
      rw [← randProb_bool_false]
      exact randProb_congr fun r => by simp
    have ht := randProb_tail_le q K (fun r => !Bx v r) (ε := 1/6) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have hpow : (1 - 1/9 : ℚ) ^ (K / 2) ≤ (1/2) ^ (n + 2) :=
      one_sub_pow_le_half_pow (m := 9) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
    calc randProb (K * q) (fun l => K ≤ 2 * blockCount q K (fun r => !Bx v r) l)
        ≤ 2 * (1 - 4 * (1/6 : ℚ) ^ 2) ^ (K / 2) := ht
      _ = 2 * (1 - 1/9 : ℚ) ^ (K / 2) := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 * (1/2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 2) := by linarith
      _ = (1/2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
  have hδ : (2 : ℚ) ^ n * (1/2) ^ (n + 1) < 1 := by
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_forall_not_of_randProb_le _ hbad hδ
  refine ⟨ρ, fun v => ?_⟩
  have hgood := hρ v
  -- the correct and the wrong blocks are all the blocks
  have hsum := blockCount_add_not q K (Bx v) (List.ofFn ρ)
  by_cases hx : List.ofFn v ∈ L
  · have hS : blockCount q K (Bx v) (List.ofFn ρ) = (List.range K).countP fun i =>
        decide (f (Turing.pairEncode (List.ofFn v) (((List.ofFn ρ).drop (i * q)).take q)) ∈ C) :=
      List.countP_congr fun i _ => by simp [Bx, hx]
    simp only [hx, true_iff]
    omega
  · have hS : blockCount q K (fun r => !Bx v r) (List.ofFn ρ) = (List.range K).countP fun i =>
        decide (f (Turing.pairEncode (List.ofFn v) (((List.ofFn ρ).drop (i * q)).take q)) ∈ C) :=
      List.countP_congr fun i _ => by simp [Bx, hx]
    simp only [hx, false_iff, not_lt]
    omega

/-! ### `NP/poly` -/

/-- **`NP/poly`** [AB09, Exercise 7.7]: `L` is decided by polynomial-size nondeterministic
circuits — fan-in-two circuits `Cₙ` on an input `x ∈ {0,1}ⁿ` and a certificate
`y ∈ {0,1}^{m(n)}`, of size at most `a(n+1)^k`, with `x ∈ L ↔ ∃ y, C_{|x|}(x, y) = 1`. -/
def _root_.Language.InNPPoly (L : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ (a k : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (C : (n : ℕ) → BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit (n + m n)),
    (∀ n, (C n).IsFaninTwo) ∧ (∀ n, (C n).size ≤ a * (n + 1) ^ k) ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔
      ∃ y : Fin (m x.length) → Bool, (C x.length).eval (Fin.append x.get y) = true

/-- The value carried by a wire: a free input bit or a constant. -/
def wireVal {N : ℕ} (v : Fin N → Bool) : Fin N ⊕ Bool → Bool :=
  Sum.elim v id

/-- Reading a circuit's buffered inputs back as a word evaluates the wire list. -/
theorem ofFn_inputValues_vectorOfList {N : ℕ} (w : List (Fin N ⊕ Bool)) (v : Fin N → Bool) :
    List.ofFn (BoolCircuit.inputValues (BoolCircuit.vectorOfList w rfl) v) =
      w.map (wireVal v) := by
  have e1 : List.ofFn (BoolCircuit.inputValues (BoolCircuit.vectorOfList w rfl) v) =
      (List.ofFn (BoolCircuit.vectorOfList w rfl)).map (wireVal v) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp only [BoolCircuit.inputValues, Function.comp_apply, wireVal]
    rcases BoolCircuit.vectorOfList w rfl i with j | b <;> rfl
  rw [e1, BoolCircuit.vectorOfList_ofFn]

/-- **Nondeterministic circuits from a `P`-language and a wiring.** If membership in `L` is
"some certificate `y ∈ {0,1}^{m(|x|)}` makes the word read off the wire list `wire |x|`
(free bits from `(x, y)`, the rest constants) land in `W ∈ P`", and the wire lists and
certificates are polynomially long, then `L ∈ NP/poly`.

**Proof sketch.** `P ⊆ P/poly` gives a fan-in-two family for `W`; feed the circuit for the
wire list's length through one buffer gate per wire (`BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.bufferInputs`),
which copies the selected free input or supplies the constant. Size is the free inputs plus
the old circuit, polynomial in `n`. -/
theorem inNPPoly_of_wiring {L W : Language Bool} (hW : W ∈ P) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (wire : (n : ℕ) → List (Fin (n + m n) ⊕ Bool)) (b j : ℕ)
    (hlen : ∀ n, (wire n).length + 1 ≤ b * (n + 1) ^ j) (hm : ∀ n, n + m n ≤ b * (n + 1) ^ j)
    (hL : ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔ ∃ y : Fin (m x.length) → Bool,
      (wire x.length).map (wireVal (Fin.append x.get y)) ∈ W) : L.InNPPoly := by
  have hPoly : W.InPPoly := P_subset_PPoly hW
  obtain ⟨bF, jF, F, hF, hSize, hLang⟩ := hPoly
  refine ⟨b + bF * b ^ jF, j * (jF + 1), m,
    fun n => (F.circuit (wire n).length).bufferInputs (BoolCircuit.vectorOfList (wire n) rfl),
    fun n => ((F.circuit _).bufferInputs_structure _ (hF _)).2.1, fun n => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · rw [((F.circuit _).bufferInputs_structure _ (hF _)).2.2]
    have hN : 0 < n + 1 := Nat.succ_pos n
    have hj1 : (n + 1) ^ j ≤ (n + 1) ^ (j * (jF + 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right j (Nat.succ_pos jF))
    have hj2 : (n + 1) ^ (j * jF) ≤ (n + 1) ^ (j * (jF + 1)) :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (Nat.mul_le_mul_left j (Nat.le_succ jF))
    calc n + m n + (F.circuit (wire n).length).size
        ≤ b * (n + 1) ^ j + bF * (b * (n + 1) ^ j) ^ jF :=
          Nat.add_le_add (hm n) ((hSize _).trans
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left bF (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (hlen n) jF)))
      _ = b * (n + 1) ^ j + bF * b ^ jF * (n + 1) ^ (j * jF) := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          ring
      _ ≤ b * (n + 1) ^ (j * (jF + 1)) + bF * b ^ jF * (n + 1) ^ (j * (jF + 1)) :=
          Nat.add_le_add (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hj1) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hj2)
      _ = (b + bF * b ^ jF) * (n + 1) ^ (j * (jF + 1)) := by ring
  · rw [hL x]
    refine exists_congr fun y => ?_
    rw [BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.bufferInputs_eval, ← BoolCircuit.DAGCircuitFamily.mem_language_ofFn,
      ofFn_inputValues_vectorOfList, hLang]

/-! ### Block bookkeeping -/

/-- Doubling every entry doubles the length. -/
private theorem length_flatMap_dup {α : Type*} (l : List α) :
    (l.flatMap fun s => [s, s]).length = 2 * l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, ih]
    ring

/-- Doubling the images is doubling, then mapping. -/
private theorem flatMap_dup_map {α β : Type*} (g : α → β) (l : List α) :
    l.flatMap (fun a => [g a, g a]) = (l.map g).flatMap fun b => [b, b] := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_cons, ih]

/-- Concatenating `K` chunks of length `c` gives length `K · c`. -/
private theorem length_flatMap_range {α : Type*} (g : ℕ → List α) {c : ℕ} :
    ∀ K : ℕ, (∀ j < K, (g j).length = c) → ((List.range K).flatMap g).length = K * c
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | K + 1, h => by
    rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append, List.length_append,
      length_flatMap_range g K fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, h K (by omega)]
    ring

/-- Chunk `i` of a concatenation of `K` chunks of length `c` is recovered by slicing. -/
private theorem flatMap_range_drop_take {α : Type*} (g : ℕ → List α) {c : ℕ} :
    ∀ K i : ℕ, (∀ j < K, (g j).length = c) → i < K →
      (((List.range K).flatMap g).drop (i * c)).take c = g i
  | 0, i, _, hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | K + 1, i, h, hi => by
    have hA := length_flatMap_range g K fun j hj => h j (by omega)
    rw [List.range_succ, List.flatMap_append]
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hi | rfl
    · have hle : i * c + c ≤ K * c := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
        rwa [Nat.succ_mul] at this
      rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [hA]; omega),
        List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [List.length_drop, hA]; omega)]
      exact flatMap_range_drop_take g K i (fun j hj => h j (by omega)) hi
    · rw [List.drop_left' hA, List.take_of_length_le (by rw [h i (by omega)])]

/-- Block `i < K` of a string of `K` blocks of length `c` has length `c`. -/
private theorem length_block {α : Type*} {l : List α} {K c i : ℕ} (hl : l.length = K * c)
    (hi : i < K) :
    ((l.drop (i * c)).take c).length = c := by
  have hle : i * c + c ≤ K * c := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right c (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)
    rwa [Nat.succ_mul] at this
  rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop, hl]
  omega

/-! ### `BP·NP ⊆ NP/poly` -/

open Classical in
/-- **`BP·NP ⊆ NP/poly`** [AB09, Exercise 7.7].

**Proof sketch.** Let `L ≤ᵣ 3SAT` via `f` with `q = polyLen a₁ k₁ |x|` coins. Fix, for every
length `n`, a string `ρ` of `K = 36(n+1)` coin blocks such that for every `x ∈ {0,1}ⁿ`,
`x ∈ L` iff a strict majority of the formulas `f(x, ρᵢ)` is satisfiable
(`exists_good_coins`, the Adleman argument). This majority of `NP`-statements is itself an
`NP`-statement: the certificate supplies, per block, a padded `3SAT` certificate for `f(x, ρᵢ)`,
and the verifier counts the blocks whose certificate checks — a satisfiable formula can
always be certified, an unsatisfiable one never. Interleaving `ρᵢ` with the certificate
blocks, this count is the block-majority test `Complexity.mem_P_of_blockMajority` of a
`P`-language (the reduction followed by the `3SAT` verifier, via `composeMap`). The
interleaving is done by wiring (`inNPPoly_of_wiring`): the coin bits of `ρ` become constants
and the certificate bits become the nondeterministic inputs of the circuit. -/
theorem BPNP_subset_NPPoly : BPNP ⊆ {L | L.InNPPoly} := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨f, a₁, k₁, hf, hprob⟩ := hL
  obtain ⟨Cf, cf, hCf⟩ := hf.output_length_le
  obtain ⟨C₃, c₃, V₃, hV₃, hSAT⟩ := SAT3_mem_NP
  choose ρ hρ using exists_good_coins hprob
  set A := C₃ * ((Cf + 1) * (a₁ + 3) ^ cf) ^ c₃ with hA
  set Ke := (k₁ + 1) * cf * c₃ with hKe
  set ab := a₁ + A with hab
  set kb := k₁ + Ke with hkb
  have hqb : ∀ n, polyLen a₁ k₁ n + polyLen A Ke n ≤ polyLen ab kb n := by
    intro n
    have h1 : (n + 1) ^ k₁ ≤ (n + 1) ^ kb := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (by omega)
    have h2 : (n + 1) ^ Ke ≤ (n + 1) ^ kb := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (by omega)
    simp only [polyLen, hab]
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_left a₁ h1, Nat.mul_le_mul_left A h2]
  -- slot length for one `3SAT` certificate, and the certificate length
  let u : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => polyLen ab kb n - polyLen a₁ k₁ n
  let m : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => polyLen 36 1 n * u n
  have hwit : ∀ (x r : List Bool), r.length = polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length →
      C₃ * ((f (Turing.pairEncode x r)).length + 1) ^ c₃ ≤ u x.length := by
    intro x r hr
    have h := polyLen_length_pairEncode_le hCf a₁ k₁ C₃ c₃ hr
    rw [← hA, ← hKe] at h
    have h' := hqb x.length
    show polyLen C₃ c₃ (f (Turing.pairEncode x r)).length ≤
      polyLen ab kb x.length - polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length
    omega
  -- the per-block `P`-language and the block-majority language
  let cm := composeMap a₁ k₁ C₃ c₃ f
  have hcm : PolyTimeComputable cm := polyTimeComputable_composeMap _ _ _ _ hf
  let V₁ : Language Bool := (fun z => pairFstD (cm z) ++ pairSndD (cm z)) ⁻¹' V₃
  have hV₁ : V₁ ∈ P := preimage_mem_P hV₃
    ((polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp hcm).append (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp hcm))
  have hV₁iff : ∀ x t : List Bool, Turing.pairEncode x t ∈ V₁ ↔
      f (Turing.pairEncode x (t.take (polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length))) ++
        (t.drop (polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length)).take (C₃ * ((f (Turing.pairEncode x
          (t.take (polyLen a₁ k₁ x.length)))).length + 1) ^ c₃) ∈ V₃ := by
    intro x t
    show pairFstD (cm _) ++ pairSndD (cm _) ∈ V₃ ↔ _
    simp only [cm, composeMap_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, polyLen]
  -- the coin blocks interleaved with certificate blocks
  let ρb : ℕ → ℕ → List Bool := fun n i =>
    ((List.ofFn (ρ n)).drop (i * polyLen a₁ k₁ n)).take (polyLen a₁ k₁ n)
  let Yb : ℕ → List Bool → ℕ → List Bool := fun n Y i => (Y.drop (i * u n)).take (u n)
  let sb : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool := fun n Y =>
    (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).flatMap fun i => ρb n i ++ Yb n Y i
  have hρl : ∀ n, (List.ofFn (ρ n)).length = polyLen 36 1 n * polyLen a₁ k₁ n :=
    fun n => List.length_ofFn
  have hqu : ∀ n, polyLen a₁ k₁ n + u n = polyLen ab kb n := fun n => by
    have := hqb n
    simp only [u]
    omega
  let Wset : Language Bool := {z | 36 * ((pairFstD z).length + 1) ^ 1 <
    2 * (List.range (36 * ((pairFstD z).length + 1) ^ 1)).countP
      (fun i => MultiTapeTM.indicator V₁ (Turing.pairEncode (pairFstD z) (blockAt ab kb z i)))}
  have hW : Wset ∈ P := mem_P_of_blockMajority hV₁ ab kb 36 1
  -- `x ∈ L` iff some certificate string puts the interleaving into `Wset`
  have hchar : ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔ ∃ Y : List Bool, Y.length = m x.length ∧
      Turing.pairEncode x (sb x.length Y) ∈ Wset := by
    intro x
    set n := x.length with hn
    have hL' := hρ n x.get
    rw [List.ofFn_get] at hL'
    -- the number of satisfiable reduced instances, and of certified blocks
    let S : ℕ := (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).countP fun i =>
      decide (f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ∈ SAT3)
    let T : List Bool → ℕ := fun Y => (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).countP fun i =>
      decide (f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ++ (Yb n Y i).take
        (C₃ * ((f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i))).length + 1) ^ c₃) ∈ V₃)
    have hLS : x ∈ L ↔ polyLen 36 1 n < 2 * S := hL'
    have hwit' : ∀ i < polyLen 36 1 n,
        C₃ * ((f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i))).length + 1) ^ c₃ ≤ u n :=
      fun i hi => hwit x _ (length_block (hρl n) hi)
    have hWiff : ∀ Y : List Bool, Y.length = polyLen 36 1 n * u n →
        (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y) ∈ Wset ↔ polyLen 36 1 n < 2 * T Y) := by
      intro Y hY
      have hblk : ∀ i < polyLen 36 1 n,
          blockAt ab kb (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y)) i = ρb n i ++ Yb n Y i := by
        intro i hi
        unfold blockAt
        simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
        show ((sb n Y).drop (i * polyLen ab kb n)).take (polyLen ab kb n) = _
        rw [← hqu n]
        exact flatMap_range_drop_take (fun i => ρb n i ++ Yb n Y i) (polyLen 36 1 n) i
          (fun j hj => by
            rw [List.length_append, length_block (hρl n) hj, length_block hY hj]) hi
      have hcount : (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).countP (fun i => MultiTapeTM.indicator V₁
          (Turing.pairEncode x (blockAt ab kb (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y)) i))) = T Y := by
        refine List.countP_congr fun i hi => ?_
        have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
        have ht1 : (ρb n i ++ Yb n Y i).take (polyLen a₁ k₁ n) = ρb n i :=
          List.take_left' (length_block (hρl n) hi')
        have ht2 : (ρb n i ++ Yb n Y i).drop (polyLen a₁ k₁ n) = Yb n Y i :=
          List.drop_left' (length_block (hρl n) hi')
        have hind : ∀ z, MultiTapeTM.indicator V₁ z = decide (z ∈ V₁) := fun z => by
          unfold MultiTapeTM.indicator
          split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
        rw [hblk i hi', hind, decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff, hV₁iff, ht1, ht2]
      have hmem : Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y) ∈ Wset ↔
          36 * ((pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y))).length + 1) ^ 1 <
            2 * (List.range
              (36 * ((pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y))).length + 1) ^ 1)).countP
              (fun i => MultiTapeTM.indicator V₁ (Turing.pairEncode
                (pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y)))
                (blockAt ab kb (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y)) i))) := Iff.rfl
      rw [hmem, pairFstD_pairEncode]
      show polyLen 36 1 n < 2 * (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).countP (fun i =>
        MultiTapeTM.indicator V₁ (Turing.pairEncode x
          (blockAt ab kb (Turing.pairEncode x (sb n Y)) i))) ↔ _
      rw [hcount]
    -- a certified block has a satisfiable instance
    have hTS : ∀ Y : List Bool, Y.length = polyLen 36 1 n * u n → T Y ≤ S := by
      intro Y hY
      refine List.countP_mono_left fun i hi h => ?_
      have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
      rw [decide_eq_true_iff] at h ⊢
      refine (hSAT _).mpr ⟨_, ?_, h⟩
      rw [List.length_take, length_block hY hi']
      exact min_eq_left (hwit' i hi')
    -- every satisfiable instance can be certified in its slot
    have hST : ∃ Y : List Bool, Y.length = polyLen 36 1 n * u n ∧ S ≤ T Y := by
      classical
      let w : ℕ → List Bool := fun i =>
        if h : f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ∈ SAT3 then Classical.choose ((hSAT _).mp h)
        else []
      have hw : ∀ i, f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ∈ SAT3 →
          (w i).length = C₃ * ((f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i))).length + 1) ^ c₃ ∧
            f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ++ w i ∈ V₃ := fun i h => by
        simp only [w, dif_pos h]
        exact Classical.choose_spec ((hSAT _).mp h)
      have hwl : ∀ i < polyLen 36 1 n, (w i).length ≤ u n := fun i hi => by
        by_cases h : f (Turing.pairEncode x (ρb n i)) ∈ SAT3
        · rw [(hw i h).1]
          exact hwit' i hi
        · simp only [w, dif_neg h, List.length_nil]
          exact Nat.zero_le _
      let Yc : ℕ → List Bool := fun i => w i ++ List.replicate (u n - (w i).length) false
      have hYc : ∀ i < polyLen 36 1 n, (Yc i).length = u n := fun i hi => by
        simp only [Yc, List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
        have := hwl i hi
        omega
      refine ⟨(List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).flatMap Yc,
        length_flatMap_range Yc _ hYc, List.countP_mono_left fun i hi h => ?_⟩
      have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
      rw [decide_eq_true_iff] at h ⊢
      have hblk : Yb n ((List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).flatMap Yc) i = Yc i :=
        flatMap_range_drop_take Yc _ i hYc hi'
      rw [hblk, List.take_left' (hw i h).1]
      exact (hw i h).2
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨Y, hY, hle⟩ := hST
      have := hLS.mp hx
      exact ⟨Y, hY, (hWiff Y hY).mpr (by omega)⟩
    · rintro ⟨Y, hY, hYW⟩
      have h1 := (hWiff Y hY).mp hYW
      have h2 := hTS Y hY
      exact hLS.mpr (by omega)
  -- the circuits: coin bits as constants, certificate bits as nondeterministic inputs
  let wire : (n : ℕ) → List (Fin (n + m n) ⊕ Bool) := fun n =>
    (List.ofFn fun j : Fin n => (Sum.inl (Fin.castAdd (m n) j) : Fin (n + m n) ⊕ Bool)).flatMap
        (fun s => [s, s]) ++ [Sum.inr false, Sum.inr true] ++
      (List.range (polyLen 36 1 n)).flatMap fun i => (ρb n i).map Sum.inr ++
        (((List.ofFn fun j : Fin (m n) => (Sum.inl (Fin.natAdd n j) : Fin (n + m n) ⊕ Bool)).drop
          (i * u n)).take (u n))
  have hwire : ∀ n (v : Fin n → Bool) (y : Fin (m n) → Bool),
      (wire n).map (wireVal (Fin.append v y)) =
        Turing.pairEncode (List.ofFn v) (sb n (List.ofFn y)) := by
    intro n v y
    simp [wire, sb, Yb, wireVal, Turing.pairEncode, flatMap_dup_map, List.map_flatMap,
      Function.comp_def]
  have hK : ∀ n, polyLen 36 1 n * polyLen ab kb n = 36 * ab * (n + 1) ^ (kb + 1) := fun n => by
    simp only [polyLen]
    ring
  have hwlen : ∀ n, (wire n).length = 2 * n + 2 + polyLen 36 1 n * polyLen ab kb n := by
    intro n
    simp only [wire, List.length_append, length_flatMap_dup, List.length_ofFn, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil]
    rw [length_flatMap_range _ (polyLen 36 1 n) (c := polyLen ab kb n) fun j hj => by
      rw [List.length_append, List.length_map, length_block (hρl n) hj,
        length_block (l := List.ofFn fun j : Fin (m n) =>
          (Sum.inl (Fin.natAdd n j) : Fin (n + m n) ⊕ Bool)) List.length_ofFn hj]
      exact hqu n]
  refine inNPPoly_of_wiring hW m wire (3 + 36 * ab) (kb + 1) (fun n => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    (fun x => ?_)
  · rw [hwlen, hK]
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (kb + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero kb) _
    nlinarith
  · have h0 : m n ≤ polyLen 36 1 n * polyLen ab kb n :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)
    rw [hK] at h0
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (kb + 1) := Nat.le_self_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero kb) _
    nlinarith
  · rw [hchar x]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨Y, hY, hYW⟩
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := exists_ofFn_eq hY
      exact ⟨y, by rw [hwire, List.ofFn_get]; exact hYW⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      rw [hwire, List.ofFn_get] at hy
      exact ⟨List.ofFn y, List.length_ofFn, hy⟩

/-- `NP ⊆ NP/poly`; follows from [AB09, Exercise 7.7] and `NP ⊆ BP·NP`. -/
theorem NP_subset_NPPoly : NP ⊆ {L | L.InNPPoly} :=
  fun _ hL => BPNP_subset_NPPoly (NP_subset_BPNP hL)

/-- **The first step of [AB09, Exercise 7.8]**: if `3SATᶜ ∈ BP·NP` then `coNP ⊆ NP/poly`.
(The exercise's conclusion `PH = Σ₃ᵖ` is `Randomized.PH_eq_SigmaP_three_of_compl_SAT3_mem_BPNP`
in `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Yap`, by Yap's theorem.)

**Proof sketch.** A `coNP` language Karp-reduces to `3SATᶜ` by the Cook–Levin reduction of
its complement; compose with the randomized reduction `3SATᶜ ≤ᵣ 3SAT`
(`RandReducible.of_polyTimeReducible_left`) and apply `BPNP_subset_NPPoly`. -/
theorem coNP_subset_NPPoly_of_compl_SAT3_mem_BPNP (h : SAT3ᶜ ∈ BPNP) :
    coNP ⊆ {L | L.InNPPoly} := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgL⟩ := SAT3_NPHard Lᶜ hL
  have hred : L ≤ₚ SAT3ᶜ := ⟨g, hg, fun x => by
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, ← hgL x, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not]⟩
  exact BPNP_subset_NPPoly (RandReducible.of_polyTimeReducible_left hred h)

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Inclusions

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The two definitions of BPP agree

[AB09, p. 126] gives an alternative definition of `BPP` (Def 7.3): a deterministic
polynomial-time machine reading its coin tosses as an extra input.  We prove that the PTM
classes of [AB09, Def 7.2 and Def 7.6] (`Randomized.BPP_PTM`, `Randomized.RP_PTM`,
`Randomized.coRP_PTM`) coincide with the certificate classes over polynomial-time verifiers
(`Randomized.InBPP polyTimeModel` etc.), and transfer the certificate-form corollaries.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith`, `Randomized.BPP_PTMWith`, `Randomized.InBPPWith` —
  `BPP` with success threshold `p(|x|)` in place of `2/3`, PTM and certificate forms.
* `Turing.FinNDTM.RDecidesInTimeWith`, `Randomized.RP_PTMWith` — `RP` with acceptance
  threshold `p(|x|)` in place of `2/3` (the PTM side of [AB09, Ex 7.4]).

## Main results

* `Randomized.randProb_maskSelect` — uniform coins push forward to uniform bits under a
  coordinate projection (with `Randomized.randProb_drop_take` for the slice).
* `Randomized.exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff`, `Randomized.exists_FinNDTM_of_eff` — a
  polynomial-time verifier as a PTM reading a coordinate projection of its coins, hence with the
  same output distribution (via `Complexity.exists_maskSelect_host`).
* `Randomized.mem_BPP_PTMWith_iff` — PTM and certificate `BPP` agree at every threshold;
  its `2/3` case `Randomized.mem_BPP_PTM_iff` is `L ∈ BPP ↔ InBPP polyTimeModel L`
  [AB09, Def 7.2 ≡ Def 7.3].
* `Randomized.mem_RP_PTM_iff`, `Randomized.mem_coRP_PTM_iff` — the same for `RP`, `coRP`.
* `Randomized.BPP_PTM_subset_EXP`, `Randomized.BPP_PTM_eq_P_of_P_eq_NP`,
  `Randomized.BPP_PTM_subset_PPoly` [AB09, Thm 7.14],
  `Randomized.BPP_PTM_subset_SigmaP_two_inter_PiP_two` [AB09, Thm 7.15],
  `Randomized.BPP_PTM_of_polyTimeReducible`, `Randomized.PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_SAT3_mem_BPP_PTM`,
  `Randomized.RP_PTMWith_error_reduction` [AB09, Ex 7.4] — PTM-form corollaries.

## Divergences

* The coin word of a PTM has length exactly its time bound `K·(n^e + 1)`, while a certificate
  verifier draws `polyLen a k n = a·(n+1)^k` bits; the translation pads (coins past halting
  are ignored) or projects onto the coordinates the simulating machine reads.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-! ### Coordinate projections preserve the uniform distribution -/

/-- `maskSelect` returns one bit per marked position. -/
theorem length_maskSelect (mask w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = mask.length) :
    (maskSelect mask w).length = (mask.filter id).length := by
  induction mask generalizing w with
  | nil => cases w <;> rfl
  | cons emit mask ih =>
    cases w with
    | nil => simp at hw
    | cons b w =>
      have ht : w.length = mask.length := by simpa using hw
      cases emit <;> simp [maskSelect, ih w ht]

/-- **Projection onto marked coordinates is measure-preserving**: the bits of a uniform word
at the marked positions of `mask` are uniform. -/
theorem randProb_maskSelect (mask : List Bool) (A : List Bool → Prop) [DecidablePred A] :
    randProb mask.length (fun w => A (maskSelect mask w)) =
      randProb (mask.filter id).length A := by
  induction mask generalizing A with
  | nil =>
    refine randProb_congr fun r => ?_
    have h : List.ofFn r = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp)
    rw [h]
    rfl
  | cons emit mask ih =>
    rw [List.length_cons, randProb_succ]
    cases emit with
    | false =>
      simp only [maskSelect, if_false, List.nil_append, List.filter_cons, id, Bool.false_eq_true]
      rw [ih A]
      ring
    | true =>
      simp only [maskSelect, if_true, List.singleton_append, List.filter_cons, id,
        List.length_cons]
      rw [ih (fun u => A (false :: u)), ih (fun u => A (true :: u)), randProb_succ]

/-- The slice-then-project map `w ↦ maskSelect mask (w[s, s+|mask|))` pushes the uniform
distribution on `m`-bit words to the uniform distribution on `|mask.filter id|`-bit words. -/
theorem randProb_maskSelect_drop_take {s m : ℕ} (mask : List Bool) (h : s + mask.length ≤ m)
    (A : List Bool → Prop) [DecidablePred A] :
    randProb m (fun w => A (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length))) =
      randProb (mask.filter id).length A := by
  rw [randProb_drop_take h (fun v => A (maskSelect mask v)), randProb_maskSelect]

/-! ### Certificate verifiers from PTMs -/

/-- The indicator of `V` is `true` exactly on `V`. -/
theorem indicator_eq_true_iff {V : Language Bool} {y : List Bool} :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) y = true ↔ y ∈ V := by
  classical
  simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator]

/-- The indicator of `V` is `false` exactly off `V`. -/
theorem indicator_eq_false_iff {V : Language Bool} {y : List Bool} :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (V : Set (List Bool)) y = false ↔ y ∉ V := by
  classical
  simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator]

/-- A Boolean verifier whose test on `⟨x, r⟩` is a polynomial-time computable bit is
efficient for `polyTimeModel`. -/
theorem eff_boolVerifier_of_test {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {t : List Bool → Bool}
    (ht : PolyTimeComputable fun z => [t z]) (hM : ∀ x r, t (pairEncode x r) = M x r) :
    polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M) := by
  refine ⟨{z | t z = true}, {z | t z = true}ᶜ, mem_P_of_test ht,
    compl_mem_P (mem_P_of_test ht), fun x r => ?_⟩
  show (some (M x r) = some true ↔ t (pairEncode x r) = true) ∧
    (some (M x r) = some false ↔ ¬ t (pairEncode x r) = true)
  rw [hM]
  simp

/-- A verifier of the form `M(x, r) = [x ++ r ∈ V]` with `V ∈ P` is polynomial-time. -/
theorem eff_append_mem {V : Language Bool} (hV : V ∈ P) :
    polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier fun x r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r)) := by
  classical
  have hg : PolyTimeComputable fun z => pairFstD z ++ pairSndD z :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.append polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
  have h1 : (fun z => pairFstD z ++ pairSndD z) ⁻¹' V ∈ P := preimage_mem_P hV hg
  refine ⟨_, _, h1, compl_mem_P h1, fun x r => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · show some (MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r)) = some true ↔
      pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ++ pairSndD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ V
    rw [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, Option.some.injEq, indicator_eq_true_iff]
  · show some (MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r)) = some false ↔
      ¬ (pairFstD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ++ pairSndD (Turing.pairEncode x r) ∈ V)
    rw [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, Option.some.injEq, indicator_eq_false_iff]

/-- The choice-word verifier of a PTM `N` halting within `T ≤ Q` steps on `x`: on a `Q`-bit
coin word `r`, it accepts iff `N` outputs `[true]` under the first `T` coins of `r`. -/
theorem append_mem_iff_outputWith_take {N : FinNDTM Bool} {V : Language Bool} {x : List Bool}
    {T Q : ℕ}
    (hV : ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = Q →
      (x ++ u ∈ V ↔ (N.tm.runWith u (N.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        (N.tm.runWith u (N.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]))
    (hhalt : N.tm.HaltsWithin x T) (hTQ : T ≤ Q) (r : List Bool) (hr : r.length = Q) :
    x ++ r ∈ V ↔ N.outputWith x (r.take T) = [true] := by
  have hle : T ≤ r.length := hr ▸ hTQ
  rw [hV r hr, FinNDTM.runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hle]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hhalt _ (List.length_take_of_le hle), h⟩⟩

/-- The acceptance probability of the choice-word verifier is the PTM's. -/
theorem randProb_choiceVerifier {N : FinNDTM Bool} {V : Language Bool} {x : List Bool}
    {T Q : ℕ}
    (hV : ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = Q →
      (x ++ u ∈ V ↔ (N.tm.runWith u (N.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        (N.tm.runWith u (N.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]))
    (hhalt : N.tm.HaltsWithin x T) (hTQ : T ≤ Q) :
    (randProb Q fun r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r) = true) = N.outputProb x T [true] := by
  classical
  unfold FinNDTM.outputProb
  rw [← randProb_take hTQ fun w => N.outputWith x w = [true]]
  refine randProb_congr fun r => ?_
  rw [indicator_eq_true_iff]
  exact append_mem_iff_outputWith_take hV hhalt hTQ _ (List.length_ofFn)

end Randomized

/-! ### `BPP` with a general success threshold -/

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

/-- `N` decides `L` in time `T` with success threshold `p(|x|)`: every branch halts within
`T(|x|)` steps and `Pr[N(x) = L(x)] ≥ p(|x|)`. [AB09, Def 7.2 and Lemma 7.9] -/
def BPDecidesInTimeWith (N : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℚ) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x : List Bool, N.tm.HaltsWithin x (T x.length) ∧
    p x.length ≤ N.outputProb x (T x.length) [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]

/-- `BPDecidesInTime` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem bpDecidesInTime_iff_with {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ} :
    N.BPDecidesInTime L T ↔ N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L T fun _ => 2/3 := Iff.rfl

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-- `BPP` with success threshold `p(|x|)`: bounded-error PTMs in time `K·(n^e + 1)`.
[AB09, Lemma 7.9] -/
def BPP_PTMWith (p : ℕ → ℚ) : Set (Language Bool) :=
  ⋃ e : ℕ, {L | ∃ (K : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool),
    N.BPDecidesInTimeWith L (fun n => K * (n ^ e + 1)) p}

/-- `BPP_PTM` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem BPP_PTM_eq_BPP_PTMWith : BPP_PTM = BPP_PTMWith fun _ => 2/3 := rfl

/-- The certificate form of `BPP_PTMWith p` over polynomial-time verifiers. -/
def InBPPWith (p : ℕ → ℚ) (L : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (a k : ℕ),
    polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M) ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      (x ∈ L → p x.length ≤ randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => M x r = true) ∧
      (x ∉ L → p x.length ≤ randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => M x r = false)

/-- `InBPP polyTimeModel` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem inBPPWith_iff_inBPP (L : Language Bool) :
    InBPPWith (fun _ => 2/3) L ↔ InBPP polyTimeModel L := Iff.rfl

/-- **Def 7.2 ⇒ Def 7.3 at threshold `p`**: a polynomial-time PTM yields a polynomial-time
verifier reading its coins as the random string. [AB09, p. 126]

**Proof sketch.** If `N` runs in time `T(n) = c(n^e + 1)`, take `M(x, r) = [x ++ r ∈ V]` with
`V` the choice-word verifier of `exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P` at length `Q = 2c(n+1)^e ≥ T`
(`choiceBudget_le`).  On a `Q`-bit word, `M` accepts iff `N` outputs `[true]` under its first
`T` coins (`append_mem_iff_outputWith_take`), so `randProb_take` turns `Pr[M = 1]` into
`Pr[N(x) = 1]`, and `Pr[M = 0] ≥ Pr[N(x) = 0]`. -/
theorem inBPPWith_of_mem_BPP_PTMWith {p : ℕ → ℚ} {L : Language Bool}
    (h : L ∈ BPP_PTMWith p) : InBPPWith p L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨V, hVP, hV⟩ := exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P N (2 * c) e
  refine ⟨fun x r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r), 2 * c, e, eff_append_mem hVP, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hprob⟩ := hN x
  have hTQ : c * (x.length ^ e + 1) ≤ polyLen (2 * c) e x.length := choiceBudget_le c e _
  have hVx : ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = polyLen (2 * c) e x.length → _ := fun u => hV x u
  have htrue := randProb_choiceVerifier hVx hhalt hTQ
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
  · exact le_of_le_of_eq (by simpa [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using hprob) htrue.symm
  · have hfalse : N.outputProb x (c * (x.length ^ e + 1)) [false] ≤
        randProb (polyLen (2 * c) e x.length)
          fun r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r) = false := by
      unfold FinNDTM.outputProb
      rw [← randProb_take hTQ fun w => N.outputWith x w = [false]]
      refine randProb_mono fun r hr => ?_
      rw [indicator_eq_false_iff,
        append_mem_iff_outputWith_take hVx hhalt hTQ _ List.length_ofFn, hr]
      decide
    refine le_trans ?_ hfalse
    simpa [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using hprob

/-- **Def 7.2 ⇒ Def 7.3** (`BPP`), the threshold-`2/3` case of
`inBPPWith_of_mem_BPP_PTMWith`. [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM {L : Language Bool} (h : L ∈ BPP_PTM) :
    InBPP polyTimeModel L :=
  inBPPWith_of_mem_BPP_PTMWith (p := fun _ => 2/3) h

/-! ### PTMs from certificate verifiers -/

/-- **Def 7.3 ⇒ Def 7.2, the machine structure**: a polynomial-time verifier `M` with
`polyLen a k` random bits is simulated by a PTM running in time `K·(n^e + 1)` whose output on a
coin word `w` is `[M(x, u)]`, `u` the projection of the slice `w[s, s + |mask|)` onto the
`polyLen a k |x|` marked positions of `mask` (so `|u| = polyLen a k |x|`).

**Proof sketch.** Let `V = {y | y = x ++ u, |u| = a(|x|+1)^k, ⟨x, u⟩ ∈ V₁} ∈ P`, recovered by
`computesFunInTime_splitSolve`; `exists_maskSelect_host` gives a PTM whose verdict is `V(x ++ u)`
with `u` such a projection. -/
theorem exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {a k : ℕ}
    (hM : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M)) :
    ∃ (K e : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ (s : ℕ) (mask : List Bool),
      (mask.filter id).length = polyLen a k x.length ∧
      s + mask.length ≤ K * (x.length ^ e + 1) ∧
      ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = K * (x.length ^ e + 1) →
        (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        N.outputWith x w = [M x (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length))] ∧
        (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length)).length = polyLen a k x.length := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V₁, V₀, hV₁, -, hMV⟩ := hM
  let sp : List Bool → List Bool := fun w => match solveSplit a k w.length with
    | some i => Turing.pairEncode (w.take i) (w.drop i)
    | none => []
  have hsp : PolyTimeComputable sp := by
    obtain ⟨S, c, hS⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve a k
    exact ⟨S, c, k + 2, hS⟩
  have hVP : sp ⁻¹' V₁ ∈ P := preimage_mem_P hV₁ hsp
  have hsplit : ∀ x u : List Bool, u.length = polyLen a k x.length →
      MultiTapeTM.indicator (sp ⁻¹' V₁) (x ++ u) = M x u := by
    intro x u hu
    have hs : sp (x ++ u) = Turing.pairEncode x u := by
      simp only [sp, List.length_append, hu, polyLen, Meyer.solveSplit_self', List.take_left',
        List.drop_left']
    have hiff : M x u = true ↔ Turing.pairEncode x u ∈ V₁ := by
      simpa only [boolVerifier, Option.some.injEq] using (hMV x u).1
    cases hb : M x u
    · have : x ++ u ∉ sp ⁻¹' V₁ := by
        rw [Set.mem_preimage, hs, ← hiff, hb]
        decide
      simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, this]
    · have : x ++ u ∈ sp ⁻¹' V₁ := by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hs, ← hiff, hb]
      simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, this]
  obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_maskSelect_host (sp ⁻¹' V₁) hVP a k
  refine ⟨K, e, N, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, mask, hcount, hle, hrun⟩ := hN x
  have hsel : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = K * (x.length ^ e + 1) →
      (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length)).length = polyLen a k x.length := by
    intro w hw
    rw [length_maskSelect _ _ (List.length_take_of_le (by rw [List.length_drop]; omega)),
      hcount]
    rfl
  refine ⟨s, mask, hcount, hle, fun w hw => ⟨(hrun w hw).1, ?_, hsel w hw⟩⟩
  rw [FinNDTM.outputWith, (hrun w hw).2, hsplit x _ (hsel w hw)]

/-- **Def 7.3 ⇒ Def 7.2, the machine**: a polynomial-time verifier `M` with `polyLen a k`
random bits is simulated by a PTM running in time `K·(n^e + 1)` whose output on every branch
is `[M(x, u)]` for a `polyLen a k |x|`-bit word `u`, and whose output distribution is that of
`M(x, ·)`.

**Proof sketch.** The machine of `exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff`; a coordinate projection of
a slice of uniform coins is uniform (`randProb_maskSelect_drop_take`). -/
theorem exists_FinNDTM_of_eff {M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool} {a k : ℕ}
    (hM : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M)) :
    ∃ (K e : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), ∀ x : List Bool,
      N.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) ∧
      (∀ b : Bool, N.outputProb x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) [b] =
        randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun u => M x u = b) ∧
      ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = K * (x.length ^ e + 1) →
        ∃ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool, N.outputWith x w = [M x (List.ofFn r)] := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_FinNDTM_maskSelect_of_eff (a := a) (k := k) hM
  refine ⟨K, e, N, fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, mask, hcount, hle, hrun⟩ := hN x
  refine ⟨fun w hw => (hrun w hw).1, fun b => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  · unfold FinNDTM.outputProb
    rw [randProb_congr (B := fun w => M x (maskSelect mask ((w.drop s).take mask.length)) = b)
      fun r => by rw [(hrun _ List.length_ofFn).2.1, List.singleton_inj]]
    refine (randProb_maskSelect_drop_take mask hle (fun u => M x u = b)).trans ?_
    rw [hcount]
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_ofFn_eq (hrun w hw).2.2
    exact ⟨r, by rw [(hrun w hw).2.1, hr]⟩

/-- **Def 7.3 ⇒ Def 7.2 at threshold `p`.** [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem mem_BPP_PTMWith_of_inBPPWith {p : ℕ → ℚ} {L : Language Bool}
    (h : InBPPWith p L) : L ∈ BPP_PTMWith p := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hM, hL⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_FinNDTM_of_eff (a := a) (k := k) hM
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, K, N, fun x => ⟨(hN x).1, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [(hN x).2.1]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ L
  · simpa [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using (hL x).1 hx
  · simpa [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using (hL x).2 hx

/-- **PTM and certificate `BPP` agree at every threshold.** [AB09, Def 7.2 ≡ Def 7.3] -/
theorem mem_BPP_PTMWith_iff (p : ℕ → ℚ) (L : Language Bool) :
    L ∈ BPP_PTMWith p ↔ InBPPWith p L :=
  ⟨inBPPWith_of_mem_BPP_PTMWith, mem_BPP_PTMWith_of_inBPPWith⟩

/-- **Def 7.3 ⇒ Def 7.2** (`BPP`), the threshold-`2/3` case of
`mem_BPP_PTMWith_of_inBPPWith`. [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem mem_BPP_PTM_of_inBPP {L : Language Bool} (h : InBPP polyTimeModel L) :
    L ∈ BPP_PTM :=
  mem_BPP_PTMWith_of_inBPPWith (p := fun _ => 2/3) h

/-- **[AB09, Def 7.2 ≡ Def 7.3]**: the PTM class `BPP` is the certificate class over
polynomial-time verifiers. -/
theorem mem_BPP_PTM_iff (L : Language Bool) : L ∈ BPP_PTM ↔ InBPP polyTimeModel L :=
  mem_BPP_PTMWith_iff (fun _ => 2/3) L

/-- `BPP_PTM` as a set of languages. -/
theorem BPP_PTM_eq : BPP_PTM = {L | InBPP polyTimeModel L} :=
  Set.ext mem_BPP_PTM_iff

end Randomized

/-! ### `RP` with a general acceptance threshold -/

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

/-- `N` decides `L` in time `T` with one-sided error and acceptance threshold `p(|x|)`: every
branch halts within `T(|x|)` steps, members are accepted with probability at least `p(|x|)`,
and on non-members every branch outputs `0`. The threshold `p` is meant to be positive (at
`p = 0` every language qualifies). [AB09, Def 7.6 and Ex 7.4] -/
def RDecidesInTimeWith (N : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) (p : ℕ → ℚ) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x : List Bool, N.tm.HaltsWithin x (T x.length) ∧
    (x ∈ L → p x.length ≤ N.outputProb x (T x.length) [true]) ∧
    (x ∉ L → ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = T x.length → N.outputWith x w = [false])

/-- `RDecidesInTime` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem rDecidesInTime_iff {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool} {T : ℕ → ℕ} :
    N.RDecidesInTime L T ↔ N.RDecidesInTimeWith L T fun _ => 2/3 := Iff.rfl

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-- `RP` with acceptance threshold `p(|x|)` (meant positive): one-sided-error PTMs in time
`K·(n^e + 1)`. [AB09, Ex 7.4] -/
def RP_PTMWith (p : ℕ → ℚ) : Set (Language Bool) :=
  ⋃ e : ℕ, {L | ∃ (K : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool),
    N.RDecidesInTimeWith L (fun n => K * (n ^ e + 1)) p}

/-- `RP_PTM` is the threshold-`2/3` case. -/
theorem RP_PTM_eq_RP_PTMWith : RP_PTM = RP_PTMWith fun _ => 2/3 := rfl

/-- The certificate form of `RP_PTMWith p` over polynomial-time verifiers. -/
def InRPWith (p : ℕ → ℚ) (L : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ (M : List Bool → List Bool → Bool) (a k : ℕ),
    polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier M) ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool,
      (x ∈ L → p x.length ≤ randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun r => M x r = true) ∧
      (x ∉ L → ∀ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool, M x (List.ofFn r) = false)

/-- **PTM and certificate `RP` agree at every threshold.** [AB09, Def 7.6, p. 131]

**Proof sketch.** Forward as `inBPPWith_of_mem_BPP_PTMWith`; a non-member's coin word outputs
`[false]` under its first `T` coins, so the verifier rejects it.  Backward by
`exists_FinNDTM_of_eff`: every branch outputs `[M(x, u)]` for some `polyLen a k |x|`-bit `u`,
which is `0` on non-members, and the acceptance probabilities agree. -/
theorem mem_RP_PTMWith_iff (p : ℕ → ℚ) (L : Language Bool) :
    L ∈ RP_PTMWith p ↔ InRPWith p L := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
    obtain ⟨V, hVP, hV⟩ := exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P N (2 * c) e
    refine ⟨fun x r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r), 2 * c, e, eff_append_mem hVP, fun x => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hhalt, hin, hout⟩ := hN x
    have hTQ : c * (x.length ^ e + 1) ≤ polyLen (2 * c) e x.length := choiceBudget_le c e _
    have hVx : ∀ u : List Bool, u.length = polyLen (2 * c) e x.length → _ := fun u => hV x u
    refine ⟨fun hx => le_of_le_of_eq (hin hx) (randProb_choiceVerifier hVx hhalt hTQ).symm,
      fun hx r => ?_⟩
    rw [indicator_eq_false_iff, append_mem_iff_outputWith_take hVx hhalt hTQ _ List.length_ofFn,
      hout hx _ (List.length_take_of_le (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hTQ))]
    decide
  · rintro ⟨M, a, k, hM, hL⟩
    obtain ⟨K, e, N, hN⟩ := exists_FinNDTM_of_eff (a := a) (k := k) hM
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, K, N, fun x => ⟨(hN x).1, fun hx => ?_, fun hx w hw => ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [(hN x).2.1]
      exact (hL x).1 hx
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (hN x).2.2 w hw
      rw [hr, (hL x).2 hx r]

/-- **[AB09, Def 7.6]**: the PTM class `RP` is the certificate class over polynomial-time
verifiers. -/
theorem mem_RP_PTM_iff (L : Language Bool) : L ∈ RP_PTM ↔ InRP polyTimeModel L := by
  rw [RP_PTM_eq_RP_PTMWith]
  exact mem_RP_PTMWith_iff _ L

/-- **[AB09, §7.3]**: the PTM class `coRP` is the certificate class over polynomial-time
verifiers. -/
theorem mem_coRP_PTM_iff (L : Language Bool) : L ∈ coRP_PTM ↔ InCoRP polyTimeModel L :=
  mem_RP_PTM_iff Lᶜ

/-! ### PTM-form corollaries -/

/-- **`BPP ⊆ EXP`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 126] -/
theorem BPP_PTM_subset_EXP : BPP_PTM ⊆ EXP := fun _ h =>
  mem_EXP_of_inBPP_polyTimeModel (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM h)

/-- **`P = NP ⇒ BPP = P`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 135 and p. 140] -/
theorem BPP_PTM_eq_P_of_P_eq_NP (h : P = NP) : BPP_PTM = P :=
  Set.ext fun L => (mem_BPP_PTM_iff L).trans (inBPP_polyTimeModel_iff_mem_P_of_P_eq_NP h L)

/-- **Adleman: `BPP ⊆ P/poly`** (PTM form). [AB09, Thm 7.14] -/
theorem BPP_PTM_subset_PPoly : BPP_PTM ⊆ BoolCircuit.PPoly := fun L h =>
  (BoolCircuit.mem_PPoly_iff L).mpr (adleman_polyTime (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM h))

/-- **Sipser–Gács: `BPP ⊆ Σ₂ᵖ ∩ Π₂ᵖ`** (PTM form). [AB09, Thm 7.15] -/
theorem BPP_PTM_subset_SigmaP_two_inter_PiP_two : BPP_PTM ⊆ SigmaP 2 ∩ PiP 2 := fun _ h =>
  sipser_gacs_polyTime (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM h)

/-- **`BPP` is closed under `≤ₚ`** (PTM form). -/
theorem BPP_PTM_of_polyTimeReducible {L L' : Language Bool} (hred : L' ≤ₚ L)
    (h : L ∈ BPP_PTM) : L' ∈ BPP_PTM :=
  mem_BPP_PTM_of_inBPP (InBPP.of_polyTimeReducible hred (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM h))

/-- **`3SAT ∈ BPP ⇒ PH = Σ₂ᵖ`** (PTM form). [AB09, p. 135] -/
theorem PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_SAT3_mem_BPP_PTM (h : SAT3 ∈ BPP_PTM) : PH = SigmaP 2 :=
  PH_eq_SigmaP_two_of_inBPP_SAT3 (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_PTM h)

/-- **Error reduction for `RP`** (PTM form, [AB09, Ex 7.4]): a polynomial-time PTM accepting
members with probability `min (2/3) ((|x|+1)^{-c})` yields one accepting them with probability
`1 − 2^{-((|x|+1)^d + 1)}`. -/
theorem RP_PTMWith_error_reduction (c d : ℕ) :
    RP_PTMWith (fun n => min (2/3) (((n + 1 : ℚ) ^ c)⁻¹)) ⊆
      RP_PTMWith fun n => 1 - (1/2 : ℚ) ^ ((n + 1) ^ d + 1) := fun L h =>
  (mem_RP_PTMWith_iff _ L).mpr
    (rp_error_reduction_polyTime (c := c) ((mem_RP_PTMWith_iff _ L).mp h) d)

end Randomized
