import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ExpectedTime
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.PTMEquiv
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Reductions

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Expected-time PTM classes as certificate classes

The class-level consequences of [AB09, §7.4.2] and [AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)]: a PTM with
expected polynomial running time, cut at a polynomial number of steps, is a polynomial-time
verifier reading its coins as the random string (`Complexity.exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P`).
Hence `ZPP` (Def 7.7) and its abort form lie in the certificate class
`Randomized.InZPP polyTimeModel`, and so in `RP ∩ coRP` [AB09, Thm 7.8]; and expected-time
bounded error gives exactly `BPP`.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInExpTime`, `Randomized.BPP_ExpPTM` — bounded error in expected
  polynomial time [AB09, §7.4.2].

## Main results

* `Randomized.exists_eff_haltRun` — a PTM's halted output on polynomially many coins is a
  polynomial-time zero-error verifier.
* `Randomized.inZPP_of_mem_ZPP_PTM`, `Randomized.inZPP_of_mem_ZPPAbort_PTM`,
  `Randomized.ZPP_PTM_subset_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM`,
  `Randomized.ZPPAbort_PTM_subset_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM` — [AB09, Def 7.7, Ex 7.6, Thm 7.8].
* `Randomized.BPP_ExpPTM_eq_BPP_PTM` — [AB09, §7.4.2]: expected time gives the same `BPP`.

## Divergences

* "`Pr[M(x) = L(x)] ≥ 2/3`" for a machine that need not halt is read as the supremum over
  `t` of `Pr[halted within t steps with output L(x)]`, i.e. `∀ ε > 0, ∃ t, 2/3 - ε ≤ …`.
* The converse inclusions (`InZPP polyTimeModel ⊆ ZPP_PTM`, `RP ∩ coRP ⊆ ZPP_PTM`) need the
  restart host; they are `Randomized.inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM` and
  `Randomized.ZPP_PTM_eq_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM` in
  `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZPPHostsClasses`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

/-- `N` decides `L` with bounded error in expected time `T`: `E[T_{N,x}] ≤ T(|x|)`, and the
probability of halting with output `[L(x)]` (as a supremum over time) is at least `2/3`.
[AB09, §7.4.2] -/
def BPDecidesInExpTime (N : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (T : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : List Bool, N.ExpTimeLe x (T x.length) ∧ ∀ ε : ℚ, 0 < ε → ∃ t : ℕ,
    2 / 3 - ε ≤ Randomized.randProb t
      (fun w => N.haltRun x w = some [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x])

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Complexity Turing

/-- `BPP` with expected running time: `⋃_e {L | some PTM decides L with bounded error in
expected time c·(n^e + 1)}`. [AB09, §7.4.2] -/
def BPP_ExpPTM : Set (Language Bool) :=
  ⋃ e : ℕ, {L | ∃ (c : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), N.BPDecidesInExpTime L fun n => c * (n ^ e + 1)}

/-- The halted output of a PTM `N` on `polyLen A e |x|` coins is a polynomial-time zero-error
verifier: `M(x, r) = some b` iff `N` has halted on `x` under `r` with output `[b]`.

**Proof sketch.** `exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P` gives `P`-languages `V₁` for `N` and `V₀` for
`N.flipOutput` recognising "halted with output `[1]`" on `x ++ r`; for the flipped machine this
is "halted with output `[0]`". Let `M` answer `1` on `V₁`, else `0` on `V₀`, else nothing. Its
two answer sets are preimages of `V₁` and `V₀ \ V₁` under the polynomial-time map
`⟨x, r⟩ ↦ x ++ r`, hence in `P`. -/
theorem exists_eff_haltRun (N : FinNDTM Bool) (A e : ℕ) :
    ∃ M : List Bool → List Bool → Option Bool, polyTimeModel.Eff M ∧
      ∀ (x r : List Bool) (b : Bool), r.length = polyLen A e x.length →
        (M x r = some b ↔ N.haltRun x r = some [b]) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V₁, hV₁, h₁⟩ := exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P N A e
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀, h₀⟩ := exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P N.flipOutput A e
  set g : List Bool → List Bool := fun z => pairFstD z ++ pairSndD z
  have hg : PolyTimeComputable g :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.append polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
  refine ⟨fun x r => if x ++ r ∈ V₁ then some true else if x ++ r ∈ V₀ then some false else none,
    ⟨g ⁻¹' V₁, {z | z ∈ g ⁻¹' V₀ ∧ z ∈ (g ⁻¹' V₁)ᶜ}, preimage_mem_P hV₁ hg,
      inter_mem_P (preimage_mem_P hV₀ hg) (compl_mem_P (preimage_mem_P hV₁ hg)),
      fun x r => ?_⟩, fun x r b hr => ?_⟩
  · have hgx : g (pairEncode x r) = x ++ r := by
      simp [g, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
    show ((if x ++ r ∈ V₁ then some true else if x ++ r ∈ V₀ then some false else none) =
        some true ↔ g (pairEncode x r) ∈ V₁) ∧
      ((if x ++ r ∈ V₁ then some true else if x ++ r ∈ V₀ then some false else none) =
        some false ↔ g (pairEncode x r) ∈ V₀ ∧ g (pairEncode x r) ∉ V₁)
    rw [hgx]
    by_cases h1 : x ++ r ∈ V₁ <;> by_cases h0 : x ++ r ∈ V₀ <;> simp [h1, h0]
  · have h1 : x ++ r ∈ V₁ ↔ N.haltRun x r = some [true] :=
      (h₁ x r hr).trans FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff.symm
    have h0 : x ++ r ∈ V₀ ↔ N.haltRun x r = some [false] := by
      refine (h₀ x r hr).trans (FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff.symm.trans ?_)
      rw [FinNDTM.haltRun_flipOutput]
      cases N.haltRun x r with
      | none => simp
      | some o =>
        simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
        exact ⟨fun h => by simpa using congrArg (List.map not) h, fun h => by rw [h]; rfl⟩
    show (if x ++ r ∈ V₁ then some true else if x ++ r ∈ V₀ then some false else none) =
        some b ↔ _
    by_cases hv1 : x ++ r ∈ V₁
    · rw [if_pos hv1, h1.mp hv1]
      cases b <;> simp
    · rw [if_neg hv1]
      by_cases hv0 : x ++ r ∈ V₀
      · rw [if_pos hv0, h0.mp hv0]
        cases b <;> simp
      · rw [if_neg hv0]
        cases b
        · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp), fun h => absurd (h0.mpr h) hv0⟩
        · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp), fun h => absurd (h1.mpr h) hv1⟩

/-- **Expected-time `ZPP` in certificate form** [AB09, Def 7.7 and Exercise 7.6(a)]: a
zero-error PTM with expected time `c(n^e + 1)` gives an `InZPP polyTimeModel` verifier.

**Proof sketch.** Cut the run at `Q = 4c(|x|+1)^e ≥ 2c(|x|^e + 1)` steps (`choiceBudget_le`)
and use `exists_eff_haltRun`. By `ZDecidesInTime.truncate` every halted answer is `L(x)`,
and the run has halted with probability at least `1 - c(|x|^e+1)/Q ≥ 1/2`. -/
theorem inZPP_of_mem_ZPP_PTM {L : Language Bool} (h : L ∈ ZPP_PTM) :
    InZPP polyTimeModel L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨M, hEff, hM⟩ := exists_eff_haltRun N (4 * c) e
  refine ⟨M, 4 * c, e, hEff, fun x => ?_⟩
  set B := c * (x.length ^ e + 1)
  set Q := polyLen (4 * c) e x.length
  have hQ : 2 * B ≤ Q := by
    have := choiceBudget_le (2 * c) e x.length
    simp only [Q, B, polyLen] at this ⊢
    nlinarith [this]
  have hB1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ B := (hN x).1.one_le
  have hQpos : 0 < Q := by
    have : 1 ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast hB1
    omega
  obtain ⟨hcorr, hprob⟩ := hN.truncate x hQpos
  have hprob' : 1 - (B : ℚ) / Q ≤ randProb Q (fun w =>
      N.haltRun x w = some [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) := hprob
  have hhalf : (B : ℚ) / Q ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hQ' : (2 * B : ℚ) ≤ Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hQpos)]
    linarith
  have hspec : ∀ (r : Fin Q → Bool) (b : Bool), M x (List.ofFn r) = some b →
      b = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x := fun r b hb => by
    have := hcorr _ _ ((hM x _ b List.length_ofFn).mp hb)
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨fun hx r hr => ?_, fun hx r hr => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hspec r false hr
    simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] at this
  · have := hspec r true hr
    simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] at this
  · calc randProb Q (fun r => M x r = none)
        ≤ randProb Q (fun r => ¬ N.haltRun x r =
            some [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) :=
          randProb_mono fun r hr heq => by
            rw [← hM x _ _ List.length_ofFn, hr] at heq
            exact absurd heq (by simp)
      _ = 1 - randProb Q (fun r => N.haltRun x r =
            some [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) := randProb_not _
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith

/-- **Abort form ⊆ `InZPP`** [AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)]: a polynomial-time PTM with outputs in
`{0, 1, ?}`, never wrong and with `Pr[?] ≤ 1/2`, gives an `InZPP polyTimeModel` verifier.

**Proof sketch.** With `T = a(|x|^e + 1) ≤ Q = 2a(|x|+1)^e`, every branch has halted after
`Q` coins with the output of its first `T` coins. `exists_eff_haltRun` reads that output as
`some b` exactly when it is `[b]`; it is never `[¬L(x)]`, and `?` occurs only when the output
is not `[L(x)]`, which has probability at most `1/2` (`randProb_take`). -/
theorem inZPP_of_mem_ZPPAbort_PTM {L : Language Bool} (h : L ∈ ZPPAbort_PTM) :
    InZPP polyTimeModel L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, a, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨M, hEff, hM⟩ := exists_eff_haltRun N (2 * a) e
  refine ⟨M, 2 * a, e, hEff, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hNx := hN x
  dsimp only at hNx
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hwrong, hprob⟩ := hNx
  set T := a * (x.length ^ e + 1)
  set Q := polyLen (2 * a) e x.length
  set ℓ := MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x
  have hTQ : T ≤ Q := choiceBudget_le a e x.length
  have hrun : ∀ r : List Bool, r.length = Q →
      N.haltRun x r = some (N.outputWith x (r.take T)) := fun r hr => by
    have hle : T ≤ r.length := hr ▸ hTQ
    rw [FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff]
    refine ⟨hhalt.mono hle r rfl, ?_⟩
    unfold FinNDTM.outputWith
    rw [FinNDTM.runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hle]
  have hspec : ∀ (r : Fin Q → Bool) (b : Bool), M x (List.ofFn r) = some b → b = ℓ :=
    fun r b hb => by
      rw [hM x _ b List.length_ofFn, hrun _ List.length_ofFn, Option.some.injEq] at hb
      have := hwrong (List.take T (List.ofFn r))
        (List.length_take_of_le (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hTQ))
      rw [hb] at this
      cases b <;> cases hl : ℓ <;> simp_all
  refine ⟨fun hx r hr => ?_, fun hx r hr => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hspec r false hr
    simp [ℓ, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] at this
  · have := hspec r true hr
    simp [ℓ, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] at this
  · unfold FinNDTM.outputProb at hprob
    calc randProb Q (fun r => M x r = none)
        ≤ randProb Q (fun r => ¬ N.outputWith x (r.take T) = [ℓ]) :=
          randProb_mono fun r hr heq => by
            rw [← Option.some.injEq, ← hrun _ List.length_ofFn,
              ← hM x _ _ List.length_ofFn, hr] at heq
            exact absurd heq (by simp)
      _ = 1 - randProb Q (fun r => N.outputWith x (r.take T) = [ℓ]) := randProb_not _
      _ = 1 - randProb T (fun w => N.outputWith x w = [ℓ]) := by
          rw [randProb_take hTQ (fun w => N.outputWith x w = [ℓ])]
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith

/-- **`ZPP ⊆ RP ∩ coRP`** [AB09, Thm 7.8], PTM form. -/
theorem ZPP_PTM_subset_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM : ZPP_PTM ⊆ RP_PTM ∩ coRP_PTM := fun L h =>
  have hz := (zpp_eq_rp_inter_corp_polyTime L).mp (inZPP_of_mem_ZPP_PTM h)
  ⟨(mem_RP_PTM_iff L).mpr hz.1, (mem_coRP_PTM_iff L).mpr hz.2⟩

/-- The abort-form class lies in `RP ∩ coRP`. [AB09, Exercise 7.6] -/
theorem ZPPAbort_PTM_subset_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM : ZPPAbort_PTM ⊆ RP_PTM ∩ coRP_PTM :=
  fun L h =>
  have hz := (zpp_eq_rp_inter_corp_polyTime L).mp (inZPP_of_mem_ZPPAbort_PTM h)
  ⟨(mem_RP_PTM_iff L).mpr hz.1, (mem_coRP_PTM_iff L).mpr hz.2⟩

/-- **Expected time ⇒ `BPP`** [AB09, §7.4.2]: a bounded-error PTM with expected time
`c(n^e + 1)` gives an `InBPP polyTimeModel` verifier.

**Proof sketch.** With `B = c(|x|^e + 1)` and `Q = 200c(|x|+1)^e ≥ 100 B`, Markov truncation
(`haltProb_le_truncate`, `haltProb_mono`) gives `Pr_Q[halted with L(x)] ≥ 2/3 - 1/100 ≥ 5/8`.
The choice-word verifier for `[1]` at length `Q` accepts exactly on those coins for `x ∈ L`
and rejects at least on them for `x ∉ L`; `InBPPAt.inBPP_of_5_8` amplifies to `2/3`. -/
theorem inBPP_of_mem_BPP_ExpPTM {L : Language Bool} (h : L ∈ BPP_ExpPTM) :
    InBPP polyTimeModel L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨V, hVP, hV⟩ := exists_choiceVerifier_mem_P N (200 * c) e
  refine InBPPAt.inBPP_of_5_8 polyTimeModel_closedUnderMajority
    ⟨fun x r => MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ r), 200 * c, e, eff_append_mem hVP, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hNx := hN x
  dsimp only at hNx
  obtain ⟨hexp, hlim⟩ := hNx
  set B := c * (x.length ^ e + 1)
  set Q := polyLen (200 * c) e x.length
  set ℓ := MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x
  have hBQ : 100 * B ≤ Q := by
    have := choiceBudget_le (100 * c) e x.length
    simp only [Q, B, polyLen] at this ⊢
    nlinarith [this]
  have hge : 5 / 8 ≤ randProb Q (fun w => N.haltRun x w = some [ℓ]) := by
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hlim (2 / 3 - 1 / 100 - 5 / 8) (by norm_num)
    have h1 := FinNDTM.haltProb_le_truncate hexp [ℓ] t
    have h2 := FinNDTM.haltProb_mono (N := N) (x := x) [ℓ] hBQ
    linarith
  have hacc : ∀ r : Fin Q → Bool, MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ List.ofFn r) = true ↔
      N.haltRun x (List.ofFn r) = some [true] := fun r => by
    rw [indicator_eq_true_iff]
    exact (hV x _ List.length_ofFn).trans FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff.symm
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
  · refine le_trans hge (randProb_mono fun r hr => (hacc r).mpr ?_)
    simpa [ℓ, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using hr
  · refine le_trans hge (randProb_mono fun r hr => ?_)
    have hf : N.haltRun x (List.ofFn r) = some [false] := by
      simpa [ℓ, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx] using hr
    show MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ List.ofFn r) = false
    cases hi : MultiTapeTM.indicator V (x ++ List.ofFn r)
    · rfl
    · rw [(hacc r).mp hi] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)

/-- A worst-case bounded-error PTM is an expected-time one. [AB09, §7.4.2] -/
theorem BPP_PTM_subset_BPP_ExpPTM : BPP_PTM ⊆ BPP_ExpPTM := by
  intro L h
  obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e, c, N, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hNx := hN x
  dsimp only at hNx
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hprob⟩ := hNx
  refine ⟨FinNDTM.expTimeLe_of_haltsWithin hhalt, fun ε hε => ⟨c * (x.length ^ e + 1), ?_⟩⟩
  have heq : randProb (c * (x.length ^ e + 1)) (fun w => N.haltRun x w =
      some [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) =
      N.outputProb x (c * (x.length ^ e + 1)) [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x] :=
    randProb_congr fun r => by
      rw [FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hhalt _ List.length_ofFn, h⟩⟩
  rw [heq]
  linarith

/-- **Expected time gives the same `BPP`** [AB09, §7.4.2]. -/
theorem BPP_ExpPTM_eq_BPP_PTM : BPP_ExpPTM = BPP_PTM :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (fun _ h => (mem_BPP_PTM_iff _).mpr (inBPP_of_mem_BPP_ExpPTM h))
    BPP_PTM_subset_BPP_ExpPTM

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDClockHostRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZPPEquiv

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Zero-error machines from the clocked restart host

The probabilistic contracts of the clocked restart host `Turing.FinNDTM.clockHost`
(`TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.NDClockHostRun`) on a PTM `A`: run `A` against a clock
of `m` coins and accept only a one-bit answer.

* With restarts, if every answer is correct and an attempt fails with probability at most
  `3/4`, the host decides with zero error in expected time `s₀ + 16(m + 1)`
  [AB09, Def 7.7 and Exercise 7.6(a)].
* Without restarts, if `A` answers correctly with probability at least `1/2` within `m` coins,
  the host is an abort-form decider [AB09, §7.4.2 and Exercise 7.6(a)].

The expected-time bound is a renewal argument on finite coin words: a round of fixed length
`R` either halts or returns to a ready configuration, so `Pr[T > s₀ + jR] ≤ a^j`.

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.attemptBit` — the one-bit answer of a PTM after a number of coins.

## Main results

* `Randomized.randProb_rounds_le`, `Randomized.halted_rounds` — the renewal bounds.
* `Turing.FinNDTM.expTimeLe_of_rounds` — `E[T] ≤ s₀ + R / (1 - a)`.
* `Randomized.clockHost_zDecides`, `Randomized.clockHost_abortDecides` — the two hosts.
* `Turing.FinNDTM.ZDecidesInTime.mono`, `Turing.FinNDTM.AbortDecidesInTime.mono`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Finset Turing

/-! ### Renewal over rounds of fixed length -/

variable {k : ℕ} {St : Type} [DecidableEq St] {x : List Bool}

/-- **Renewal, halting**: if every round of `R` coins from a ready configuration either halts
or ends ready, and fails to halt with probability at most `a`, then `j` rounds fail to halt
with probability at most `a^j`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `j`, conditioning on the first round
(`randProb_append_le`): a halted round stays halted, and a ready one contributes `a^j`. -/
theorem randProb_rounds_le (tm : NDTM k Bool St) (Ready : Cfg k Bool St x → Prop) (R : ℕ)
    {a : ℚ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hstep : ∀ c, Ready c → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = R →
      (tm.runWith p c).state = none ∨ Ready (tm.runWith p c))
    (hprob : ∀ c, Ready c → randProb R (fun p => (tm.runWith p c).state ≠ none) ≤ a)
    (j : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool St x) (hc : Ready c) :
    randProb (R * j) (fun w => (tm.runWith w c).state ≠ none) ≤ a ^ j := by
  induction j generalizing c with
  | zero => simpa using (randProb_le_one : randProb 0 (fun w => (tm.runWith w c).state ≠ none) ≤ 1)
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [show R * (j + 1) = R + R * j by ring, pow_succ, mul_comm (a ^ j) a]
    rw [randProb_congr (B := fun r => (tm.runWith (r.drop R) (tm.runWith (r.take R) c)).state ≠
      none) fun r => by
        show _ ↔ (tm.runWith ((List.ofFn r).drop R) (tm.runWith ((List.ofFn r).take R) c)).state ≠
          none
        rw [← NDTM.runWith_append, List.take_append_drop]]
    refine (randProb_append_le R (R * j) (fun p => (tm.runWith p c).state ≠ none)
      (fun p v => (tm.runWith v (tm.runWith p c)).state ≠ none) ?_ ?_).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hprob c hc) (pow_nonneg ha j))
    · intro p v hv hp
      exact hv (by rw [NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ hp]; exact hp)
    · intro u hu
      rcases hstep c hc _ List.length_ofFn with h | h
      · exact absurd h hu
      · exact ih _ h

omit [DecidableEq St] in
/-- **Renewal, answers**: if every round from a ready configuration either halts in a
configuration satisfying `P` or ends ready, and ready configurations are live, then every run
of whole rounds that has halted satisfies `P`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the number of rounds: split off the first round; if it halted,
later coins change nothing, otherwise it ended ready. -/
theorem halted_rounds (tm : NDTM k Bool St) (Ready P : Cfg k Bool St x → Prop) (R : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ c, Ready c → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = R →
      ((tm.runWith p c).state = none ∧ P (tm.runWith p c)) ∨ Ready (tm.runWith p c))
    (hlive : ∀ c, Ready c → c.state ≠ none) (j : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool St x) (hc : Ready c)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = R * j) (hh : (tm.runWith w c).state = none) :
    P (tm.runWith w c) := by
  induction j generalizing c w with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.mul_zero, List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hw
    subst hw
    exact absurd hh (hlive c hc)
  | succ j ih =>
    have ht : (w.take R).length = R :=
      List.length_take_of_le (by rw [hw]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right R (Nat.succ_pos j))
    rw [← List.take_append_drop R w, NDTM.runWith_append] at hh ⊢
    rcases hstep c hc _ ht with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | h
    · rw [NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ h1]; exact h2
    · exact ih _ h _ (by rw [List.length_drop, hw, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel]) hh

end Randomized

namespace Turing.FinNDTM

open Finset Randomized

/-- **Expected time from rounds**: if a startup of `s₀` steps always reaches `c₀`, and `j`
rounds of `R > 0` coins from `c₀` fail to halt with probability at most `a^j` (`a < 1`), then
`E[T_{N,x}] ≤ s₀ + R/(1 - a)`. [AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)]

**Proof sketch.** `Pr[T > s₀ + jR] ≤ a^j`, since the startup ignores its coins
(`randProb_split`). Bound `Pr[T > t]` by `1` for `t < s₀`, and by antitonicity by `a^j` on the
`j`-th block of `R` steps after `s₀`; sum the geometric series. -/
theorem expTimeLe_of_rounds (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s₀ R : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (c₀ : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x)
    (hstart : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = s₀ → N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) = c₀)
    {a : ℚ} (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hround : ∀ j, randProb (R * j) (fun w => (N.tm.runWith w c₀).state ≠ none) ≤ a ^ j) :
    N.ExpTimeLe x (s₀ + R / (1 - a)) := by
  set f := notHaltedProb (N.haltRun x)
  have hf1 : ∀ t, f t ≤ 1 := fun t => notHaltedProb_le_one t
  have hf0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ f t := fun t => notHaltedProb_nonneg t
  have hblock : ∀ j, f (s₀ + R * j) ≤ a ^ j := by
    intro j
    have : f (s₀ + R * j) = randProb (s₀ + R * j) (fun r => True ∧
        (N.tm.runWith (r.drop s₀) c₀).state ≠ none) := by
      refine randProb_congr fun r => ?_
      have hl : ((List.ofFn r).take s₀).length = s₀ :=
        List.length_take_of_le (by simp)
      have hrun : N.tm.runWith (List.ofFn r) (N.tm.initCfg x) =
          N.tm.runWith ((List.ofFn r).drop s₀) c₀ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop s₀ (List.ofFn r)]
        rw [NDTM.runWith_append, hstart _ hl]
      rw [haltRun_eq_none_iff, hrun]
      simp
    rw [this, randProb_split s₀ (R * j) (fun _ => True)
      (fun v => (N.tm.runWith v c₀).state ≠ none), randProb_true, one_mul]
    exact hround j
  have hanti : Antitone f := notHaltedProb_haltRun_antitone N x
  have hsum : ∀ n, ∑ t ∈ range (R * n), f (s₀ + t) ≤ R * ∑ j ∈ range n, a ^ j := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [show R * (n + 1) = R * n + R by ring, sum_range_add, sum_range_succ, mul_add]
      refine add_le_add ih ?_
      calc ∑ r ∈ range R, f (s₀ + (R * n + r))
          ≤ ∑ _r ∈ range R, a ^ n := sum_le_sum fun r _ =>
            (hanti (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_add_right _ _) _ :
              s₀ + R * n ≤ s₀ + (R * n + r))).trans (hblock n)
        _ = R * a ^ n := by simp
  have hgeom : ∀ K, ∑ j ∈ range K, a ^ j ≤ 1 / (1 - a) := by
    intro K
    have := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one ha0 ha1 (m := 0) (n := K)
    rwa [← range_eq_Ico, pow_zero] at this
  intro K
  calc ∑ t ∈ range K, f t
      ≤ ∑ t ∈ range (s₀ + R * K), f t :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (range_mono (le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left K hR) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)))
          fun _ _ _ => hf0 _
    _ = ∑ t ∈ range s₀, f t + ∑ t ∈ range (R * K), f (s₀ + t) := sum_range_add _ _ _
    _ ≤ s₀ + R * (1 / (1 - a)) := by
        refine add_le_add ?_ ((hsum K).trans ?_)
        · calc ∑ t ∈ range s₀, f t ≤ ∑ _t ∈ range s₀, (1 : ℚ) := sum_le_sum fun t _ => hf1 t
            _ = s₀ := by simp
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgeom K) (by positivity)
    _ = s₀ + R / (1 - a) := by ring

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {L : Language Bool}

/-- Zero-error deciding is monotone in the time bound. -/
theorem ZDecidesInTime.mono {T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (h : N.ZDecidesInTime L T₁)
    (hT : ∀ n, T₁ n ≤ T₂ n) : N.ZDecidesInTime L T₂ :=
  fun x => ⟨fun K => ((h x).1 K).trans (by exact_mod_cast hT _), (h x).2⟩

/-- Abort-form deciding is monotone in the time bound. -/
theorem AbortDecidesInTime.mono {T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (h : N.AbortDecidesInTime L T₁)
    (hT : ∀ n, T₁ n ≤ T₂ n) : N.AbortDecidesInTime L T₂ := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hwrong, hprob⟩ := h x
  refine ⟨hhalt.mono (hT _), fun w hw => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : T₁ x.length ≤ w.length := hw ▸ hT _
    unfold outputWith
    rw [runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hle]
    exact hwrong _ (List.length_take_of_le hle)
  · rw [outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin hhalt (hT _)]
    exact hprob

end Turing.FinNDTM

namespace Randomized

open Turing Turing.ClockHost

/-- The one-bit answer of the PTM `A` on `x` after the coins `u`: `some v` if it has halted
with output `[v]`, else `none`. -/
def attemptBit (A : FinNDTM Bool) (x u : List Bool) : Option Bool :=
  (A.haltRun x u).bind FinNDTM.bitOfOutput

/-- `attemptBit` reads a halted one-bit output. -/
theorem attemptBit_eq_some {A : FinNDTM Bool} {x u : List Bool} {v : Bool} :
    attemptBit A x u = some v ↔ (A.tm.runWith u (A.tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
      (A.tm.runWith u (A.tm.initCfg x)).output = [v] := by
  unfold attemptBit
  cases h : A.haltRun x u with
  | none =>
    rw [FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_none_iff] at h
    simp only [Option.bind_none]
    exact ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by simp), fun h' => absurd h'.1 h⟩
  | some o =>
    rw [FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    simp only [Option.bind_some, h1, true_and, FinNDTM.outputWith] at h2 ⊢
    rw [h2]
    rcases o with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨b', o⟩⟩ <;> simp [FinNDTM.bitOfOutput]

/-- **The restart host decides with zero error** [AB09, Def 7.7 and Exercise 7.6(a)]: let `S`
compute `1^{m(n)}` in time `T_S(n)` with `n ≤ m(n)`, and let every one-bit answer of `A` within
`m` coins be `L(x)`, with no answer with probability at most `3/4`. Then the restart host
decides `L` with zero error in expected time `T_S(n) + m(n) + 2 + 16(m(n) + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.** After the startup (`startup`), the host performs rounds of `4(m + 1)` coins
(`round`): each halts with `A`'s answer on its first `m` coins, which is `L(x)`, or ends ready.
A round fails to halt only if `A` gives no answer, with probability at most `3/4`
(`randProb_take`). Renewal (`randProb_rounds_le`, `expTimeLe_of_rounds`) bounds the expected
time; `halted_rounds`, after padding a halted run to whole rounds, gives correctness. -/
theorem clockHost_zDecides (S : FinTM Bool) (A : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool)
    (m TS : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hS : S.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (m x.length) true) TS)
    (hm : ∀ n, n ≤ m n)
    (hcorr : ∀ x u v, u.length = m x.length → attemptBit A x u = some v →
      v = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)
    (hprob : ∀ x : List Bool, randProb (m x.length) (fun u => attemptBit A x u = none) ≤ 3 / 4) :
    (FinNDTM.clockHost S A true).ZDecidesInTime L
      fun n => TS n + m n + 2 + 16 * (m n + 1) := by
  classical
  intro x
  set mm := m x.length with hmm
  set ℓ := MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, sT, sP, hstart⟩ :=
    startup (A := A) (loop := true) mm (hS x) (hm _)
  set c₀ := runCfg (S := S) mm (A.tm.initCfg x) 0 sT sP
  have hc₀ : ClockReady mm c₀ := ⟨_, _, _, readyAt_initCfg mm, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R, R = 4 * (mm + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsucc : ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = R → ∀ v, attemptBit A x (p.take mm) = some v →
      ∀ (c : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x), ClockReady mm c →
        ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).state = none ∧
        ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).output = [ℓ] := by
    intro p hp v hv c hc
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := attemptBit_eq_some.mp hv
    have hvℓ : v = ℓ := hcorr x _ v (List.length_take_of_le (by omega)) hv
    rw [hvℓ] at h2
    exact (round mm hc (hm _) p (hp.trans hR)).1 ℓ h1 h2
  have hfail : ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = R → attemptBit A x (p.take mm) = none →
      ∀ (c : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x), ClockReady mm c →
        ClockReady mm ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c) := by
    intro p hp hn c hc
    refine (round mm hc (hm _) p (hp.trans hR)).2 fun ⟨h1, v, h2⟩ => ?_
    rw [attemptBit_eq_some.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩] at hn
    exact absurd hn (by simp)
  have hstep : ∀ (c : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x),
      ClockReady mm c → ∀ p : List Bool, p.length = R →
      (((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).state = none ∧
        ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).output = [ℓ]) ∨
      ClockReady mm ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c) := by
    intro c hc p hp
    cases hb : attemptBit A x (p.take mm) with
    | none => exact Or.inr (hfail p hp hb c hc)
    | some v => exact Or.inl (hsucc p hp v hb c hc)
  have hprobR : ∀ (c : Cfg (S.k + A.k + 1) Bool (ClockPhase S.State A.State) x), ClockReady mm c →
      randProb R (fun p => ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).state ≠ none) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    intro c hc
    calc randProb R (fun p => ((hostTM S A true).runWith p c).state ≠ none)
        ≤ randProb R (fun p => attemptBit A x (p.take mm) = none) := randProb_mono fun r hr => by
          cases hb : attemptBit A x ((List.ofFn r).take mm) with
          | none => rfl
          | some v => exact absurd (hsucc _ List.length_ofFn v hb c hc).1 hr
      _ = randProb mm (fun u => attemptBit A x u = none) :=
          randProb_take (by omega) (fun u => attemptBit A x u = none)
      _ ≤ 3 / 4 := hprob x
  refine ⟨?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
  · have hexp := FinNDTM.expTimeLe_of_rounds (FinNDTM.clockHost S A true) x s₀ R (by omega) c₀
      hstart (a := 3 / 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun j =>
        randProb_rounds_le (hostTM S A true) (ClockReady mm) R (by norm_num)
          (fun c hc p hp => (hstep c hc p hp).imp_left And.left) hprobR j c₀ hc₀
    intro K
    refine (hexp K).trans ?_
    have h4 : ((R : ℕ) : ℚ) / (1 - 3 / 4) = 16 * ((mm : ℚ) + 1) := by
      rw [hR]; push_cast; ring
    have hs : (s₀ : ℚ) ≤ TS x.length + mm + 2 := by exact_mod_cast hs₀
    rw [h4]
    push_cast
    linarith
  · -- pad the halted run to whole rounds after the startup
    have hle : w.length ≤ s₀ + R * w.length :=
      le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
    set w' := w ++ List.replicate (s₀ + R * w.length - w.length) false with hw'
    have hlen : w'.length = s₀ + R * w.length := by
      rw [hw', List.length_append, List.length_replicate, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle]
    have hrun : (hostTM S A true).runWith w' ((hostTM S A true).initCfg x) =
        (hostTM S A true).runWith w ((hostTM S A true).initCfg x) := by
      rw [hw', NDTM.runWith_append]
      exact NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ hw
    have hsplit : (hostTM S A true).runWith w' ((hostTM S A true).initCfg x) =
        (hostTM S A true).runWith (w'.drop s₀) c₀ := by
      rw [← List.take_append_drop s₀ w', NDTM.runWith_append,
        hstart (w'.take s₀) (List.length_take_of_le (by rw [hlen]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _)),
        List.take_append_drop]
    have hh : ((hostTM S A true).runWith (w'.drop s₀) c₀).state = none := by
      rw [← hsplit, hrun]; exact hw
    have := halted_rounds (hostTM S A true) (ClockReady mm) (fun c => c.output = [ℓ]) R hstep
      (fun c hc => hc.state_ne_none mm) w.length c₀ hc₀ (w'.drop s₀)
      (by rw [List.length_drop, hlen, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]) hh
    show ((hostTM S A true).runWith w ((hostTM S A true).initCfg x)).output = [ℓ]
    rw [← hrun, hsplit]
    exact this

/-- **The clocked runner is an abort-form decider** [AB09, §7.4.2 and Exercise 7.6(a)]: let `S`
compute `1^{m(n)}` in time `T_S(n)` with `n ≤ m(n)`, let every one-bit answer of `A` within
`m` coins be `L(x)`, and let `A` answer `L(x)` with probability at least `1/2`. Then the
one-shot host halts within `T_S(n) + m(n) + 2 + (m(n) + 1)` steps on every branch, never
outputs `[¬L(x)]`, and outputs `[L(x)]` with probability at least `1/2`.

**Proof sketch.** After the startup (`startup`), `m + 1` more steps halt the host (`oneShot`),
with output `[v]` exactly when `A` answered `v` on the first `m` coins after the startup. Since
the startup ignores its coins, the output distribution is `A`'s (`randProb_split`,
`randProb_take`). -/
theorem clockHost_abortDecides (S : FinTM Bool) (A : FinNDTM Bool) (L : Language Bool)
    (m TS : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hS : S.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (m x.length) true) TS)
    (hm : ∀ n, n ≤ m n)
    (hcorr : ∀ x u v, u.length = m x.length → attemptBit A x u = some v →
      v = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)
    (hprob : ∀ x : List Bool, 1 / 2 ≤ randProb (m x.length)
      (fun u => attemptBit A x u = some (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x))) :
    (FinNDTM.clockHost S A false).AbortDecidesInTime L
      fun n => TS n + m n + 2 + (m n + 1) := by
  classical
  intro x
  set mm := m x.length with hmm
  set ℓ := MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, sT, sP, hstart⟩ :=
    startup (A := A) (loop := false) mm (hS x) (hm _)
  have hrun : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = s₀ + (mm + 1) →
      (hostTM S A false).runWith w ((hostTM S A false).initCfg x) =
        (hostTM S A false).runWith (w.drop s₀) (runCfg mm (A.tm.initCfg x) 0 sT sP) := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← List.take_append_drop s₀ w, NDTM.runWith_append,
      hstart (w.take s₀) (List.length_take_of_le (by omega)), List.take_append_drop]
  have hdrop : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = s₀ + (mm + 1) → (w.drop s₀).length = mm + 1 :=
    fun w hw => by rw [List.length_drop, hw]; omega
  have hhalt : (FinNDTM.clockHost S A false).tm.HaltsWithin x (s₀ + (mm + 1)) := fun w hw => by
    show ((hostTM S A false).runWith w ((hostTM S A false).initCfg x)).state = none
    rw [hrun w hw]
    exact (oneShot mm sT sP _ (hdrop w hw)).1
  have hout : ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = s₀ + (mm + 1) → ∀ v,
      (FinNDTM.clockHost S A false).outputWith x w = [v] ↔
        attemptBit A x ((w.drop s₀).take mm) = some v := by
    intro w hw v
    show ((hostTM S A false).runWith w ((hostTM S A false).initCfg x)).output = [v] ↔ _
    rw [hrun w hw, (oneShot mm sT sP _ (hdrop w hw)).2, attemptBit_eq_some]
  have hT' : s₀ + (mm + 1) ≤ TS x.length + mm + 2 + (mm + 1) := by omega
  refine ⟨hhalt.mono hT', fun w hw => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : s₀ + (mm + 1) ≤ w.length := by rw [hw]; exact hT'
    intro heq
    have h1 : (FinNDTM.clockHost S A false).outputWith x (w.take (s₀ + (mm + 1))) = [!ℓ] := by
      unfold FinNDTM.outputWith
      rw [← FinNDTM.runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hle]
      exact heq
    rw [hout _ (List.length_take_of_le hle)] at h1
    have hl1 : mm ≤ (List.drop s₀ (List.take (s₀ + (mm + 1)) w)).length := by
      rw [List.length_drop, List.length_take_of_le hle]
      omega
    have hbad : (!ℓ) = ℓ := hcorr x _ _ (List.length_take_of_le hl1) h1
    revert hbad
    generalize ℓ = b
    cases b <;> decide
  · rw [FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin hhalt hT']
    unfold FinNDTM.outputProb
    rw [randProb_congr (B := fun r => True ∧ attemptBit A x ((r.drop s₀).take mm) = some ℓ)
        fun r => by rw [hout _ List.length_ofFn]; simp,
      randProb_split s₀ (mm + 1) (fun _ => True) (fun u => attemptBit A x (u.take mm) = some ℓ),
      randProb_true, one_mul, randProb_take (by omega) (fun u => attemptBit A x u = some ℓ)]
    exact hprob x

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZPPHosts

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# ZPP: expected time, abort form, certificates, and RP ∩ coRP

The converse inclusions for the zero-error classes, at machine level, through the clocked
restart host (`Randomized.clockHost_zDecides`, `Randomized.clockHost_abortDecides`), and the
resulting equalities with the easy directions of `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZPPEquiv`.

* **§7.4.2** — a zero-error PTM with expected time `T`, run for `m ≥ 2T` steps with abort on
  timeout, is an abort-form decider.
* **Ex 7.6(a), ⇐** — a polynomial-time zero-error verifier gives a PTM attempt: one coin
  `b` selects the PTM of the Boolean verifier "`M` answers `b`"
  (`Randomized.exists_FinNDTM_of_eff`), whose `1` becomes the answer `b` and whose `0` becomes
  no answer. An attempt answers with probability at least `1/4`, always correctly; the restart
  host reruns it until it answers.

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.zppAttempt`, `Randomized.keepAs` — the one-coin attempt built from two PTMs.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinNDTM.ZDecidesInTime.exists_abortDecidesInTime` — [AB09, §7.4.2] at machine
  level.
* `Randomized.ZPP_PTM_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM`, `Randomized.inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM`,
  `Randomized.inZPP_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM`, `Randomized.mem_ZPP_PTM_iff`.
* `Randomized.ZPP_PTM_eq_setOf_inZPP`, `Randomized.ZPPAbort_PTM_eq_ZPP_PTM` —
  [AB09, Def 7.7 and Exercise 7.6(a)].
* `Randomized.ZPP_PTM_eq_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM` — [AB09, Theorem 7.8] for Def 7.7's `ZPP`.

## Divergences

* Ex 7.6(a)'s "repeat until an answer" reruns an attempt that answers with probability at
  least `1/4` (one coin chooses which answer to look for), not the abort-form machine itself;
  the expected time is `16(m + 1)` steps after a polynomial startup.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

open Turing Complexity

/-- `(n + 1)^p ≤ 2^p (n^p + 1)`. -/
theorem succ_pow_le_two_pow_mul (n p : ℕ) : (n + 1) ^ p ≤ 2 ^ p * (n ^ p + 1) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp only [zero_add, one_pow]
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
  · calc (n + 1) ^ p ≤ (2 * n) ^ p := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) p
      _ = 2 ^ p * n ^ p := mul_pow 2 n p
      _ ≤ 2 ^ p * (n ^ p + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)

/-- A sum of terms in `(n+1)^(p+1)`, `(n+1)^p` and constants, in the `c(n^e + 1)` normal form. -/
theorem add_mul_succ_pow_le (A B C n p : ℕ) :
    A * (n + 1) ^ (p + 1) + B * (n + 1) ^ p + C ≤
      (A + B + C) * 2 ^ (p + 1) * (n ^ (p + 1) + 1) := by
  have h1 : (n + 1) ^ p ≤ (n + 1) ^ (p + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (p + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  calc A * (n + 1) ^ (p + 1) + B * (n + 1) ^ p + C
      ≤ (A + B + C) * (n + 1) ^ (p + 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_mul]
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left B h1
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left C h2
        omega
    _ ≤ (A + B + C) * (2 ^ (p + 1) * (n ^ (p + 1) + 1)) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (succ_pow_le_two_pow_mul n (p + 1))
    _ = (A + B + C) * 2 ^ (p + 1) * (n ^ (p + 1) + 1) := by ring

/-! ### §7.4.2: the clocked runner -/

/-- **Markov truncation at machine level** [AB09, §7.4.2]: a PTM deciding `L` with zero error
in expected time `c(n^e + 1)` yields a PTM deciding `L` in the abort form of
[AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)] in polynomial time.

**Proof sketch.** Run it in the one-shot clocked host for `m = (4c + 1)(n + 1)^{e+1} ≥ 2c(n^e+1)`
steps (`clockHost_abortDecides`). Its answers are correct by zero error; by Markov
(`ZDecidesInTime.truncate`) it has halted, with output `L(x)`, with probability
`≥ 1 - c(n^e+1)/m ≥ 1/2`. -/
theorem _root_.Turing.FinNDTM.ZDecidesInTime.exists_abortDecidesInTime {N : FinNDTM Bool}
    {L : Language Bool} {c e : ℕ} (h : N.ZDecidesInTime L fun n => c * (n ^ e + 1)) :
    ∃ (K E : ℕ) (N' : FinNDTM Bool), N'.AbortDecidesInTime L fun n => K * (n ^ E + 1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, cS, hS⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary (4 * c + 1) (e + 1)
  obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, m = fun n => (4 * c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS' : S.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (m x.length) true)
      (fun n => cS * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1 + 1)) := by rw [hmdef]; exact hS
  have hpow : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := fun n => by
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ e + 1 by omega)
    simpa using this
  have hm : ∀ n, n ≤ m n := fun n => by
    have h1 := hpow n
    have h2 : (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) ≤ (4 * c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    simp only [hmdef]
    omega
  have h2B : ∀ n, 2 * (c * (n ^ e + 1)) ≤ m n := fun n => by
    have h1 : n ^ e ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) :=
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) e).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have h3 : c * (n ^ e + 1) ≤ c * (2 * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    simp only [hmdef]
    calc 2 * (c * (n ^ e + 1)) ≤ 2 * (c * (2 * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1))) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h3
      _ = 4 * c * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ (4 * c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
  have hab := clockHost_abortDecides S N L m (fun n => cS * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1 + 1)) hS' hm
    (fun x u v _ hv => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := attemptBit_eq_some.mp hv
      have := (h x).2 u h1
      rw [FinNDTM.outputWith, h2] at this
      simpa using this)
    (fun x => by
      have hB1 : (1 : ℚ) ≤ ((c * (x.length ^ e + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) := (h x).1.one_le
      have hB1' : 1 ≤ c * (x.length ^ e + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hB1
      have hmpos : 0 < m x.length := by have := h2B x.length; omega
      obtain ⟨-, hprob⟩ := h.truncate x hmpos
      have hhalf : ((c * (x.length ^ e + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / (m x.length : ℕ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hmpos)]
        have : ((2 * (c * (x.length ^ e + 1)) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ (m x.length : ℕ) := by
          exact_mod_cast h2B x.length
        push_cast at this ⊢
        linarith
      calc (1 : ℚ) / 2 ≤ 1 - ((c * (x.length ^ e + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / (m x.length : ℕ) := by
            linarith
        _ ≤ _ := hprob
        _ = _ := randProb_congr fun r => by
            rw [attemptBit_eq_some, FinNDTM.haltRun_eq_some_iff, FinNDTM.outputWith])
  refine ⟨(cS + 2 * (4 * c + 1) + 3) * 2 ^ (e + 1 + 1), e + 1 + 1, _, hab.mono fun n => ?_⟩
  calc cS * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1 + 1) + m n + 2 + (m n + 1)
      = cS * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1 + 1) + 2 * (4 * c + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 3 := by
        simp only [hmdef]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := add_mul_succ_pow_le _ _ _ n (e + 1)

/-- **`ZPP ⊆ ZPP` (abort form)** [AB09, §7.4.2 and Exercise 7.6(a)], at machine level. -/
theorem ZPP_PTM_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM : ZPP_PTM ⊆ ZPPAbort_PTM := by
  intro L h
  obtain ⟨e, c, N, hN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨K, E, N', hN'⟩ := hN.exists_abortDecidesInTime
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨E, K, N', hN'⟩

/-! ### Exercise 7.6(a), ⇐: restarting a zero-error verifier -/

/-- Keep an output bit `β` as the answer `b` if `β = 1`, drop it otherwise. -/
def keepAs (b : Bool) : Bool → Option Bool := fun β => if β then some b else none

/-- The attempt built from two PTMs: one coin `b` selects `N b`, whose output `1` is read as
the answer `b` and `0` as no answer. -/
def zppAttempt (N : Bool → FinNDTM Bool) : FinNDTM Bool :=
  FinNDTM.coinBranch ((N false).mapOutput (keepAs false)) ((N true).mapOutput (keepAs true))

/-- The attempt has halted under `b :: u` exactly when `N b` has halted under `u`. -/
theorem zppAttempt_halted (N : Bool → FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (u : List Bool) :
    ((zppAttempt N).tm.runWith (b :: u) ((zppAttempt N).tm.initCfg x)).state = none ↔
      ((N b).tm.runWith u ((N b).tm.initCfg x)).state = none := by
  rw [zppAttempt, FinNDTM.coinBranch_runWith]
  cases b
  · change (FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₀ _ _ (((N false).tm.mapOutput (keepAs false)).runWith u
      (((N false).tm.mapOutput (keepAs false)).initCfg x))).state = none ↔ _
    rw [NDTM.mapOutput_initCfg, NDTM.mapOutput_runWith]
    simp [FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₀, NDTM.mapOutputCfg]
  · change (FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₁ _ _ (((N true).tm.mapOutput (keepAs true)).runWith u
      (((N true).tm.mapOutput (keepAs true)).initCfg x))).state = none ↔ _
    rw [NDTM.mapOutput_initCfg, NDTM.mapOutput_runWith]
    simp [FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₁, NDTM.mapOutputCfg]

/-- The output of the attempt under `b :: u` is `N b`'s output, filtered by `keepAs b`. -/
theorem zppAttempt_output (N : Bool → FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool)
    (u : List Bool) :
    ((zppAttempt N).tm.runWith (b :: u) ((zppAttempt N).tm.initCfg x)).output =
      ((N b).tm.runWith u ((N b).tm.initCfg x)).output.filterMap (keepAs b) := by
  rw [zppAttempt, FinNDTM.coinBranch_runWith]
  cases b
  · change (FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₀ _ _ (((N false).tm.mapOutput (keepAs false)).runWith u
      (((N false).tm.mapOutput (keepAs false)).initCfg x))).output = _
    rw [NDTM.mapOutput_initCfg, NDTM.mapOutput_runWith]
    rfl
  · change (FinNDTM.coinBranchCfg₁ _ _ (((N true).tm.mapOutput (keepAs true)).runWith u
      (((N true).tm.mapOutput (keepAs true)).initCfg x))).output = _
    rw [NDTM.mapOutput_initCfg, NDTM.mapOutput_runWith]
    rfl

/-- **Ex 7.6(a), ⇐** [AB09, Exercise 7.6(a) and Def 7.7]: a polynomial-time zero-error
verifier gives a PTM deciding with zero error in expected polynomial time.

**Proof sketch.** For each `b`, `exists_FinNDTM_of_eff` turns the Boolean verifier
"`M(x, r) = some b`" into a PTM `N b` with the same output distribution, every branch outputting
one bit. In the attempt `zppAttempt N` a coin `b` selects `N b`, whose `1` is the answer `b`;
since `M` never answers wrongly, every answer is `L(x)`. With `ℓ = L(x)`, the attempt answers
when the coin is `ℓ` and `M` answers, so with probability at least `1/2 · 1/2`
(`randProb_append_ge`). The restart host with yardstick `m(n) ≥ 1 + max_b T_b(n)` reruns it
(`clockHost_zDecides`). -/
theorem inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM : {L | InZPP polyTimeModel L} ⊆ ZPP_PTM := by
  classical
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨M, a, k, hEff, hM⟩ := hL
  have hE : ∀ b : Bool, ∃ (K e : ℕ) (N : FinNDTM Bool), ∀ x : List Bool,
      N.tm.HaltsWithin x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) ∧
      (∀ β : Bool, N.outputProb x (K * (x.length ^ e + 1)) [β] =
        randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun u => decide (M x u = some b) = β) ∧
      ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = K * (x.length ^ e + 1) →
        ∃ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool,
          N.outputWith x w = [decide (M x (List.ofFn r) = some b)] := fun b =>
    exists_FinNDTM_of_eff (polyTimeModel_closedUnderAnswerIs M b hEff)
  choose K e N hN using hE
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E, E = e false + e true + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C, C = 2 * (K false + K true) + 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, m = fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ E := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpowE : ∀ n, n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ E := fun n => by
    have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ E by omega)
    simpa using this
  have hm : ∀ n, n ≤ m n := fun n => by
    have h1 := hpowE n
    have h2 : (n + 1) ^ E ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ E := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    simp only [hmdef]
    omega
  have hT : ∀ b n, K b * (n ^ e b + 1) + 1 ≤ m n := fun b n => by
    have h1 : n ^ e b ≤ (n + 1) ^ E := (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _).trans
      (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by cases b <;> omega))
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ E := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have hK : K b ≤ K false + K true := by cases b <;> omega
    have h3 : K b * (n ^ e b + 1) ≤ (K false + K true) * (2 * (n + 1) ^ E) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul hK (by omega)
    have h4 : (K false + K true) * (2 * (n + 1) ^ E) + 1 ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ E := by
      rw [hC]
      calc (K false + K true) * (2 * (n + 1) ^ E) + 1
          = 2 * (K false + K true) * (n + 1) ^ E + 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (K false + K true) * (n + 1) ^ E + 2 * (n + 1) ^ E := by omega
        _ = (2 * (K false + K true) + 2) * (n + 1) ^ E := by ring
    simp only [hmdef]
    omega
  -- the attempt on `b :: u` with `|u| ≥ T_b`: `N b` has halted with one bit
  have hcase : ∀ (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (u : List Bool),
      K b * (x.length ^ e b + 1) ≤ u.length → ∃ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool,
        ((N b).tm.runWith u ((N b).tm.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        ((N b).tm.runWith u ((N b).tm.initCfg x)).output =
          [decide (M x (List.ofFn r) = some b)] := by
    intro x b u hu
    obtain ⟨hhalt, -, hout⟩ := hN b x
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hout (u.take _) (List.length_take_of_le hu)
    refine ⟨r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [FinNDTM.runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hu]
      exact hhalt _ (List.length_take_of_le hu)
    · rw [FinNDTM.runWith_eq_runWith_take hhalt hu]
      exact hr
  have hbit : ∀ (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (u : List Bool),
      K b * (x.length ^ e b + 1) ≤ u.length → ∀ v, attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x (b :: u) = some v →
        ∃ r : Fin (polyLen a k x.length) → Bool, M x (List.ofFn r) = some b ∧ v = b := by
    intro x b u hu v hv
    obtain ⟨r, h1, h2⟩ := hcase x b u hu
    rw [attemptBit_eq_some, zppAttempt_output, h2] at hv
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    by_cases hr : M x (List.ofFn r) = some b
    · simp only [hr, decide_true, List.filterMap_cons, keepAs, if_true, List.filterMap_nil,
        List.cons.injEq, and_true] at hv
      exact ⟨hr, hv.2.symm⟩
    · simp [hr, keepAs] at hv
  have hcorr : ∀ x u v, u.length = m x.length → attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x u = some v →
      v = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x := by
    intro x u v hu hv
    rcases u with _ | ⟨b, u⟩
    · have := hm x.length; have := hT true x.length; simp at hu; omega
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hvb⟩ := hbit x b u (by have := hT b x.length; simp at hu; omega) v hv
      subst hvb
      by_cases hx : x ∈ L
      · have := (hM x).1 hx r
        cases v
        · exact absurd hr this
        · simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx]
      · have := (hM x).2.1 hx r
        cases v
        · simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx]
        · exact absurd hr this
  have hprob : ∀ x : List Bool,
      randProb (m x.length) (fun u => attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x u = none) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓdef⟩ : ∃ ℓ, ℓ = MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hm1 : m x.length = 1 + (m x.length - 1) := by have := hT true x.length; omega
    -- `M` answers `ℓ` with probability at least `1/2`
    have hans : 1 / 2 ≤
        randProb (polyLen a k x.length) fun u => decide (M x u = some ℓ) = true := by
      have hle : randProb (polyLen a k x.length) (fun u => ¬ (decide (M x u = some ℓ) = true)) ≤
          randProb (polyLen a k x.length) (fun u => M x u = none) := randProb_mono fun r hr => by
        by_cases hx : x ∈ L
        · have h1 := (hM x).1 hx r
          have hℓ : ℓ = true := by rw [hℓdef]; simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx]
          rw [hℓ] at hr
          cases hMr : M x (List.ofFn r) with
          | none => rfl
          | some β => cases β <;> simp_all
        · have h1 := (hM x).2.1 hx r
          have hℓ : ℓ = false := by rw [hℓdef]; simp [MultiTapeTM.indicator, hx]
          rw [hℓ] at hr
          cases hMr : M x (List.ofFn r) with
          | none => rfl
          | some β => cases β <;> simp_all
      rw [randProb_not] at hle
      linarith [(hM x).2.2]
    -- conditioned on the first coin being `ℓ`, the attempt answers with probability `≥ 1/2`
    have hcond : ∀ u : Fin 1 → Bool, List.ofFn u = [ℓ] → 1 / 2 ≤
        randProb (m x.length - 1)
          (fun v => attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x (List.ofFn u ++ v) ≠ none) := by
      intro u hu
      rw [hu]
      obtain ⟨hhalt, hdist, -⟩ := hN ℓ x
      have hTℓ : K ℓ * (x.length ^ e ℓ + 1) ≤ m x.length - 1 := by have := hT ℓ x.length; omega
      calc (1 : ℚ) / 2 ≤ _ := hans
        _ = (N ℓ).outputProb x (K ℓ * (x.length ^ e ℓ + 1)) [true] := (hdist true).symm
        _ = (N ℓ).outputProb x (m x.length - 1) [true] :=
            (FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin hhalt hTℓ _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := randProb_mono fun r hr => by
            obtain ⟨r', h1, h2⟩ := hcase x ℓ (List.ofFn r) (by simpa using hTℓ)
            have h2' := hr
            rw [FinNDTM.outputWith, h2, List.singleton_inj, decide_eq_true_iff] at h2'
            intro hnone
            have hsome : attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x (ℓ :: List.ofFn r) = some ℓ := by
              rw [attemptBit_eq_some, zppAttempt_output, h2]
              refine ⟨(zppAttempt_halted N x ℓ _).mpr h1, ?_⟩
              simp [h2', keepAs]
            rw [List.singleton_append, hsome] at hnone
            exact absurd hnone (by simp)
    have hlow := randProb_append_ge 1 (m x.length - 1) (fun p => p = [ℓ])
      (fun p v => attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x (p ++ v) ≠ none) hcond
    rw [randProb_one_eq, ← hm1] at hlow
    have heq : randProb (m x.length)
          (fun r => attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x (r.take 1 ++ r.drop 1) ≠ none) =
        randProb (m x.length) (fun u => ¬ attemptBit (zppAttempt N) x u = none) :=
      randProb_congr fun r => by rw [List.take_append_drop]
    rw [heq, randProb_not] at hlow
    linarith
  obtain ⟨S, cS, hS⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary C E
  have hS' : S.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => List.replicate (m x.length) true)
      (fun n => cS * (n + 1) ^ (E + 1)) := by rw [hmdef]; exact hS
  have hz := clockHost_zDecides S (zppAttempt N) L m (fun n => cS * (n + 1) ^ (E + 1)) hS' hm
    hcorr hprob
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨E + 1, (cS + 17 * C + 18) * 2 ^ (E + 1), _, hz.mono fun n => ?_⟩
  calc cS * (n + 1) ^ (E + 1) + m n + 2 + 16 * (m n + 1)
      = cS * (n + 1) ^ (E + 1) + 17 * C * (n + 1) ^ E + 18 := by simp only [hmdef]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := add_mul_succ_pow_le _ _ _ n E

/-! ### The equalities -/

/-- **[AB09, Def 7.7 and Exercise 7.6(a)]**: the expected-time class `ZPP` is the
certificate class of polynomial-time zero-error verifiers. -/
theorem ZPP_PTM_eq_setOf_inZPP : ZPP_PTM = {L | InZPP polyTimeModel L} :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (fun _ h => inZPP_of_mem_ZPP_PTM h) inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM

/-- `L ∈ ZPP` (Def 7.7) iff `L` has a polynomial-time zero-error verifier. -/
theorem mem_ZPP_PTM_iff (L : Language Bool) : L ∈ ZPP_PTM ↔ InZPP polyTimeModel L := by
  rw [ZPP_PTM_eq_setOf_inZPP]; rfl

/-- **[AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)]** at machine level: the abort-form class equals `ZPP`. -/
theorem ZPPAbort_PTM_eq_ZPP_PTM : ZPPAbort_PTM = ZPP_PTM :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (fun _ h => inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM (inZPP_of_mem_ZPPAbort_PTM h))
    ZPP_PTM_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM

/-- A polynomial-time zero-error verifier gives an abort-form PTM. [AB09, Exercise 7.6(a)] -/
theorem inZPP_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM : {L | InZPP polyTimeModel L} ⊆ ZPPAbort_PTM :=
  fun _ h => ZPP_PTM_subset_ZPPAbort_PTM (inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM h)

/-- **`ZPP = RP ∩ coRP`** [AB09, Theorem 7.8; Exercise 7.6(b)], for the expected-time `ZPP` of
Def 7.7. -/
theorem ZPP_PTM_eq_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM : ZPP_PTM = RP_PTM ∩ coRP_PTM :=
  Set.Subset.antisymm ZPP_PTM_subset_RP_PTM_inter_coRP_PTM fun L ⟨h1, h2⟩ =>
    inZPP_subset_ZPP_PTM ((zpp_eq_rp_inter_corp_polyTime L).mpr
      ⟨(mem_RP_PTM_iff L).mp h1, (mem_coRP_PTM_iff L).mp h2⟩)

end Randomized

import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZeroPRun
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Fingerprint
import TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Primality

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# `ZEROP ∈ coRP`

The class half of [AB09, §7.2.3, p.130]: the fingerprinting test for `ZEROP`
(`Randomized.zeropVerifier`, analysed in `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Fingerprint`) runs in
polynomial time, so `ZEROP ∈ coRP`, hence `ZEROP ∈ BPP`, in the certificate form over
`Randomized.polyTimeModel` and in the PTM form of [AB09, Def 7.2/7.6]. The test on words cuts
the coins into the point and the moduli and evaluates the circuit modulo each modulus with
`Randomized.PIT.evalModW` (`TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.ZeroPRun`).

## Main definitions

* `Randomized.PIT.pipe` — cut the coins into the point and the moduli, and compare the values
  of two codes modulo every modulus.
* `Randomized.PIT.zeropW` — `Randomized.zeropVerifier` on `⟨x, r⟩`, on words.

## Main results

* `Randomized.PIT.pipe_eq`, `Randomized.PIT.zeroTest_eq`, `Randomized.PIT.zeropW_pairEncode`.
* `Randomized.eff_zeropVerifier` — the ZEROP test is polynomial-time.
* `Randomized.inCoRP_ZEROP_polyTime`, `Randomized.inBPP_ZEROP_polyTime`,
  `Randomized.ZEROP_mem_coRP_PTM`, `Randomized.ZEROP_mem_BPP_PTM` — [AB09, §7.2.3].

## Divergences

* None beyond those of `TCSlib.Complexity.Randomized.Fingerprint` (the test's parameters);
  this file only shows that test is polynomial-time.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009.
-/

namespace Randomized

namespace PIT

open Complexity Turing BinArith AlgCircuit
open Complexity.LogProg (bitsVal bitsVal_bits)

/-! ### Cutting the coins into blocks -/

/-- One round of the point loop on `⟨1^b, ⟨u, P⟩⟩`: move the first `b` bits of `u` to the end
of the list `P`. -/
def ptStep (d : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (pairFstD d)
    (pairEncode (dropPrefixByLen (pairEncode (pairFstD d) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))
      (pairSndD (pairSndD d) ++
        pairEncode (takePrefixByLen (pairEncode (pairFstD d) (pairFstD (pairSndD d)))) []))

/-- The rounds of the point loop. -/
theorem iterate_ptStep (b : ℕ) (u : List Bool) (P : List (List Bool)) (i : ℕ) :
    ptStep^[i] (pairEncode (List.replicate b true) (pairEncode u (encWords P))) =
      pairEncode (List.replicate b true) (pairEncode (u.drop (i * b))
        (encWords (P ++ (List.range i).map (fun j => (u.drop (j * b)).take b)))) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
    simp only [ptStep, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, dropPrefixByLen,
      takePrefixByLen, List.length_replicate, List.drop_drop, List.range_succ, List.map_append,
      List.map_singleton, ← List.append_assoc, encWords_append_singleton]
    rw [Nat.succ_mul]

/-- The point loop is polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_ptLoop : PolyTimeComputable (forLoop ptStep) := by
  have hb : PolyTimeComputable (fun d => pairEncode (pairFstD d) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))) :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode polyTimeComputable_slot2
  have hstep : PolyTimeComputable ptStep :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode ((polyTimeComputable_dropPrefixByLen.comp hb).pairEncode
      (polyTimeComputable_slot3.append
        ((polyTimeComputable_takePrefixByLen.comp hb).pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const []))))
  refine polyTimeComputable_forLoop hstep (6 + 1) 2 (forLoop_bound_of_ctx 6 (fun d => by
    simp [ptStep]) (fun d => ?_))
  have h1 := length_pair_components_le d
  have h2 := length_pair_components_le (pairSndD d)
  have ht := List.length_take_le (pairFstD d).length (pairFstD (pairSndD d))
  simp only [ptStep, length_pairEncode, List.length_append, dropPrefixByLen, takePrefixByLen,
    pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, List.length_drop, List.length_nil]
  omega

/-! ### The trials -/

/-- The trial context `Q = ⟨1^L, ⟨1^n, ⟨G₁, ⟨G₂, P⟩⟩⟩⟩`: block length, inputs, two codes, point. -/
def qL (Q : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD Q

/-- The number of inputs. -/
def qN (Q : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD Q)

/-- The first code. -/
def qG₁ (Q : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD Q))

/-- The second code. -/
def qG₂ (Q : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD Q)))

/-- The point. -/
def qP (Q : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD Q)))

/-- One trial with modulus `R + 1`: do the two codes have the same value mod `R + 1`? -/
def trialTest (Q R : List Bool) : Bool :=
  BinArith.beq (pairEncode (evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN Q) (pairEncode R (qP Q))) (qG₁ Q)))
    (evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN Q) (pairEncode R (qP Q))) (qG₂ Q))))

/-- One round of the trial loop on `⟨Q, ⟨s, [acc]⟩⟩`: test the next block of `s`, `AND` into
`acc`. -/
def trStep (d : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (pairFstD d)
    (pairEncode (dropPrefixByLen (pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))
      [(pairSndD (pairSndD d)).headD false &&
        trialTest (pairFstD d)
          (takePrefixByLen (pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))])

/-- The rounds of the trial loop. -/
theorem iterate_trStep (Q s : List Bool) (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    trStep^[i] (pairEncode Q (pairEncode s [b])) =
      pairEncode Q (pairEncode (s.drop (i * (qL Q).length))
        [b && (List.range i).all (fun j => trialTest Q
          ((s.drop (j * (qL Q).length)).take (qL Q).length))]) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
    simp only [trStep, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, dropPrefixByLen,
      takePrefixByLen, List.drop_drop, List.range_succ, List.all_append, List.all_cons,
      List.all_nil, Bool.and_true, List.headD_cons, Bool.and_assoc]
    rw [Nat.succ_mul]

/-- The test of a trial is polynomial-time.

**Proof sketch.** The fields of the trial context are projections; evaluating both circuits
at the point modulo the trial's modulus (`polyTimeComputable_evalModW`) and comparing the two
residues (`polyTimeComputable_beq`) compose by `polyTimeComputable_app`. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_trialTest :
    PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [trialTest (pairFstD z) (pairSndD z)]) := by
  have hN : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => qN (pairFstD z)) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_slot2 polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hP : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => qP (pairFstD z)) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app (show PolyTimeComputable qP from
      polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot4) polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hG₁ : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => qG₁ (pairFstD z)) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app (show PolyTimeComputable qG₁ from
      polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot3) polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hG₂ : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => qG₂ (pairFstD z)) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app (show PolyTimeComputable qG₂ from
      polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot4) polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hctx : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairEncode (qN (pairFstD z))
      (pairEncode (pairSndD z) (qP (pairFstD z)))) :=
    hN.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.pairEncode hP)
  have h1 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN (pairFstD z))
      (pairEncode (pairSndD z) (qP (pairFstD z)))) (qG₁ (pairFstD z)))) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_evalModW (hctx.pairEncode hG₁)
  have h2 : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN (pairFstD z))
      (pairEncode (pairSndD z) (qP (pairFstD z)))) (qG₂ (pairFstD z)))) :=
    polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_evalModW (hctx.pairEncode hG₂)
  have h : (fun z => [trialTest (pairFstD z) (pairSndD z)]) = (fun z => [BinArith.beq
      (pairEncode (evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN (pairFstD z))
        (pairEncode (pairSndD z) (qP (pairFstD z)))) (qG₁ (pairFstD z))))
        (evalModW (pairEncode (pairEncode (qN (pairFstD z))
          (pairEncode (pairSndD z) (qP (pairFstD z)))) (qG₂ (pairFstD z)))))]) := by
    funext z; simp only [trialTest]
  rw [h]
  exact polyTimeComputable_test_app polyTimeComputable_beq (h1.pairEncode h2)

/-- The trial loop is polynomial-time.

**Proof sketch.** The round keeps its context and moves the next block of coins from the
coin field into the trial test (`takePrefixByLen`, `dropPrefixByLen`), conjoining the result
into a one-bit accumulator; it grows the state by at most `5(|context| + 1)` bits, so
`polyTimeComputable_forLoop` with `forLoop_bound_of_ctx` applies. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_trLoop : PolyTimeComputable (forLoop trStep) := by
  have hb : PolyTimeComputable (fun d => pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))) :=
    (polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_pairFstD polyTimeComputable_pairFstD).pairEncode
      polyTimeComputable_slot2
  have ht : PolyTimeComputable (fun d => [trialTest (pairFstD d)
      (takePrefixByLen (pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))]) := by
    have := polyTimeComputable_test_app polyTimeComputable_trialTest
      (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_app
        polyTimeComputable_takePrefixByLen hb))
    simpa only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode] using this
  have hacc : PolyTimeComputable (fun d => [(pairSndD (pairSndD d)).headD false]) :=
    polyTimeComputable_test_app polyTimeComputable_headD polyTimeComputable_slot3
  have hstep : PolyTimeComputable trStep := by
    have := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode ((polyTimeComputable_app
      polyTimeComputable_dropPrefixByLen hb).pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_and hacc ht))
    have h : trStep = fun d => pairEncode (pairFstD d)
        (pairEncode (dropPrefixByLen (pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))
          [(pairSndD (pairSndD d)).headD false && trialTest (pairFstD d)
            (takePrefixByLen (pairEncode (qL (pairFstD d)) (pairFstD (pairSndD d))))]) := by
      funext d; simp only [trStep]
    rw [h]
    exact this
  refine polyTimeComputable_forLoop hstep (5 + 1) 2 (forLoop_bound_of_ctx 5 (fun d => by
    simp [trStep]) (fun d => ?_))
  have h1 := length_pair_components_le d
  have h2 := length_pair_components_le (pairSndD d)
  simp only [trStep, length_pairEncode, dropPrefixByLen, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
    List.length_drop, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
  omega

/-! ### The pipeline -/

/-- The packed input `⟨1^n, ⟨1^m, ⟨G₁, ⟨G₂, r⟩⟩⟩⟩`: inputs. -/
def pN (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD z

/-- The circuit size `m`, in unary. -/
def pI (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD z)

/-- The first code. -/
def pG₁ (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD z))

/-- The second code. -/
def pG₂ (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD z)))

/-- The coins. -/
def pR (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD z)))

/-- `M = m + 12`, in unary. -/
def pM (z : List Bool) : List Bool := pI z ++ List.replicate 12 true

/-- The point loop on the coins: blocks of `m + 4` bits, one per input. -/
def pPts (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  forLoop ptStep (pairEncode (pN z) (pairEncode (pI z ++ List.replicate 4 true)
    (pairEncode (pR z) [])))

/-- **The test on words**: with `M = m + 12`, cut `n` blocks of `m + 4` coins into the point
`a` (`aᵢ = 1 + block`), then for `8M` blocks of `2M` coins compare the values of `G₁` and `G₂`
modulo `k = 1 + block`; accept iff they always agree.  [AB09, §7.2.3, p.130] -/
def pipe (z : List Bool) : Bool :=
  (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (forLoop trStep (pairEncode
    (pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z)
    (pairEncode (pairEncode (pM z ++ pM z) (pairEncode (pN z) (pairEncode (pG₁ z)
        (pairEncode (pG₂ z) (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z))))))))
      (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z)))) [true]))))))).headD false

/-- The pipeline is polynomial-time.

**Proof sketch.** The pipeline is the point loop (`polyTimeComputable_ptLoop`) followed by
the trial loop (`polyTimeComputable_trLoop`) on a state assembled by pairing, projections and
concatenation of polynomial-time pieces, then the accumulator bit; each step composes by
`polyTimeComputable_app`. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_pipe : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [pipe z]) := by
  have hN : PolyTimeComputable pN := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hI : PolyTimeComputable pI := polyTimeComputable_slot2
  have hG₁ : PolyTimeComputable pG₁ := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot3
  have hG₂ : PolyTimeComputable pG₂ := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot4
  have hR : PolyTimeComputable pR := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot4
  have hM : PolyTimeComputable pM := hI.append (polyTimeComputable_const (List.replicate 12 true))
  have hP : PolyTimeComputable pPts := by
    have := polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_ptLoop (hN.pairEncode
      ((hI.append (polyTimeComputable_const (List.replicate 4 true))).pairEncode
        (hR.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const []))))
    have h : pPts = fun z => forLoop ptStep (pairEncode (pN z) (pairEncode
        (pI z ++ List.replicate 4 true) (pairEncode (pR z) []))) := by
      funext z; simp only [pPts]
    rw [h]
    exact this
  have h8 : PolyTimeComputable
      (fun z => pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z) :=
    ((((((hM.append hM).append hM).append hM).append hM).append hM).append hM).append hM
  have hPs : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z)))) :=
    @polyTimeComputable_app (fun S => pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD S))) pPts
      polyTimeComputable_slot4 hP
  have hS : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z)))) :=
    @polyTimeComputable_app (fun S => pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD S))) pPts
      (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot3) hP
  have hQ : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairEncode (pM z ++ pM z) (pairEncode (pN z)
      (pairEncode (pG₁ z) (pairEncode (pG₂ z) (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z)))))))) :=
    (hM.append hM).pairEncode (hN.pairEncode (hG₁.pairEncode (hG₂.pairEncode hPs)))
  have hs : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z))))
      [true]) := hS.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const [true])
  have hL := @polyTimeComputable_app (forLoop trStep) _ polyTimeComputable_trLoop
    (h8.pairEncode (hQ.pairEncode hs))
  have h := @polyTimeComputable_test_app (fun w => w.headD false) _ polyTimeComputable_headD
    (@polyTimeComputable_app (fun S => pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD S))) _
      polyTimeComputable_slot4 hL)
  have he : (fun z => [pipe z]) = (fun z => [(pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (forLoop trStep
      (pairEncode (pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z)
        (pairEncode (pairEncode (pM z ++ pM z) (pairEncode (pN z) (pairEncode (pG₁ z)
          (pairEncode (pG₂ z) (pairSndD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z))))))))
          (pairEncode (pairFstD (pairSndD (pairSndD (pPts z)))) [true]))))))).headD false]) := by
    funext z; simp only [pipe]
  rw [he]
  exact h

/-- The point: `n` blocks of `m + 4` coins. -/
def pts (n m : ℕ) (r : List Bool) : List (List Bool) :=
  (List.range n).map (fun i => (r.drop (i * (m + 4))).take (m + 4))

/-- The `j`-th modulus block: `2(m + 12)` coins after the point. -/
def rawj (n m : ℕ) (r : List Bool) (j : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  ((r.drop (n * (m + 4))).drop (j * (2 * (m + 12)))).take (2 * (m + 12))

/-- **The pipeline computes the test**: on `⟨1^n, ⟨1^m, ⟨G₁, ⟨G₂, r⟩⟩⟩⟩` it accepts iff for each
of the `8(m+12)` moduli the two codes have the same value.

**Proof sketch.** The point loop runs `n` rounds and leaves the point `pts n m r` and the coins
`r.drop (n(m+4))` (`iterate_ptStep`); the trial loop runs `8(m+12)` rounds of `2(m+12)` coins
and leaves the conjunction of the trials (`iterate_trStep`); a trial compares the two values
with `beq`. -/
theorem pipe_eq (n m : ℕ) (G₁ G₂ r : List Bool) :
    pipe (pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (pairEncode (List.replicate m true)
      (pairEncode G₁ (pairEncode G₂ r)))) =
      decide (∀ j < 8 * (m + 12),
        bitsVal (evalModW (pairEncode (ctxOf n (rawj n m r j) (pts n m r)) G₁)) =
          bitsVal (evalModW (pairEncode (ctxOf n (rawj n m r j) (pts n m r)) G₂))) := by
  set z := pairEncode (List.replicate n true) (pairEncode (List.replicate m true)
      (pairEncode G₁ (pairEncode G₂ r))) with hz
  have e1 : pN z = List.replicate n true := by simp [pN, z]
  have e2 : pI z = List.replicate m true := by simp [pI, z]
  have e3 : pG₁ z = G₁ := by simp [pG₁, z]
  have e4 : pG₂ z = G₂ := by simp [pG₂, z]
  have e5 : pR z = r := by simp [pR, z]
  have eM : pM z = List.replicate (m + 12) true := by simp [pM, e2, List.replicate_add]
  have e8 : pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z ++ pM z =
      List.replicate (8 * (m + 12)) true := by
    rw [eM]; simp only [← List.replicate_add]; congr 1; ring
  have e2M : pM z ++ pM z = List.replicate (2 * (m + 12)) true := by
    rw [eM, ← List.replicate_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hpts : pPts z = pairEncode [] (pairEncode (List.replicate (m + 4) true)
      (pairEncode (r.drop (n * (m + 4))) (encWords (pts n m r)))) := by
    rw [pPts, e1, e2, e5, ← List.replicate_add,
      show (pairEncode r [] : List Bool) = pairEncode r (encWords []) from rfl,
      forLoop_pairEncode, iterate_ptStep, List.length_replicate, List.nil_append]
    rfl
  unfold pipe
  rw [e8, e2M, e1, e3, e4, hpts]
  simp only [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
  rw [forLoop_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, iterate_trStep]
  simp only [pairSndD_pairEncode, List.headD_cons, Bool.true_and, qL, pairFstD_pairEncode,
    List.length_replicate]
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
  simp only [List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine forall_congr' fun j => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  simp only [trialTest, qN, qP, qG₁, qG₂, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode,
    BinArith.beq, decide_eq_true_eq, ctxOf, rawj]

/-! ### The fingerprint test through the pipeline -/

/-- A block read inside a prefix of the coins is the block of the whole string. -/
theorem take_drop_take {l : List Bool} {N a b : ℕ} (h : a + b ≤ N) :
    ((l.take N).drop a).take b = (l.drop a).take b := by
  rw [List.drop_take, List.take_take]
  congr 1
  omega

/-- **The ZEROP test through `pts` and `rawj`**: `D.zeroTest r` accepts iff `D(a) ≡ 0` modulo
each of the `8(m+12)` moduli read by the pipeline.

**Proof sketch.** The test reads its point and moduli from the first `testLen` coins; every
block it reads lies inside that prefix (`(i+1)(m+4) ≤ n(m+4)` and
`(j+1)·2(m+12) ≤ 8(m+12)·2(m+12)`), so it is the block of the whole string
(`take_drop_take`): the test's point is `ptVal (pts …)` and its `j`-th modulus is
`rawj … j + 1`. -/
theorem zeroTest_eq {n : ℕ} (D : AlgCircuit n) (r : List Bool) :
    D.zeroTest r = decide (∀ j < 8 * (D.size + 12), D.eval (fun i =>
      (ptVal (pts n D.size r) i : ZMod (bitsVal (rawj n D.size r j) + 1))) = 0) := by
  have hL : n * (D.size + 4) ≤ testLen n D.size := by simp [testLen, inputBits]
  have hpt : ∀ i : Fin n, D.testPoint ((r.take (testLen n D.size)).take (n * inputBits D.size)) i =
      ptVal (pts n D.size r) i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (i : ℕ) * (D.size + 4) + (D.size + 4) ≤ n * (D.size + 4) := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.size + 4) (show (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ n from i.isLt)
      rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hg : (pts n D.size r).getD i [] = (r.drop (i * (D.size + 4))).take (D.size + 4) := by
      simp [pts, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, i.isLt]
    simp only [AlgCircuit.testPoint, ptVal, blockVal, inputBits, hg]
    rw [List.take_take, take_drop_take (le_min h1 (h1.trans hL))]
  have hmod : ∀ j < 8 * (D.size + 12),
      D.testModulus ((r.take (testLen n D.size)).drop (n * inputBits D.size)) j =
        bitsVal (rawj n D.size r j) + 1 := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 : j * (2 * (D.size + 12)) + 2 * (D.size + 12) ≤
        testLen n D.size - n * (D.size + 4) := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * (D.size + 12)) (show j + 1 ≤ 8 * (D.size + 12) from hj)
      simp only [testLen, inputBits, numTrials, modParam]
      rw [Nat.succ_mul] at this
      omega
    simp only [AlgCircuit.testModulus, blockVal, rawj, inputBits, modParam]
    rw [List.drop_take, take_drop_take h1]
  unfold AlgCircuit.zeroTest AlgCircuit.ZeroTestCore
  rw [decide_eq_decide]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    have hj' : j < numTrials D.size := by simp only [numTrials, modParam]; exact hj
    have := h ⟨j, hj'⟩
    rw [hmod j hj] at this
    simpa only [hpt] using this
  · intro h j
    have hj : (j : ℕ) < 8 * (D.size + 12) := by
      have := j.isLt; simp only [numTrials, modParam] at this; exact this
    rw [hmod j hj]
    simpa only [hpt] using h j hj

/-- The empty code has value `0`. -/
theorem bitsVal_evalModW_nil (n : ℕ) (R : List Bool) (P : List (List Bool)) :
    bitsVal (evalModW (pairEncode (ctxOf n R P) [])) = 0 := by
  rw [evalModW, gateRun_eq (n := n)]
  simp [runVal_encState, Nat.zero_bits, bitsVal]

/-- A residue below `k` is `0` in `ZMod k` only if it is `0`. -/
theorem natCast_eq_zero_iff_of_lt {v k : ℕ} (h : v < k) : (v : ZMod k) = 0 ↔ v = 0 := by
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hd
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd h
  · rintro rfl
    exact dvd_zero k

/-- **The ZEROP verifier on words**: reject (`true`) malformed inputs, otherwise run the
pipeline on the circuit against the empty code (value `0`) and negate. -/
def zeropW (z : List Bool) : Bool :=
  !validW (pairFstD z) || !pipe (pairEncode (uHead (pairFstD z))
    (pairEncode (sI (scanRun (pairFstD z))) (pairEncode (uRest (pairFstD z))
      (pairEncode [] (pairSndD z)))))

/-- The ZEROP verifier on words is polynomial-time. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_zeropW : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [zeropW z]) := by
  have hv : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [validW (pairFstD z)]) :=
    polyTimeComputable_test_app polyTimeComputable_validW polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hI : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => sI (scanRun (pairFstD z))) :=
    @polyTimeComputable_app (fun x => sI (scanRun x)) pairFstD
      (@polyTimeComputable_app sI scanRun
        (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.comp polyTimeComputable_slot3) polyTimeComputable_scanRun)
      polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hpack : PolyTimeComputable (fun z => pairEncode (uHead (pairFstD z))
      (pairEncode (sI (scanRun (pairFstD z))) (pairEncode (uRest (pairFstD z))
        (pairEncode [] (pairSndD z))))) :=
    (polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_uHead polyTimeComputable_pairFstD).pairEncode
      (hI.pairEncode ((polyTimeComputable_app polyTimeComputable_uRest
        polyTimeComputable_pairFstD).pairEncode
        ((polyTimeComputable_const []).pairEncode polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)))
  have hp := polyTimeComputable_not (polyTimeComputable_test_app polyTimeComputable_pipe hpack)
  exact polyTimeComputable_or (polyTimeComputable_not hv) hp

/-- **The word-level verifier computes `zeropVerifier`.**

**Proof sketch.** If `x` is not the code of a well-formed circuit both sides are `true`
(`validW_iff`). Otherwise `x = 1ⁿ0·code(C)`, the scan counts `|C|` (`sI_scanRun`), and by
`pipe_eq` the pipeline asks, for each modulus `k`, that `C(a) mod k` equal the value `0` of the
empty code; by `evalModW_spec` this is `C(a) = 0` in `ZMod k`, which is the ZEROP test
(`zeroTest_eq`). -/
theorem zeropW_pairEncode (x r : List Bool) :
    zeropW (pairEncode x r) = zeropVerifier x r := by
  simp only [zeropW, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode]
  by_cases hv : validW x = true
  · rw [hv, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_or]
    obtain ⟨⟨n, C⟩, hd, hw⟩ := (validW_iff x).mp hv
    have hx := encode_of_decode hd
    simp only [encode] at hx
    have hu : uHead x = List.replicate n true := by rw [← hx, uHead_encodeNat]
    have hr : uRest x = encodeGates C.gates := by rw [← hx, uRest_encodeNat]
    rw [sI_scanRun hd hw, hu, hr, pipe_eq]
    have hz : zeropVerifier x r = !(C.zeroTest r) := by
      simp only [zeropVerifier, hd]
      exact if_pos hw
    rw [hz, zeroTest_eq]
    refine congrArg (fun b => !b) ?_
    rw [decide_eq_decide]
    refine forall_congr' fun j => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
    rw [bitsVal_evalModW_nil]
    obtain ⟨hlt, hcast⟩ := evalModW_spec (rawj n C.size r j) (pts n C.size r) C hw
    rw [← hcast, natCast_eq_zero_iff_of_lt hlt]
  · rw [Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hv, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or]
    have hno : ¬ ∃ c : (n : ℕ) × AlgCircuit n, decode x = some c ∧ c.2.WellFormed :=
      fun h => hv ((validW_iff x).mpr h)
    unfold zeropVerifier
    cases hd : decode x with
    | none => rfl
    | some c =>
      have hw : ¬ c.2.WellFormed := fun hw => hno ⟨c, hd, hw⟩
      simp [hw]

end PIT

/-! ### `ZEROP ∈ coRP` -/

/-- **The ZEROP test is polynomial-time** [AB09, §7.2.3, p.130]: `zeropVerifier` is efficient
for `polyTimeModel`. -/
theorem eff_zeropVerifier : polyTimeModel.Eff (boolVerifier zeropVerifier) :=
  eff_boolVerifier_of_test PIT.polyTimeComputable_zeropW PIT.zeropW_pairEncode

/-- **`ZEROP ∈ coRP`** [AB09, §7.2.3, p.130], certificate form over polynomial-time verifiers. -/
theorem inCoRP_ZEROP_polyTime : InCoRP polyTimeModel ZEROP :=
  inCoRP_ZEROP polyTimeModel eff_zeropVerifier

/-- **`ZEROP ∈ BPP`** [AB09, §7.2.3], certificate form. -/
theorem inBPP_ZEROP_polyTime : InBPP polyTimeModel ZEROP :=
  InCoRP.inBPP_polyTime inCoRP_ZEROP_polyTime

/-- **`ZEROP ∈ coRP`**, PTM form [AB09, Def 7.6]. -/
theorem ZEROP_mem_coRP_PTM : ZEROP ∈ coRP_PTM :=
  (mem_coRP_PTM_iff _).2 inCoRP_ZEROP_polyTime

/-- **`ZEROP ∈ BPP`**, PTM form [AB09, Def 7.2]. -/
theorem ZEROP_mem_BPP_PTM : ZEROP ∈ BPP_PTM :=
  (mem_BPP_PTM_iff _).2 inBPP_ZEROP_polyTime

end Randomized
