import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Convention
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Machine-construction library: wrappers

The output-isolation layer of the machine-construction library
(`machine-library-design.md` §5, W1–W3): the capture/silence discipline
written once, consolidating its four private incarnations
(`universalCaptureTM` in the universal-machine development, the Chapter-2
enumerator's `enumCaptureTM`, the HALT batch's `acceptTM`, and the private
engine inside `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Composition.exists_cond`).
The obligation list is the one the phase-1 and phase-4 audits tabulated:
every source emission is captured, **including an emission on the halting
transition**; the wrapper's physical output stays untouched; the completed
source configuration is preserved at the return.

**Status: proved.** The two action/configuration transformers and the
derived machine are real definitions; the four contract theorems are
proved (filled from the existing private proofs in the library fill
batches; gates closed). New Chapter-1 surface, audited in the shared
infrastructure round.

## Design

* **W1 (capture)** is *host-parametric*: rather than a closed wrapper
  machine, `Turing.captureAction` transforms one source action into a host
  action (source tapes untouched, emission appended to the last tape,
  silence, halt redirected to a designated return state), and
  `Turing.capture_run` says that **any** host machine agreeing with the
  transformed table on an embedded copy of the source states simulates the
  source in lockstep with its output captured on the last tape. Consumers
  (the loop fill, HALT-style control modifications, the Chapter-2
  continuations) embed the source into *their* controller state type and
  inherit the whole induction. The capture tape holds the full output
  word (tape-capture core, frozen design decision 9.3); reading one bit
  off it is the register corollary, derived at fill time.
* **W2 (halt-redirect)** is the `acceptTM` pattern as a closed
  transformation `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM`: simulate a machine silently
  while remembering the last emitted bit, halt exactly when the source
  halts with the designated bit, and otherwise enter a one-state
  stationary live loop.
* **W3 (timed branch)** is the quantitative form of
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_comp_partial`'s sibling
  `Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`: deciding which branch runs costs the
  decider's budget, and the branch runs on the *same* physical input, so
  no monotonicity hypothesis is needed.

## Main declarations

* `Turing.captureAction`, `Turing.captureCfg` — the W1 transformers.
* `Turing.capture_run` — the W1 lockstep/capture/silence contract.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` — the W2 transformation.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_computes`, `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_live` — the
  W2 contract pair.
* `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM_runFrom` — the W2 run correspondence, field by field (MIG-1).
* `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM` — the W3 controller (the named witness), with
  `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_computes` (time) and `Turing.FinTM.timedCondTM_spaceUsed`
  (space).
* `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond` — the W3 timed branch.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2; the capture discipline is the
  output-isolation folklore every simulation argument of §1.4–§1.7 uses.)

**Implementation note (batch W).** All four contracts are now proved; the
original spec-phase descriptions above and in their docstrings are retained.
The conditional controller instantiates `capture_run` on a padded decider,
reads its singleton output, and uses a quantitative refinement of
`rewind_from_any`. Its branch-start prefix is at most twice the decider's
budget plus five, yielding the uniform multiplier `5` in the frozen bound.

**Maintainer note (D6 promotion).** Batch W's two shared-lemma promotion
requests are executed: `timed_input_bound` is now the public
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound` in `Deterministic.lean` (generalized
from `Bool` to an arbitrary symbol type; the proof was symbol-free), and
`timed_rewind` is the public `Turing.FinTM.timed_rewind` in
`Simulation.lean`, verbatim. The private copies formerly here are removed;
the two call sites below consume the public lemmas.

**Implementation note (emitter batch W).** `emit_run` is now proved by the
private action identity `emit_apply` and the guarded induction used by
`capture_run`. A halting action forwards its optional final emission on
the same transition that transfers control to the live return state.
-/

namespace Turing

variable {k : ℕ} {S H : Type*}

/-- W1 action transformer. Transform one source action into a host action
over one extra tape: the source's input move and work-tape actions are kept
on the first `k` tapes; the source's emission, **if any**, is written on
the last tape with a right move (so the capture tape accumulates the output
word from the origin); the host emits nothing; a live source successor is
embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action transfers control to the
designated return state `ret` — on the very transition that may carry the
final emission, which is therefore captured like any other. -/
def captureAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action (k + 1) Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then a.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else
      match a.output with
      | some b => (some (some b), SignType.pos)
      | none => (none, SignType.zero)
  output := none
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- W1 configuration correspondence. A source configuration `c`, viewed
inside a host with one extra tape: source state embedded (a halted source
sits at the return state `ret`), same input head, source work tapes on the
first `k` tapes, and the capture tape holding `pre ++ c.output` — the
emissions captured so far after a pre-existing prefix — with its head one
past that word. The host's own physical output is the untouched `out₀`. -/
def captureCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg (k + 1) Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapes ⟨i, h⟩
    else FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ c.output)
  workTapePos := fun i =>
    if h : (i : ℕ) < k then c.workTapePos ⟨i, h⟩
    else ((pre ++ c.output).length : ℤ)
  output := out₀

-- Field equations for the captured source configuration.
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) state inputPos workTapes workTapePos output]
  Turing.captureCfg

/-- Applying a captured action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission to the buffer. The write uses the old head before moving.
**Proof sketch.** Split the tape index at the source tape count. Source tapes
are unchanged by the embedding; on the final tape use `bufferTape_append`
for an emission and the stationary no-write action otherwise. -/
private lemma capture_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (captureAction emb ret a).apply (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho,
          ← List.append_assoc, FinTM.bufferTape_append]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < k
    · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi]
    · cases ho : a.output <;>
        simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply, hi, ho, Nat.cast_add,
          add_assoc]
  · simp [captureAction, captureCfg, Action.apply]

/-- **W1, the capture contract** (harvested from the
four private incarnations). If a host machine's transition table agrees, on
an embedded copy of the source's states, with the capture-transformed
source table, then the host run from a capture configuration *is* the
capture image of the source run, for as long as the source has not halted
before the time in question. Taking `t` to be the source's halting time
instantiates the return clause: the host sits at `ret` with the completed
source configuration preserved, the full source output (halting emission
included) on the capture tape, and the host output still `out₀`; taking
`t` below it gives live lockstep.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `t`. One host step from a live capture image
applies the transformed action: the first `k` tapes and the input head
update exactly as the source's (`Turing.Action.apply` componentwise); the
capture tape appends the emitted bit, which is
`Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_append` at head `|pre ++ c.output|`; silence keeps
the host output at `out₀`; and the successor state is the embedded source
successor, or `ret` on the halting transition. -/
theorem capture_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w =
        captureAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp fun i => w i.castSucc))
    (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c₀) t =
      captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c) =
        captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [captureCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (fun i => (captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapeSymbols
          i.castSucc) = c.workTapeSymbols := by
        funext i
        simp [captureCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, i.isLt]
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact capture_apply emb ret pre out₀ c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

/-- **E2 action transformer** (design §11): the forwarding dual
of `Turing.captureAction`. Transform one source action into a host action
over the **same** tapes: input move and work-tape actions are kept
verbatim; the source's emission, **if any, is forwarded as the host's
physical emission** — including an emission on the halting transition; a
live source successor is embedded via `emb`, and a halting source action
transfers control to the designated live return state `ret`. This is what
lets a proved transducer serve as one emission stage of a larger host.
Customers: the forwarding loop-host variant behind `exists_emitLoopTM`,
and `exists_emitCallTM`'s module. Construction: a record map, no
machine content. -/
def emitAction (emb : S → H) (ret : H) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    Action k Bool H where
  inputTape := a.inputTape
  workTapes := a.workTapes
  output := a.output
  state := some ((a.state.map emb).getD ret)

/-- **E2 configuration correspondence** (design §11): a source
configuration `c`, viewed inside the host — state embedded (a halted source
appears at the live return state `ret`), tapes, heads, and input position
verbatim, and the host's physical output equal to the host's prior output
`pre` followed by everything the source has emitted. It deliberately does
**not** normalize the source's terminal tapes or heads: clean returns are
the separate bridge contracts' job (`exists_installCallTM`,
`exists_emitCallTM` — emitter-infra round-1 audit, finding 1). Customers:
`emit_run`'s statement and the bridge fills. Construction: a record map,
no machine content. -/
def emitCfg {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) :
    Cfg k Bool H input where
  state := some ((c.state.map emb).getD ret)
  inputPos := c.inputPos
  workTapes := c.workTapes
  workTapePos := c.workTapePos
  output := pre ++ c.output

/-- Applying a forwarded action preserves the source fields and appends its
optional emission after the host prefix, including when that action halts.
**Proof sketch.** The state, input head, work tapes, and work heads agree
definitionally; the physical output equality is append associativity. -/
private lemma emit_apply {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (pre : List Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (a : Action k Bool S) :
    (emitAction emb ret a).apply (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (a.apply c) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl rfl rfl ?_
  exact List.append_assoc pre c.output a.output.toList

/-- **E2, the forwarding wrapper** (design §11;
customers: the emitting loop's per-round chunk calls, the Cook-Levin
clause-group emission (4A), 3B-cont's fresh-literal chains). Any host
machine agreeing with the transformed table on an embedded copy of the
source states runs the source in lockstep while **appending the source's
output to the host's physical output**, the exact dual of
`Turing.capture_run`: source tapes verbatim, the halting transition's
emission forwarded like any other, and the host landing in the live
return state at the source's halt.

**Construction sketch.** Mirror `capture_run`: one `emitAction`-apply
lemma (source fields preserved; the optional emission appended to the
host output after `pre`), then induction over the guarded run, the guard
supplying a genuine source step including at the final halt. -/
theorem emit_run {input : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H) (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
    (hagree : ∀ (s : S) (inp : Option Bool) (w : Fin k → Option Bool),
      host.tr (emb s) inp w = emitAction emb ret (tm.tr s inp w))
    (pre : List Bool) (c₀ : Cfg k Bool S input) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ t' < t, ¬(tm.runFrom c₀ t').Halted) :
    host.runFrom (emitCfg emb ret pre c₀) t =
      emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.runFrom c₀ t) := by
  have hstep (c : Cfg k Bool S input) (hs : ¬c.Halted) :
      host.step (emitCfg emb ret pre c) =
        emitCfg emb ret pre (tm.step c) := by
    cases hq : c.state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have hstate : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).state = some (emb q) := by
        simp [emitCfg, hq]
      have hinput : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
      have hwork : (emitCfg emb ret pre c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hq]
      rw [hagree, hinput, hwork]
      exact emit_apply emb ret pre c _
  -- The guard supplies a genuine source step, including at the final halt.
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun s hs => hlive s (by omega)),
      hstep _ (hlive t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

end Turing

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- W2 transformation: the `acceptTM` control-modification pattern. Simulate
`M` with its output suppressed while a finite register remembers the **last**
emitted bit (`none` before any emission) — updated *before* the halt test, so
a bit emitted on the halting transition counts. When the source halts, halt
if the remembered bit is `haltOn`; otherwise enter the one-state stationary
live loop. Tape count unchanged. -/
def redirectTM (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := M.k
  State := (M.State × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit
  tm :=
    { q₀ := Sum.inl (M.tm.q₀, none)
      tr := fun q inp work =>
        match q with
        | Sum.inl (s, r) =>
          let a := M.tm.tr s inp work
          let r' := match a.output with
            | some b => some b
            | none => r
          { inputTape := a.inputTape
            workTapes := a.workTapes
            output := none
            state := match a.state with
              | some s' => some (Sum.inl (s', r'))
              | none => if r' = some haltOn then none else some (Sum.inr ()) }
        | Sum.inr () =>
          { inputTape := SignType.zero
            workTapes := fun _ => (none, SignType.zero)
            output := none
            state := some (Sum.inr ()) } }

/-- Map a source state and its last-emission register to simulation, halt,
or the stationary live loop. An empty register never matches a bit. -/
private def redirectState {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool) (q : Option S)
    (r : Option Bool) : Option ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  match q with
  | some s => some (.inl (s, r))
  | none => if r = some haltOn then none else some (.inr ())

/-- Suppress physical emission, updating the register before the halt test. -/
private def redirectAction {k : ℕ} {S : Type} (haltOn : Bool)
    (a : Action k Bool S) (r : Option Bool) : Action k Bool ((S × Option Bool) ⊕ Unit) :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, none, redirectState haltOn a.state (a.output.or r)⟩

/-- The source tapes and input head are unchanged; its last emitted bit is
remembered in control and the physical output is empty. -/
private def redirectCfg (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool
      (redirectTM M haltOn).State x :=
  ⟨redirectState haltOn c.state c.output.getLast?, c.inputPos,
    c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, []⟩

/-- The stationary live loop is fixed by every subsequent transition. -/
private lemma redirect_loop (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (redirectTM M haltOn).k Bool (redirectTM M haltOn).State x)
    (hs : c.state = some (.inr ())) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom c t = c := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [MultiTapeTM.step, hs, redirectTM, Action.apply]

/-- Capture and application commute because the last entry of an appended
singleton is the new bit, while no emission leaves the old register intact. -/
private lemma redirect_apply (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (a : Action M.k Bool M.State) :
    (redirectAction haltOn a c.output.getLast?).apply (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (a.apply c) := by
  have hlast : (c.output ++ a.output.toList).getLast? = a.output.or c.output.getLast? := by
    cases a.output <;> simp
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ rfl rfl rfl rfl
  dsimp only [redirectCfg, redirectAction, Action.apply]
  rw [hlast]

/-- The correspondence also holds after a source halt: a matching result
is absorbed as halted, and a mismatching result is absorbed in the live loop.
This adapts `acceptCfg_step` in the HALT reduction to an optional register. -/
private lemma redirect_step (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.step (redirectCfg M haltOn c) =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.step c) := by
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hs]
    by_cases hr : c.output.getLast? = some haltOn
    · exact MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr])
    · exact redirect_loop M haltOn (redirectCfg M haltOn c)
        (by simp [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs, hr]) 1
  | some q =>
    have hi : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).workTapeSymbols = c.workTapeSymbols := rfl
    have hstate : (redirectCfg M haltOn c).state = some (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?)) := by
      simp only [redirectCfg, redirectState, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    rw [hi, hw]
    have htr : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.tr (.inl (q, c.output.getLast?))
        c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols =
        redirectAction haltOn (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols) c.output.getLast? := by
      cases hq : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state <;>
        cases ho : (M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).output <;>
          simp [redirectTM, redirectAction, redirectState, hq, ho]
    rw [htr]
    exact redirect_apply M haltOn c _

/-- Initialized runs commute with redirection at every time, including
after a source halt. This is the last-emission invariant for both clauses. -/
private lemma redirect_run (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t =
      redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t) := by
  have hi : (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x = redirectCfg M haltOn (M.tm.initCfg x) := rfl
  rw [hi]
  exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (redirectCfg M haltOn) (redirect_step M haltOn)
    (M.tm.initCfg x) t

/-- **W2, the halting clause** (harvested from the
HALT batch's `acceptTM_halts_iff`). If `M` completes output `w` on `x`
within `t` steps and the last bit of `w` is the designated bit, the
redirected machine halts on `x` within the same budget with **empty**
output (everything was suppressed).

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep correspondence between `M`'s run and the
redirected run, carrying "register = last emitted bit so far"; at `M`'s
halting transition the register equals `w`'s last bit, so the redirect
halts there. -/
theorem redirectTM_computes {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? = some haltOn) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).ComputesInTime x [] t := by
  obtain ⟨hs, hout⟩ := (computesInTime_iff M x w t).mp hM
  apply (computesInTime_iff _ x [] t).mpr
  rw [redirect_run]
  exact ⟨by simp only [redirectCfg, hs, hout, redirectState, hlast, ite_true], rfl⟩

/-- **W2, the live clause**. If `M` completes output
`w` on `x` and `w`'s last bit is *not* the designated bit (in particular if
`w = []`), the redirected machine never halts on `x`: at the source's
halting transition it enters the stationary live loop, which is fixed under
every further step.

**Proof sketch.** Lockstep with the register invariant (register = last
emission so far) up to the source's halting transition; there the register
differs from the designated bit, so control enters the stationary live
state, which every further step fixes (two-line induction). -/
theorem redirectTM_live {M : FinTM Bool} {haltOn : Bool}
    {x w : List Bool} {t : ℕ} (hM : M.ComputesInTime x w t)
    (hlast : w.getLast? ≠ some haltOn) :
    ∀ u : ℕ, ¬((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) u).Halted := by
  intro u hhalt
  rw [redirect_run] at hhalt
  change redirectState haltOn (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state
    (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output.getLast? = none at hhalt
  -- A redirected halt forces a genuine source halt with the matching register.
  have hs : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state = none := by
    cases h : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).state with
    | none => rfl
    | some q => simp only [redirectState, h, reduceCtorEq] at hhalt
  have hc : M.ComputesInTime x (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) u).output u :=
    (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have hout := hc.output_unique hM
  rw [hs, hout] at hhalt
  simp only [redirectState, if_neg hlast, Option.some_ne_none] at hhalt

/-- **The redirect correspondence**. At every time `t`, the redirected machine's configuration on
`x` has the source run's input position, work tapes and work heads, an empty output, and the state
that the source state and the source's last emitted bit determine: the source state with that bit
while the source is live; after the source halts, halted if the bit is `haltOn`, and the stationary
live loop otherwise.

**Proof sketch.** Rewrite with the private `redirect_run`, which states that the run is the
image of the source run under the private `redirectCfg`; each conjunct is then a field of that
image, by `rfl`. -/
theorem redirectTM_runFrom (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).state =
        (match (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).state with
          | some s => some (.inl (s, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast?))
          | none =>
            if (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).output.getLast? = some haltOn then none
            else some (.inr ())) ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).inputPos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapes ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos =
        (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos ∧
      ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.runFrom ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t).output = [] := by
  rw [redirect_run]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  generalize M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t = c
  rcases c with ⟨q, p, tapes, heads, out⟩
  cases q <;> rfl

/-- **W2 space row** (design §12 R3, decision 12.3;
annotates `Turing.FinTM.redirectTM` beside its
`redirectTM_computes`/`redirectTM_live` contract pair). Redirection costs
no space, per tape and exactly: the redirected machine's tape actions are
the source's verbatim, before and after the source halt.

**Proof sketch.** `redirect_run`'s configuration correspondence preserves
work tapes and heads at every time (the live loop is stationary and the
simulation phase copies the source's tape actions), so the two head
trajectories coincide pointwise and the visited images agree. -/
theorem redirectTM_spaceUsedByTape (M : FinTM Bool) (haltOn : Bool)
    (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    (redirectTM M haltOn).tm.spaceUsedByTape
        ((redirectTM M haltOn).tm.initCfg x) t i
      = M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff, (redirectTM_runFrom M haltOn x _).2.2.2.1]

/-- Pad the decider with the fresh branch tapes. The added tapes are idle,
so the public left-block simulation supplies its complete run invariant. -/
private def timedPadTM (D : FinTM Bool) (r : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM (D.k + r) Bool D.State where
  q₀ := D.tm.q₀
  tr q inp work := leftAction r id (D.tm.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castAdd r i)))

/-- **The timed conditional**. Run the decider `D` with its output captured on the last tape, step
back to read the verdict, rewind the input, then run `M₁` or `M₂`, as the verdict says, from its
genuine initial configuration on its own untouched tape bank (W3). The branch tapes are idle while
`D` runs. -/
def timedCondTM (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) : FinTM Bool where
  k := (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1
  State := D.State ⊕ (Bool ⊕ ((Bool × Bool) ⊕ (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State)))
  tm :=
    { q₀ := .inl D.tm.q₀
      tr := fun q inp work => match q with
        | .inl q => captureAction Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false))
            ((timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)).tr q inp (fun i => work i.castSucc))
        | .inr (.inl false) =>
          ⟨0, (fun i => if (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k) then (none, 0)
            else (none, .neg)), none, some (.inr (.inl true))⟩
        | .inr (.inl true) => controlAction 0
            (some (.inr (.inr (.inl ((work (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))) =>
            controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))) => match inp with
          | some _ => controlAction .neg (some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true)))))
          | none => controlAction .pos
              (some (.inr (.inr (.inr (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀))))
        | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => leftAction 1 id
            (rightAction D.k (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s)))
              ((branchTM M₁ M₂ false).tm.tr q inp
                (fun i => work (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc))) }

/-- The branch configuration retains the decider's finished work and the
captured verdict; its own state, input head, work tapes, and output are exact. -/
private def timedBranchCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  leftCfg id (rightCfg (fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))) c tapes heads)
    (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)

/-- The decider's configuration inside its padded, captured simulation.
Both branch tape banks are blank throughout this phase. -/
private def timedControlCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  captureCfg Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun (_ : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k)) _ => none) (fun _ => 0))

/-- The capture contract, instantiated on the padded decider, gives the
entire controller phase through its first halt. -/
private lemma timed_capture (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ s < t, ¬(D.tm.runFrom c s).Halted) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom c t) := by
  have hpad (u : ℕ) := leftCfg_run D.tm (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) id
    (fun _ _ _ => rfl) c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) u
  have h := capture_run (timedPadTM D (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    Sum.inl (.inr (.inl false)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) [] []
    (leftCfg id c (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)) t (fun s hs => by
      unfold Cfg.Halted
      rw [hpad s]
      simpa only [leftCfg, Option.map_id] using hlive s hs)
  simpa only [hpad t] using h

/-- The host's genuine initial configuration is the captured, padded
initial configuration: all three work-tape blocks are blank. -/
private lemma timed_control_init (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.initCfg x) := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]
  · funext i
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)
    · simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg,
        Cfg.init, dif_pos hi]
      exact (Fin.addCases (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ => by simp) ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hi]

/-- Once dispatched, the selected branch runs in lockstep while the old
decider tapes and singleton capture tape remain idle.
**Proof sketch.** The branch action is a right-block embedding followed by
a left-block embedding; compose their application lemmas, then iterate. -/
private lemma timed_branch_run (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b) t =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.runFrom c t) tapes heads b := by
  apply MultiTapeTM.runFrom_comm_of_step (fun c => timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b)
  intro d
  cases hs : d.state with
  | none =>
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_none]
  | some q =>
    have hstate : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).state =
        some (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) := by
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, hs, Option.map_some, id_eq]
    have hi : (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).inputSymbol = d.inputSymbol := rfl
    have hw : (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc) = d.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext i
      simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols,
        Fin.castSucc, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate, hs]
    dsimp only [timedCondTM]
    let emb : (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) → (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State :=
      fun s => .inr (.inr (.inr s))
    change (leftAction 1 id (rightAction D.k emb
      ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.tr q d.inputSymbol
        (fun i => (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ d tapes heads b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc)))).apply
        (leftCfg id (rightCfg emb d tapes heads)
          (fun (_ : Fin 1) => bufferTape [b]) (fun _ => 0)) = _
    erw [hw, leftCfg_apply, rightCfg_apply]
    rfl

/-- After reading the verdict, all branch data are initialized; only the
input head still needs rewinding. The capture head is back at cell zero. -/
private def timedReadyCfg (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x :=
  { timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b with
    state := some (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false))))
    inputPos := c.inputPos }

/-- Two silent transitions move the capture head left and read the completed
singleton verdict, without touching the input or either work bank.
**Proof sketch.** The final capture head is one past the singleton, hence at
one. Moving it left exposes exactly its bit at zero; the next transition
records that bit in the rewind state. -/
private lemma timed_read (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) 2 =
      timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b := by
  let ready := timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b
  have hback : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) =
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} := by
    have hstate : (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).state = some (.inr (.inl false)) := by
      simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg, hs]
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hstate]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl (moveInputPos_zero _) ?_ ?_ rfl
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, j.isLt]
        refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro z <;> simp
      · intro j
        simp [timedCondTM, Action.apply, timedControlCfg, captureCfg, leftCfg,
          timedReadyCfg, timedBranchCfg, rightCfg, ready, ho]
  have hread : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
      {ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} = ready := by
    have hsym : ({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _) = some b := by
      change (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)
        c.workTapes c.workTapePos b).workTapeSymbols
          (Fin.natAdd (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (0 : Fin 1)) = some b
      simp [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg, rightCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, bufferTape]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    dsimp only
    change ((controlAction 0 (some (.inr (.inr (.inl
      ((({ready with state := some (.inr (.inl true))} :
        Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x).workTapeSymbols
        (Fin.last _)).getD false, false)))))) :
          Action (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State).apply _ = _
    rw [hsym, controlAction_apply]
    simp only [Option.getD_some, moveInputPos_zero]
    rfl
  change (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step
    ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.step (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c)) = _
  rw [hback, hread]

/-- A singleton-output decider reaches the selected branch's genuine
initial configuration in at most twice its budget plus five steps.
**Proof sketch.** Use `Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt` for the first source halt within
budget and its exact completed singleton output. Capture until that halt, read the singleton in
two steps, and rewind in at most the current input position plus two. Charge this rewind to the
decider's elapsed steps using the head-position bound. -/
private lemma timed_start (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (show Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x from by
          simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)) tapes heads b := by
  classical
  let branchInit : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x := by
    simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x)
  let branchStart : M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State := by
    simpa only [branchTM_State] using (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.q₀
  have hbranchInit : branchInit = Cfg.init branchStart x := by
    simpa only [branchInit, branchStart, branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using
      (MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq (tm := (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm) x)
  change ∃ a ≤ 2 * T + 5, ∃ (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ),
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ branchInit tapes heads b
  have hspec := (computesInTime_iff D x [b] T).mp hD
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlive, heq⟩ :=
    MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt D.tm (D.tm.initCfg x) hspec.1
  let c := D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t
  have hs : c.state = none := by
    change (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t).state = none
    rw [heq]
    exact hspec.1
  have ho : c.output = [b] := by
    change (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) t).output = [b]
    rw [heq]
    exact hspec.2
  have hcap : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t =
      timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c := by
    rw [timed_control_init]
    exact timed_capture D M₁ M₂ _ t hlive
  obtain ⟨r, hrle, hr⟩ := timed_rewind (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false)))) (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))))
    (some (.inr (.inr (.inr branchStart))))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl)
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b) rfl
  refine ⟨t + 2 + r, ?_, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, ?_⟩
  · have hp : c.inputPos.val ≤ 1 + t := by
      simpa only [c, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos, Fin.val_one] using
        MultiTapeTM.timed_input_bound (tm := D.tm) (D.tm.initCfg x) t
    change r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2 at hrle
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap,
      timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho, hr]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_state, rightCfg_state,
        hbranchInit, Cfg.init_state, Option.map_some, id_eq]
    · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_inputPos, rightCfg_inputPos,
        hbranchInit, Cfg.init_inputPos]
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl

/-- **The timed conditional's time**. If `D` computes the verdict `[p x]` within `T₀` and `M₁`, `M₂`
compute `f₁`, `f₂` within `T₁`, `T₂`, the timed conditional computes `if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x`
within `5·(T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)` steps; no monotonicity is needed, since the selected
branch runs on the same physical input.

**Proof sketch.** The captured decider run, the two-step verdict read and the input rewind take
at most `2·T₀ + 5` steps (`timed_start`; the input head has moved at most once per decider step),
and the selected branch then runs from its own initial configuration (`timed_branch_run`,
`branchTM_computes`) within `max T₁ T₂`; `2·T₀ + 5 + max T₁ T₂` is at most the stated bound. -/
theorem timedCondTM_computes {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesFunInTime
      (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
      (fun n => 5 * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) := by
  refine (computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mpr fun x => ?_
  let B := max (T₁ x.length) (T₂ x.length)
  have hb : (branchTM M₁ M₂ (p x)).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) B := by
    apply (branchTM_computes M₁ M₂ (p x) x _ B).mpr
    cases hp : p x with
    | false => exact ((computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp h₂ x).mono (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
    | true => exact ((computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp h₁ x).mono (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, tapes, heads, hstart⟩ :=
    timed_start D M₁ M₂ x (p x) (T₀ x.length) ((computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hD x)
  let V : Bool → MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) :=
    fun tag => by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ tag, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ tag]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ tag).tm
  let start := (V (p x)).initCfg x
  have hstart' :
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) a =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ start tapes heads (p x) := by
    dsimp only [start, V]
    simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using hstart
  have hr : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom
      (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ start tapes heads (p x)) B =
        timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ ((V (p x)).runFrom start B) tapes heads (p x) := by
    dsimp only [V]
    simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using
      timed_branch_run D M₁ M₂ start tapes heads (p x) B
  obtain ⟨hs, ho⟩ := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hb
  have halted : ((V (p x)).runFrom start B).state = none := by
    simpa only [start, V, branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using hs
  have output : ((V (p x)).runFrom start B).output =
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) := by
    simpa only [start, V, branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using ho
  have hc : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).ComputesInTime x
      (if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x) (a + B) := by
    apply (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart', hr]
    exact ⟨by simpa only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_state, rightCfg_state,
      Option.map_eq_none_iff] using halted,
      by simpa only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_output, rightCfg_output] using output⟩
  apply hc.mono
  dsimp only [B] at *
  omega

/-- Head layout of the timed controller: decider heads, branch-bank heads, and one scalar
capture position. -/
private def timedHeads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (d : Fin D.k → ℤ)
    (b : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k) → ℤ) (z : ℤ) :
    Fin ((D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1) → ℤ :=
  Fin.addCases (Fin.addCases d b) (fun _ => z)

/-- The captured decider has its source positions, idle branches, and a
capture head at its output length. -/
private lemma timed_control_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) :
    (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) c.output.length := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg_workTapePos, leftCfg_workTapePos, timedHeads, j.isLt]
  · simp [timedControlCfg, captureCfg_workTapePos, leftCfg_output, timedHeads]

/-- A dispatched branch keeps the completed decider's heads and the
capture head fixed while simulating precisely its selected bank. -/
private lemma timed_branch_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) x)
    (tapes : Fin D.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (heads : Fin D.k → ℤ) (b : Bool) :
    (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ c tapes heads b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ heads c.workTapePos 0 := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_workTapePos, rightCfg_workTapePos, timedHeads,
      Fin.addCases_left]
  · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_workTapePos, timedHeads, Fin.addCases_right]

/-- After the verdict read, the decider heads are where it halted, the branch bank is at its
origin and the capture head at zero. -/
private lemma timedReadyCfg_workTapePos (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) 0 := by
  let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
    rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
    exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
  have h0 : (V.initCfg x).workTapePos = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext i
    rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  have h := timed_branch_heads D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b
  rw [h0] at h
  dsimp only [timedReadyCfg, V] at h ⊢
  simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using h

/-- Dispatching from the ready configuration, with the input head back at `1`, gives the
selected branch union's initial configuration in the branch bank. -/
private lemma timedReady_dispatch (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ({timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b with
        state := some (.inr (.inr (.inr V.q₀))), inputPos := 1} :
      Cfg (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).k Bool (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).State x) =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b := by
  dsimp only
  simp only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State]
  refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_state, rightCfg_state, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq,
      Cfg.init_state, Option.map_some, id_eq]
  · simp only [timedBranchCfg, leftCfg_inputPos, rightCfg_inputPos,
      MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos]
  · simp only [timedReadyCfg, branchTM_k, branchTM_State]
  · simp only [timedReadyCfg, branchTM_k, branchTM_State]
  · simp only [timedReadyCfg, branchTM_k, branchTM_State]

/-- The mandatory back/read pair preserves both machine banks and moves
only the singleton capture head from one to zero. -/
private lemma timed_read_heads (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg D.k Bool D.State x) (b : Bool) (hs : c.state = none) (ho : c.output = [b]) :
    ∀ u ≤ 2, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ c.workTapePos (fun _ => 0) z := by
  intro u hu
  have hu : u = 0 ∨ u = 1 ∨ u = 2 := by omega
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · refine ⟨1, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    simpa [ho] using timed_control_heads D M₁ M₂ c
  · refine ⟨0, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    have hstate : (timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ c).state = some (.inr (.inl false)) := by
      simp only [timedControlCfg, captureCfg_state, leftCfg_state, hs,
        Option.map_none, Option.getD_none]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
      MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hstate]
    funext i
    rw [Action.apply_workTapePos, timed_control_heads]
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [timedCondTM, timedHeads, j.isLt]
    · simp [timedCondTM, timedHeads, ho]
  · refine ⟨0, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho, timedReadyCfg_workTapePos]

/-- **The timed conditional's head ledger.** At every time the controller's heads are a decider
head layout at some time `v ≤ T`, a branch-union head layout at some time `w ≤ u`, and a capture
head in `{0, 1}`.

**Proof sketch.** Split at the decider's first halt `d ≤ T` (`exists_first_halt`). Before it, the captured run
(`timed_capture`) shows the decider at time `u` and the capture head at its output length, at
most one. During the two-step verdict read (`timed_read_heads`) and the input rewind
(`rewind_heads`), the decider heads stay at time `d` and the branch bank at its origin. After the
dispatch, the branch union runs in lockstep (`timed_branch_run`) from its initial
configuration. -/
private lemma timed_ledger (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
      rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
      exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
    ∀ u, ∃ v ≤ T, ∃ w ≤ u, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos =
        timedHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
          (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z := by
  dsimp only
  let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
    rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
    exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
  change ∀ u, ∃ v ≤ T, ∃ w ≤ u, ∃ z : ℤ, 0 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 1 ∧
    ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u).workTapePos =
      timedHeads D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) v).workTapePos
        (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z
  obtain ⟨hTs, hTo⟩ := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hD
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hlive, hcfg⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt D.tm (D.tm.initCfg x) hTs
  let c := D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) d
  have hs : c.state = none := by
    change (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) d).state = none
    rw [hcfg]
    exact hTs
  have ho : c.output = [b] := by
    change (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) d).output = [b]
    rw [hcfg]
    exact hTo
  have hcap (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ d) :
      (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) u =
        timedControlCfg D M₁ M₂ (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) u) := by
    rw [timed_control_init]
    exact timed_capture D M₁ M₂ _ u (fun s hsu => hlive s (by omega))
  obtain ⟨r, hrle, hr, hrheads⟩ := rewind_heads (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm
    (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, false)))) (.inr (.inr (.inl (b, true))))
    (some (.inr (.inr (.inr V.q₀))))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by
      cases inp with
      | none =>
        dsimp only [timedCondTM, V]
        simp only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State]
        rfl
      | some _ => rfl)
    (timedReadyCfg D M₁ M₂ c b) rfl
  have hstart : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom
      ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) (d + 2 + r) =
      timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap d (le_refl _),
      timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho, hr]
    exact timedReady_dispatch D M₁ M₂ c b
  have h0 : (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) 0).workTapePos =
      fun _ => 0 := by
    funext i
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  intro u
  by_cases hu : u ≤ d
  · -- The captured decider phase.
    refine ⟨u, hu.trans hd, 0, Nat.zero_le _,
      (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) u).output.length, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp := (D.tm.output_prefix (D.tm.initCfg x) hu).length_le
      change (D.tm.runFrom (D.tm.initCfg x) u).output.length ≤ c.output.length at hp
      rw [ho] at hp
      simp only [List.length_singleton] at hp
      exact_mod_cast hp
    · rw [hcap u hu, timed_control_heads, h0]
  · refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
    by_cases hread : u ≤ d + 2
    · -- The verdict read.
      obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1, he⟩ := timed_read_heads D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho (u - d) (by omega)
      refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, z, hz0, hz1, ?_⟩
      rw [show u = d + (u - d) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap d (le_refl _), h0]
      exact he
    · by_cases hrew : u ≤ d + 2 + r
      · -- The input rewind moves no work head.
        refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, 0, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [show u = d + 2 + (u - (d + 2)) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hcap d (le_refl _), timed_read D M₁ M₂ c b hs ho,
          hrheads _ (by omega), timedReadyCfg_workTapePos, h0]
      · -- The dispatched branch union.
        refine ⟨u - (d + 2 + r), by omega, 0, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
        have hbranch : (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom
            (timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b)
              (u - (d + 2 + r)) =
            timedBranchCfg D M₁ M₂ (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) (u - (d + 2 + r)))
              c.workTapes c.workTapePos b := by
          have legacy := timed_branch_run D M₁ M₂ (V.initCfg x) c.workTapes c.workTapePos b
            (u - (d + 2 + r))
          dsimp only [V] at legacy ⊢
          simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using legacy
        rw [show u = d + 2 + r + (u - (d + 2 + r)) by omega,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstart, hbranch, timed_branch_heads]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        rfl

/-- **The timed conditional's space**. If `D` outputs `[b]` on `x` within `T` steps, then at every
time `t` the conditional's space is at most `D`'s space at time `T`, plus the branch union's space
at time `t`, plus two cells for the capture tape.

**Proof sketch.** The three tape groups are disjoint. By the head ledger `timed_ledger`, every
decider-bank head position the controller visits is one the decider visits by time `T`, every
branch-bank position is one the branch union visits by time `t`, and the capture head stays in
`{0, 1}`. Compare the visited sets tape by tape and split the sum over the three groups with
`Fin.sum_univ_add`. -/
theorem timedCondTM_spaceUsed (D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T t : ℕ)
    (hD : D.ComputesInTime x [b] T) :
    (timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.spaceUsed ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T +
        (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.spaceUsed ((branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm.initCfg x) t + 2 := by
  let M := timedCondTM D M₁ M₂
  let V : MultiTapeTM (M₁.k + M₂.k) Bool (M₁.State ⊕ M₂.State) := by
    rw [← branchTM_k M₁ M₂ b, ← branchTM_State M₁ M₂ b]
    exact (branchTM M₁ M₂ b).tm
  suffices h : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤
      D.tm.spaceUsed (D.tm.initCfg x) T + V.spaceUsed (V.initCfg x) t + 2 by
    dsimp only [M, V] at h
    simpa only [branchTM_k, branchTM_State] using h
  have hDcard (i : Fin D.k) :
      M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t ((Fin.castAdd (M₁.k + M₂.k) i).castSucc) ≤
        D.tm.spaceUsedByTape (D.tm.initCfg x) T i := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
    refine Finset.card_le_card fun p hp => ?_
    obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mp hp
    obtain ⟨v, hv, w, -, z, -, -, he⟩ := timed_ledger D M₁ M₂ x b T hD u
    refine (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
    change _ = ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom _ u).workTapePos _
    rw [he]
    rw [show (Fin.castAdd (M₁.k + M₂.k) i).castSucc =
      Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd (M₁.k + M₂.k) i) from rfl]
    simp only [timedHeads, Fin.addCases_left]
  have hBcard (i : Fin (M₁.k + M₂.k)) :
      M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t ((Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc) ≤
        V.spaceUsedByTape (V.initCfg x) t i := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
    refine Finset.card_le_card fun p hp => ?_
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mp hp
    obtain ⟨v, -, w, hw, z, -, -, he⟩ := timed_ledger D M₁ M₂ x b T hD u
    change _ = timedHeads D M₁ M₂ _ (V.runFrom (V.initCfg x) w).workTapePos z at he
    refine (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨w, hw.trans hu, ?_⟩
    change _ = ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom _ u).workTapePos _
    rw [he]
    rw [show (Fin.natAdd D.k i).castSucc = Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd D.k i) from rfl]
    simp only [timedHeads, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
  have hcap : M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t (Fin.last _) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card]
    have hsub : M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t (Fin.last _) ⊆
        Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) 1 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mp hp
      obtain ⟨v, -, w, -, z, hz0, hz1, he⟩ := timed_ledger D M₁ M₂ x b T hD u
      change ((timedCondTM D M₁ M₂).tm.runFrom _ u).workTapePos _ ∈ _
      rw [he]
      rw [show Fin.last (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) =
        Fin.natAdd (D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) (0 : Fin 1) from rfl]
      simpa only [timedHeads, Fin.addCases_right] using Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hz0, hz1⟩
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (by decide)
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum, MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum]
  change (∑ i : Fin ((D.k + (M₁.k + M₂.k)) + 1), M.tm.spaceUsedByTape (M.tm.initCfg x) t i) ≤ _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_unique]
  exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hDcard i))
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hBcard i))) hcap

/-- **W3, the timed branch**: the quantitative form of
`Turing.FinTM.exists_cond`. If a decider machine computes the test bit
within `T₀` and each branch computes its function within `T₁`, `T₂`, the
conditional function is computable within a constant multiple of
`T₀ + max T₁ T₂ + 1`. No monotonicity hypothesis: the selected branch runs
on the *same* physical input.

**Proof sketch.** Run the decider through the W1 capture discipline (its
verdict on the capture tape, physical output silent), rewind per the
`Turing.FinTM.rewind_from_any` scan, then dispatch on the captured bit into
the two-machine branch union (`Turing.FinTM.branchTM`), which runs the
selected branch from its genuine initial configuration on the shared input.
Constant overhead per phase is absorbed into `c`. -/
theorem computesFunInTime_cond {D M₁ M₂ : FinTM Bool} {p : List Bool → Bool}
    {f₁ f₂ : List Bool → List Bool} {T₀ T₁ T₂ : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hD : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => [p x]) T₀)
    (h₁ : M₁.ComputesFunInTime f₁ T₁) (h₂ : M₂.ComputesFunInTime f₂ T₂) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ),
      M.ComputesFunInTime (fun x => if p x then f₁ x else f₂ x)
        (fun n => c * (T₀ n + max (T₁ n) (T₂ n) + 1)) :=
  ⟨timedCondTM D M₁ M₂, 5, timedCondTM_computes hD h₁ h₂⟩

end Turing.FinTM

import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.CodeFormat
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.CounterLoop
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.StepBlock
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.StepBlockLoop
-- B5a continuation: sanctioned imports for the physical binary-header loader.
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputCall
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputRewind
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Nondeterministic
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InterpreterStartup

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The uniform code simulator

One format-parameterized simulator for deterministic machine codes: on
`⟨⟨bits t, α⟩, x⟩` it decides whether the machine that `α` denotes halts on `x`
with output exactly `[true]` within `t` steps, in time **one polynomial in
`|α| + |x| + t + 1` jointly**. The parameter is a `Turing.MachineFormat`: a
`Turing.CodeFormat` (12.2c item 8's parse layer) whose codes denote `k`-work-tape
binary machines in the fixed `k`-record serialization. The one-work-tape codes
(`Turing.oneTapeMachineFormat`) and the two-work-tape codes of `Codes2Tape` are
instances; they supply `Turing.exists_uniformMachineCode` (`Diagonalization/EXPCOM`)
and `Turing.exists_uniformMachineCode2` (`Codes2Tape`). [AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9;
the uniform form required by Example 3.6(3), audited at phase P3.2 round 2]

## Design

* **One interpreter, parameterized by the record grammar.** The table of a
  `k`-tape code is `3^(k+1)` `Turing.actionBitsK` records per state
  (`Turing.tableBitsK`); a single finite machine per format interprets it.
* **Canonize first, then interpret.** The decoded machine's serialization is
  computed in polynomial time (`Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer`):
  the binary state count and the minimum-length guard are checked before any
  state-indexed work, so a huge declared count is never expanded in unary.
* **The clock is §12.7's counter loop** (`Turing.counterLoopTM`) over the
  deadline's binary word; a simulated halt is a live body exit.
* **Status.** The canonizer `Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer` is proved, with
  no admission. A validator (`exists_canonDecider`) runs the two-port parse front end
  (`exists_canonParseFront`: header validity, canonicality and the binary length guard) and
  the grammar stage (`exists_canonGrammarStage`) on one bank and emits one verdict bit; the
  strip machine (`exists_canonStripTM`) or the constant fallback follows. The grammar stage
  checks the unary initial state against the header (the bounded unary reader
  `exists_canonUnaryTM`), runs two nested public counter loops, over `n + 1` states and
  `3^(k+1)` records each, on the fresh-anchor record round (`canonReturnAdapter` around the
  record validator `exists_canonRecordTM`), and tests the all-`true` suffix; its time is
  quadratic in the input length and independent of the header's value.
  The uniform simulator `Turing.MachineFormat.exists_uniformSimulator` is proved, with no
  admission: the interpreter startup (`Turing.exists_interpreterStartup`, with the canonizer
  installed) seamed to the binary deadline clock around the complete generic step block
  `Turing.StepBlock.roundTM` of `Build/StepBlock`, hosted on the virtual input, with its one-bit
  verdict (`h1HostedVerdict_accepts`), the clock being the public loop
  `Turing.StepBlock.hostedLoopTM_run` of `Build/StepBlockLoop`.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.serializeK`, `Turing.codeSkipTableK` — the fixed `k`-record serialization
  and grammar, over the table layout `Turing.workReadsK`, `Turing.tableBitsK` of
  `Build/StepBlock`.
* `Turing.serializeK_eq` — the serialization as an equation, the specification API (user,
  2026-10-16).
* `Turing.MachineFormat`, `Turing.MachineFormat.toFinTM` — the format parameter.
* `Turing.oneTapeMachineFormat` — the one-work-tape instance.

## Main results

* `Turing.tableBitsK_two`, `Turing.codeSkipTable2_eq_codeSkipTableK` — the
  two-work-tape bridges to `CodeFormat`'s frozen table writer and skipper.
* `Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer` — a polynomial-time canonizer.
* `Turing.MachineFormat.exists_uniformSimulator` — the uniform simulator.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.4, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9; Example 3.6(3).)
-/

namespace Turing

/-! ## The `k`-record layout -/

/-- The canonical serialization of a `k`-work-tape binary machine with `n + 1`
states: the binary state count, the unary initial state, the table. [AB09, §1.4] -/
def serializeK {k n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode n.bits (unaryFin M.q₀ ++ tableBitsK M.tr)

/-- **The serialization as an equation** (the specification API, user 2026-10-16): the doubled
binary state count, the separator, the unary initial state, then the table. Consumers read the
captured serialization through this equation (with `Turing.pairEncode_eq` and
`Turing.unaryFin_eq`), not by unfolding `Turing.serializeK`. -/
theorem serializeK_eq {k n : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :
    serializeK M = pairEncode n.bits (unaryFin M.q₀ ++ tableBitsK M.tr) :=
  rfl

/-- The table skipper of the `k`-record grammar: `n + 1` states of `3^(k+1)`
records each. [AB09, §1.4] -/
def codeSkipTableK (k n : ℕ) : List Bool → Option (List Bool) :=
  codeSkipRepeat ((fun r => codeSkipRepeat r 3)^[k + 1] (codeSkipActionK k n)) (n + 1)

/-- A one-tape read vector built by `Fin.cons` is the constant function. -/
private lemma fin_cons_one (w : Option Bool) :
    (Fin.cons w Fin.elim0 : Fin 1 → Option Bool) = fun _ => w := by
  funext i; fin_cases i; rfl

/-- A two-tape read vector built by `Fin.cons` is the `Turing.workPair` of its entries. -/
private lemma fin_cons_two (w₀ w₁ : Option Bool) :
    (Fin.cons w₀ (fun _ : Fin 1 => w₁) : Fin 2 → Option Bool) = workPair w₀ w₁ := by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl

/-- The one-work-tape reads are the constant functions, in table order. -/
lemma workReadsK_one : workReadsK 1 =
    ([none, some false, some true] : List (Option Bool)).map fun w => fun _ => w := by
  simp [workReadsK, fin_cons_one]

/-- The two-work-tape reads are the `Turing.workPair`s, in table order. -/
lemma workReadsK_two : workReadsK 2 =
    ([none, some false, some true] : List (Option Bool)).flatMap fun w₀ =>
      ([none, some false, some true] : List (Option Bool)).map fun w₁ => workPair w₀ w₁ := by
  simp [workReadsK, fin_cons_one, fin_cons_two]

/-- At two work tapes the generic table writer is `Turing.codeTable2Bits`. -/
lemma tableBitsK_two {n : ℕ}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin 2 → Option Bool) → Action 2 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) :
    tableBitsK tr = codeTable2Bits (fun q inp w₀ w₁ => tr q inp (workPair w₀ w₁)) := by
  unfold tableBitsK codeTable2Bits
  rw [workReadsK_two]
  simp only [List.flatMap_assoc, List.flatMap_map]

/-- At two work tapes the generic table skipper is `Turing.codeSkipTable2`. -/
lemma codeSkipTable2_eq_codeSkipTableK (n : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :
    codeSkipTable2 n xs = codeSkipTableK 2 n xs := rfl

/-! ## Machine formats -/

/-- A **deterministic machine format**: a `Turing.CodeFormat` whose codes denote
`k`-work-tape binary machines, serialized in the fixed `k`-record layout and
parsed by the fixed `k`-record grammar. [AB09, §1.4] -/
structure MachineFormat extends CodeFormat where
  /-- the work-tape count of the coded machines -/
  k : ℕ
  /-- the machine a code denotes -/
  machine : (M : Code) → MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (numStates M + 1))
  /-- the format's serialization is the fixed `k`-record serialization -/
  serialize_eq : ∀ M, serialize M = serializeK (machine M)
  /-- the format's table skipper is the fixed `k`-record skipper -/
  skipTable_eq : ∀ n xs, skipTable n xs = codeSkipTableK k n xs

/-- The bundled machine a code of a machine format denotes. -/
def MachineFormat.toFinTM (F : MachineFormat) (M : F.Code) : FinTM Bool where
  k := F.k
  State := Fin (F.numStates M + 1)
  tm := F.machine M

/-- The one-tape format's table skipper is the generic skipper at one work tape: the
framed one-tape action skipper is `Turing.codeSkipActionK 1`. -/
private lemma oneTape_skipTable_eq (n : ℕ) (xs : List Bool) :
    oneTapeFormat.skipTable n xs = codeSkipTableK 1 n xs := by
  have h : codeSkipAction n = codeSkipActionK 1 n :=
    funext (codeSkipAction_eq_codeSkipActionK n)
  show codeSkipRepeat (codeSkipRepeat (codeSkipRepeat (codeSkipAction n) 3) 3) (n + 1) xs = _
  rw [h]; rfl

/-- The frozen one-tape serialization is the generic one at one work tape, record for
record (`Turing.workReadsK_one`, `Turing.actionBits_eq_actionBitsK`). -/
private lemma oneTape_serialize_eq (M : CodeTM) : M.serialize = serializeK M.tm := by
  unfold CodeTM.serialize serializeK tableBitsK
  rw [workReadsK_one]
  simp only [List.flatMap_map, actionBits_eq_actionBitsK]

/-- The one-work-tape code format `Turing.oneTapeFormat` as a machine format.
Its decoder is `Turing.codeDecode` and its bundled machines are
`Turing.CodeTM.toFinTM`, both definitionally. [AB09, §1.4] -/
def oneTapeMachineFormat : MachineFormat :=
  { oneTapeFormat with
    k := 1
    machine := fun M => M.tm
    serialize_eq := oneTape_serialize_eq
    skipTable_eq := oneTape_skipTable_eq }

namespace MachineFormat

variable (F : MachineFormat)

/-! ### Positive grammar bound (B5a fill preparation)

These lemmas justify the extra fail-fast guard even when `F.guard = 0`.
They concern the specified parser; the finite binary implementation and its
polynomial time ledger remain the canonizer's continuation obligation.
-/

/-- Iterated skipping consumes the sum of the per-record lower bounds.

**Proof sketch.** Split off the first successful skip, apply the induction
hypothesis to its suffix, and add the two length inequalities. -/
private lemma skipRepeat_consumes (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool)) (b : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ xs ys, r xs = some ys → b + ys.length ≤ xs.length)
    (m : ℕ) (xs ys : List Bool) (h : codeSkipRepeat r m xs = some ys) :
    b * m + ys.length ≤ xs.length := by
  induction m generalizing xs with
  | zero =>
    have heq : xs = ys := Option.some.inj h
    simp [heq]
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨zs, hz, hy⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
    have hfirst := hr xs zs hz
    have hrest := ih zs hy
    rw [Nat.mul_succ]
    omega

/-- Nesting a three-symbol reader multiplies its consumption bound by three. -/
private lemma skipSymbols_consumes (r : List Bool → Option (List Bool)) (b : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ xs ys, r xs = some ys → b + ys.length ≤ xs.length)
    (j : ℕ) (xs ys : List Bool)
    (h : ((fun f => codeSkipRepeat f 3)^[j] r) xs = some ys) :
    b * 3 ^ j + ys.length ≤ xs.length := by
  induction j generalizing xs ys with
  | zero => simpa using hr xs ys h
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at h
    have hb := skipRepeat_consumes _ (b * 3 ^ j) (fun u v huv => ih u v huv)
      3 xs ys h
    simpa only [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc] using hb

/-- A successful table skip consumes a positive number of bits per state,
independently of the format's optional guard. -/
private lemma skipTable_consumes (k n : ℕ) (xs ys : List Bool)
    (h : codeSkipTableK k n xs = some ys) :
    (4 * k + 5) * 3 ^ (k + 1) * (n + 1) + ys.length ≤ xs.length := by
  have ha (u v : List Bool) (hu : codeSkipActionK k n u = some v) :
      4 * k + 5 + v.length ≤ u.length := by
    rw [← codeEraseActionK] at hu
    obtain ⟨⟨a, rest⟩, hread, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hu
    rw [codeReadActionK_sound u a rest hread, List.length_append]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (codeActionK_length a) _
  exact skipRepeat_consumes _ _ (fun u v huv =>
    skipSymbols_consumes _ _ ha (k + 1) u v huv) (n + 1) xs ys h

/-- A successful scanner satisfies the positive grammar guard already on the
suffix following the binary header. This holds also for a zero format guard.

**Proof sketch.** Decompose the successful scanner into its header, initial-state
and table checks. Erasure and initial-state reader soundness show that the table
input is a suffix of the header remainder. Apply the generic table-skip bound
and discard the nonnegative final-suffix length. -/
private lemma scan_grammar_guard (α bits rest tail : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest)) (hs : F.scan α = some tail) :
    (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (codeBitsNat bits + 1) ≤ rest.length := by
  unfold CodeFormat.scan at hs
  rw [hp] at hs
  dsimp only [bind, Option.bind] at hs
  split at hs
  · contradiction
  split at hs
  · contradiction
  obtain ⟨table, hq, ht⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp hs
  obtain ⟨suffix, htable, _⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp ht
  rw [F.skipTable_eq] at htable
  have hlen := skipTable_consumes F.k (codeBitsNat bits) table suffix htable
  rw [← codeEraseFin] at hq
  obtain ⟨⟨q, r⟩, hread, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp hq
  have hword := codeReadFin_sound rest q r hread
  have hrest : r.length ≤ rest.length := by
    rw [hword, List.length_append]
    omega
  dsimp only at hlen
  omega

/-- Reject a binary header whose declared table cannot fit in the remaining
input, before evaluating the format scanner. This is a specification function,
not yet a certified finite-machine implementation. -/
private def guardedScan (α : List Bool) : Option (List Bool) := do
  let (bits, rest) ← pairDecode α
  if rest.length < (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)
    then none else F.scan α

/-- The additional positive guard preserves the scanner exactly.

**Proof sketch.** Header failure already fails the scanner. If the new guard
fails, any hypothetical successful scan contradicts `scan_grammar_guard`;
otherwise the guarded scanner calls the original scanner. -/
private lemma guardedScan_eq (α : List Bool) : guardedScan F α = F.scan α := by
  unfold guardedScan
  cases hp : pairDecode α with
  | none => simp [CodeFormat.scan, hp]
  | some p =>
    rcases p with ⟨bits, rest⟩
    dsimp only [bind, Option.bind]
    split
    next hg =>
      cases hs : F.scan α with
      | none => rfl
      | some tail =>
        have := scan_grammar_guard F α bits rest tail hp hs
        omega
    · rfl

/-- Early failure of the positive grammar guard selects exactly the prescribed
fallback, including for a zero guard and a potentially accepting fallback. -/
private lemma decode_of_grammar_guard (α bits rest : List Bool)
    (hp : pairDecode α = some (bits, rest))
    (hg : rest.length < (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (codeBitsNat bits + 1)) :
    F.decode α = F.fallback := by
  have hs : F.scan α = none := by
    rw [← guardedScan_eq]
    simp [guardedScan, hp, hg]
  have hparse : F.parseFull α = none := by
    rw [F.scan_full] at hs
    exact Option.map_eq_none_iff.mp hs
  exact F.decode_of_parseFull_none α hparse

/-- Passing the positive guard bounds state-count work by the available input. -/
private lemma grammar_guard_states (n s : ℕ)
    (h : (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (n + 1) ≤ s) : n + 1 ≤ s := by
  have hc : 1 ≤ (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (Nat.pow_pos (by omega))
  have hs : n + 1 ≤ (4 * F.k + 5) * 3 ^ (F.k + 1) * (n + 1) := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n + 1) hc
  exact hs.trans h

/-! ### Physical binary-header loading (B5a continuation) -/

/-- The undoubled header, or the empty word when the pair grammar fails.
The later validation phase must distinguish failure from a valid zero header. -/
private def canonHeader (α : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  ((pairDecode α).map Prod.fst).getD []

/-- Loading a doubled header never produces more bits than the source input. -/
private lemma canonHeader_length (α : List Bool) : (canonHeader α).length ≤ α.length := by
  cases hp : pairDecode α with
  | none => simp [canonHeader, hp]
  | some p =>
    rcases p with ⟨bits, rest⟩
    have he := congrArg List.length (eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode α bits rest hp)
    rw [length_pairEncode] at he
    simp only [canonHeader, hp, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
    omega

/-- A physical linear-time header loader installs the binary header on tape
zero and restores a clean seam with the original native input available.

**Proof sketch.** Install the public pair-first extractor through the public
native-input call row. The header length is at most the original input length,
so the call row's ledger is linear as well. No parsing or host trace is copied. -/
private lemma exists_canonHeaderCall :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * (α.length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ u, 0 < u → u < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) u).state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := α) entry (fun _ => [])) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (canonHeader α)) := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, hM⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairFst
  obtain ⟨C, entry, exit, c, hk, hC⟩ :=
    FinTM.exists_inputCallTM M canonHeader (fun n => a * (n + 1)) hM
  refine ⟨C, entry, exit, c * (a + 2), hk, ?_⟩
  intro α
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hcut, hrun⟩ := hC α
  refine ⟨t, ht.trans ?_, hpos, hcut, hrun⟩
  have hlen := canonHeader_length α
  calc
    c * (a * (α.length + 1) + α.length + (canonHeader α).length + 1) ≤
        c * (a * (α.length + 1) + 2 * (α.length + 1)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (by omega)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-! ### Physical fail-fast length guard (B5a continuation)

The catalog has whole-input scans but no fixed-block input scan with a short-input
exit. The following body supplies that missing finite controller; the binary
countdown itself is the public `counterLoopTM`, not a new loop implementation.
The body has no work tapes and never emits. Its block length is `b + 1`, so
even the zero-format-guard case can use the positive grammar minimum.
-/

/-- Progress through a fixed positive block; `none` is the short-input exit. -/
private def guardPhase (b u : ℕ) : Option (Fin (b + 1)) :=
  some ⟨u % (b + 1), Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩

/-- Read at most `b + 1` actual input symbols, returning to the anchor after
one whole block and taking a distinct live exit on a boundary blank. -/
private def guardBlockTM (b : ℕ) : MultiTapeTM 0 Bool (Option (Fin (b + 1))) where
  q₀ := guardPhase b 0
  tr := fun q inp _ => match q with
    | none => inputMoveAction 0 none
    | some i => if inp.isSome then
        inputMoveAction 1 (guardPhase b (i.val + 1))
      else inputMoveAction 0 none

/-- A block-scan configuration after `j` input cells have been consumed. -/
private def guardCfg (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (q : Option (Fin (b + 1)))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    Cfg 0 Bool (Option (Fin (b + 1))) x :=
  ⟨some q, ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, out⟩

/-- The finite block controller advances one cell without writing or emitting.
The input-only action law supplies all unchanged configuration fields. -/
private lemma guardBlock_step (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (u j : ℕ)
    (hu : u < b + 1) (hj : j < x.length) (out : List Bool) :
    (guardBlockTM b).step (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out) =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b (u + 1)) (j + 1) (by omega) out := by
  have hr := inputSymbolInner
    (cfg := guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out) j (by dsimp [guardCfg]; omega) hj
  rw [step_of_inputMoveAction (guardBlockTM b) _ (q' := guardPhase b (u + 1)) 1 rfl (by
    change (if (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out).inputSymbol.isSome then
      inputMoveAction 1 (guardPhase b (u % (b + 1) + 1)) else inputMoveAction 0 none) = _
    rw [hr]
    simp only [Option.isSome_some, if_true, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hu])]
  apply Cfg.ext_zero_tapes
  · rfl
  · apply Fin.ext
    change (moveInputPos (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) j (by omega) out).inputPos
      SignType.pos).val = j + 1 + 1
    rw [moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by dsimp [guardCfg]; omega)]
    rfl
  · rfl

/-- Every available prefix of one block is traversed in exactly its length.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the traversed prefix and apply the input-only
one-step contract. The upper bound prevents an intermediate anchor return. -/
private lemma guardBlock_run (b : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j ≤ x.length) (out : List Bool) (u : ℕ)
    (hu : u ≤ b + 1) (hlen : j + u ≤ x.length) :
    (guardBlockTM b).runFrom (guardCfg b x (guardPhase b 0) j hj out) u =
      guardCfg b x (guardPhase b u) (j + u) hlen out := by
  induction u with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ u ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega) (by omega)]
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using
      guardBlock_step b x u (j + u) (by omega) (by omega) out

/-- At the right input blank, the next transition takes the short-input exit. -/
